trivia: The 🐋 is one of the 5 Emoji fish in the game, with the others being 🦑, 🐟, 🦈 and 🐡.
Catching the 🐋 outside of Admin Events rewards the player with the 🐋 title.

%F0%9F%90%9F.intro: 🐟 is a Secret fish found rarely in any body of water.
trivia: The 🐟 is one of the 5 Emoji fish in the game, with the others being 🐋, 🦑, 🦈 and 🐡.
Catching the 🐟 outside of Admin Events rewards the player with the 🐟 title.

%F0%9F%90%A1.intro: 🐡 is a Secret fish found rarely in any body of water.
trivia: Catching the 🐡 outside of Admin Events rewards the player with the 🐡 title.

%F0%9F%A6%88.intro: 🦈 is a Secret fish found rarely in any body of water.
trivia: Catching the 🦈 outside of Admin Events rewards the player with the 🦈 title.

%F0%9F%A6%8B.intro: 🦋 is a Secret fish found in the Living Garden.

1000-Year-Old_Wood.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

8-Bit_Mr._Tentacles.description: His bits are 8, but someday they'll be OVAR 9000!!!!1!
8-Bit_Mr._Tentacles.intro: 8-Bit Mr. Tentacles is a Special fish found in any body of water during the MADNESS, MEGA MAYHEM and Tentacles Admin Events.

Abaia.description: The serpent sealed beneath Skycrest. It drank from the Sky Crystals until the island itself fled into the clouds, and it has not forgotten the taste.
Abaia.intro: Abaia is an Exotic fish found in the Skycrest.

Abyss_Dart.description: A lilac colored fish with light purple fins and a sharp, pointed snout, piercing the abyss like a dart.
Abyss_Dart.intro: Abyss Dart is an Extinct fish found at Waveborne.

Abyss_Flicker.description: A dark purple fish with white accents, flickering like a ghost in the deep.
Abyss_Flicker.intro: Abyss Flicker is an Extinct fish found in the Isle of New Beginnings.

Abyss_Snapper.description: A territorial fish with sharp teeth and storm-grey scales. These snappers have adapted to the constant turbulence of the Atlantean Storm, using the currents to ambush their prey.
Abyss_Snapper.intro: Abyss Snapper is an Uncommon fish found in the Atlantean Storm.

Abyssacuda.description: Abyssacudas are large predatory fish, known for their fearsome appearance and ferocious behaviour. They are adept swimmers, and are a top predator for the Twilight Eel. Abyssacudas are related to the Barracuda, however their cause for being primarily innate to Vertigo is unknown.
Abyssacuda.intro: Abyssacuda is a Rare fish found in Vertigo.

Abyssal_Bearded_Seadevil.description: A terrifying fish with a glowing beard-like lure and razor-sharp teeth.
Abyssal_Bearded_Seadevil.intro: Abyssal Bearded Seadevil is an Uncommon fish found in the Abyssal Zenith of Mariana's Veil.

Abyssal_Devourer.description: A colossal entity that feeds on darkness itself. Its hunger is endless, and its presence creates a void that nothing escapes.
Abyssal_Devourer.intro: Abyssal Devourer is a Mythical fish found in Atlantis.

Abyssal_Gauntlets.intro: The Abyssal Gauntlets are a gloves equipment that reveals the hooked fish's mutation at the start of the catch and grants +10% Universal Mutation Chance.

Abyssal_Goliath.description: A colossal deep-sea fish of impossible size, its mere presence creates currents in the water. Its true size is unknown as none have ever seen its full form.
Abyssal_Goliath.intro: Abyssal Goliath is a Mythical fish found in Atlantis.

Abyssal_Grenadier.description: A deep-sea rattail scavenging abyssal plains worldwide.
Abyssal_Grenadier.intro: Abyssal Grenadier is a Mythical fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Abyssal_King.description: A colossal being that rules over the abyssal depths. Its authority is second only to the Kraken itself, and its movements can cause earthquakes.
Abyssal_King.intro: Abyssal King is a Legendary fish found in Kraken Lair.

Abyssal_Maw.description: A gaping jagged maw rises from the abyss, with devastating hunger for more than what is imaginable.
Abyssal_Maw.intro: Abyssal Maw is a Limited fish found within the Cults Curse event.

Abyssal_Slickhead.description: A deep-sea slickhead with smooth, scaleless skin, inhabiting abyssal waters.
Abyssal_Slickhead.intro: Abyssal Slickhead is a Common fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Abyssal_Tonic.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Abyssborn_Monstrosity.description: A colossal terror birthed from the abyss’s cruel heart.
Abyssborn_Monstrosity.intro: Abyssborn Monstrosity is a Secret fish found in the Cursed Isle, and formerly in The Cursed Shores.

Acanthodii.description: Acanthodii, commonly known as Spiny Sharks, possess many scales that form a diamond pattern along its body. They prey on smaller creatures among the Ancient Isle's waters, and are active both during the day and night. They went extinct around 250 million years ago, at the end of the Permian period.
Acanthodii.intro: Acanthodii is an Unusual fish found in the Ancient Isle.

Admin_Bait_Crate.description: A wooden crate with fabric over top to preserve the bait inside. Seemingly lost from an admin's boat of some kind. The bait is still alive and fresh. Therefore, finders keepers?- Opening it might give you an array of admin-exclusive baits!
Admin_Bait_Crate.intro: Admin Bait Crate is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Crates, Shady Surge, and Tidefall Resurgence Admin Events.

Admin_Crate.description: A moderately sized admin crate seemingly lost from an admin's boat of some kind. The date of it's disappearance is unknown. Therefore, finders keepers?- Opening it might give you an array of admin fish, bait, and money!
Admin_Crate.intro: Admin Crate is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Crates Admin Event.

Admin_Fish_Barrel.description: A large admin barrel with iron hoops. The barrel filled with a large array of admin fish that all seem pretty fresh. Therefore, finders keeps?- Opening it might give you an assortment of admin fish
Admin_Fish_Barrel.intro: Admin Fish Barrel is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Crates and Tidefall Resurgence Admin Event.

Admin_Relic.description: The ultimate relic, capable of shaping itself to match the wishes of its owner...
Admin_Relic.intro: Admin Relic is a Special fish exclusively given out by admins at Admin Events.

Adumbral_Shark.description: Adumbral Sharks are rare nocturnal sharks found beneath the Enchanted Crevice. They resemble Umbral Sharks, but their darker bodies are lined with glowing carcks from the altar's leaking power. They are usually calm, though their strengh can become overwhelming when disturbed.
Adumbral_Shark.intro: Adumbral Shark is a Legendary fish found in Enchanted Crevice.

Advanced_Diving_Gear.intro: The Advanced Diving Gear is a diving gear equipment that can be used to aid in swimming and breathing underwater. It acts as the direct upgrade to the Basic Diving Gear.

Advanced_Oxygen_Tank.intro: The Advanced Oxygen Tank is an oxygen tank equipment that acts as a direct upgrade from the Intermediate Oxygen Tank. This oxygen tank lasts the longest and is highly recommended to purchase in order to survive at the summit of the mountain.

Aegisbreaker_Ray.description: A radiant ray that tears through invisible barriers with ease.
Aegisbreaker_Ray.intro: Aegisbreaker Ray is a Rare fish found in Olympian Fissure.

Aetherfin.description: A surreal form of manta ray; an extremely rare and unknown catch...
Aetherfin.intro: Aetherfin is a Divine Secret fish found rarely at Roslit Bay.

African_Butterflyfish.description: A specialized surface hunter equipped with wing-like pectoral fins that enable gliding leaps to snatch insects from the air.
African_Butterflyfish.intro: African Butterflyfish is a Rare fish found in the Skycrest.

Akkorokamui.description: A divine cephalopod from ancient legend, Akkorokamui's scarlet tendrils glow like veins of fire through the sea. It is said to grant great fortune to those it spares; and swift demise to those it doesn't.
Akkorokamui.intro: Akkorokamui is an Apex fish found during an Earthquake, and was formerly found anywhere during Continental Drift.

Algae_Lurker.description: A long green-blue fish with light green fins, lurking among tangled algae.
Algae_Lurker.intro: Algae Lurker is an Extinct fish found in the Azure Lagoon.

Alien_Buddy.intro: Alien Buddy is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Aliens and MADNESS Admin Event.

Alien_Hat.intro: Alien Hat is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Aliens Admin Event.

All_Season_Potion.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Alligator.description: The Alligator is a massive, fearsome reptile known for its powerful bite and armoured body. Found in Mushgrove Swamp, Alligators are the apex predator with a stealthy and ambush-based hunting style.
Alligator.intro: Alligator is a Legendary fish found in Mushgrove Swamp.

Alligator_Gar.description: The Alligator Gar is a large, vicious freshwater fish that can be found in Roslit Bays pond. Gars track back to 100 million years ago, giving them the nickname as a 'living fossil'.
Alligator_Gar.intro: Alligator Gar is a Rare fish found in Roslit Bay.

Alpaca_Plushie.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Altarfin_Grouper.description: Altarfin Groupers are bulky fish that hide near the broken wall between the Enchanted Crevice and the Keepers Altar. Their stone-like marking and faint altar-shaped patterns make them difficult to spot when they stay still.
Altarfin_Grouper.intro: Altarfin Grouper is a Rare fish found in Enchanted Crevice.

Amberjack.description: The Amberjack is a strong, fast-swimming fish known for their vigorous fights and robust body. Mostly active in spring, and best caught in open ocean waters with live baitfish such as small minnows. The Amberjack is not rare or hard to come by, but it does put up an impressive battle when trying to catch.
Amberjack.intro: Amberjack is an Uncommon fish found in the Ocean.

Amberleaf_Carp.description: A carp with scales resembling falling amber leaves, drifting lazily in cooling waters.
Amberleaf_Carp.intro: Amberleaf Carp is an Uncommon fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Amblypterus.description: Amblypterus is an extinct genus of prehistoric fish from the Carboniferous period, known for its unusual body shape and large, complex pectoral fins that allowed for agile, precise movement.
Amblypterus.intro: Amblypterus is a Mythical fish found in the Ancient Archives.

Amethyst.description: A purple variety of quartz with calming properties.
Amethyst.intro: Amethyst is a Gemstone found inside Meteors in the Ancient Isle.

Amphibian_Boots.intro: The Amphibian Boots are a reusable piece of equipment which can be used to increase the player's movement speed and jump height on land.

Amulet.intro: The Amulet is a miscellaneous equipment that keeps the player from decaying while in Oscar's Locker.

Ancestral_Abaia.description: The serpent as it was before the seal. Older, angrier, and far beyond what any single angler should attempt alone.
Ancestral_Abaia.intro: Ancestral Abaia is a Secret fish found in the Skycrest.

Ancestral_Pliosaur.description: A monstrous marine reptile from the age of dinosaurs, with a skull larger than a man and jaws built to crush.
Ancestral_Pliosaur.intro: Ancestral Pliosaur is a Secret fish found in Collapsed Ruins.

Anchor.description: A massive, ancient ship's anchor, covered in rust and barnacles.
Anchor.intro: Anchor is a Mythical fish found in the Tidefall.

Anchovy.description: Anchovies are extremely small and slender fish, with a silvery sheen. They are known for their schooling behaviour and are a common catch near Moosewood.
Anchovy.intro: Anchovy is a Common fish found in Moosewood.

Ancient_Algae.intro: Ancient Algae is a Limited fish found in Algae Hunts during the Golden Tide event.

Ancient_Depth_Serpent.description: A colossal, serpent-like creature with armored scales and glowing eyes, lurking in the abyss. The Ancient Depth Serpent is only active when The Depths go completely dark... No one knows where it goes in the meantime, possibly lurking in a secret cave?
Ancient_Depth_Serpent.intro: Ancient Depth Serpent is an Exotic fish found during the Absolute Darkness event in The Depths of Vertigo.

Ancient_Eel.description: A long, snake-like eel with glowing patterns and a menacing, ancient presence. This is one of the oldest creatures known to man, with it dating back to 3400 BCE.
Ancient_Eel.intro: Ancient Eel is a Legendary fish found in The Depths of Vertigo.

Ancient_Fragment.description: A magical stone with an etching representing a mystical sea creature lost in time.
Ancient_Fragment.intro: Ancient Fragment is a Fragment found in the Ancient Isle.

Ancient_Goldwraith.description: A spectral fish made of living gold, said to be the guardian spirit of the Crowned Ruins. Its passage leaves trails of light.
Ancient_Goldwraith.intro: Ancient Goldwraith is a Secret fish found in Crowned Ruins.

Ancient_Kraken.description: A direct descendant of the original Kraken, possessing a fraction of its progenitor's power. Its true form is impossible to comprehend, and its strength is beyond measure.
Ancient_Kraken.intro: Ancient Kraken is a Secret fish found in Atlantis.

Ancient_Lobster.description: Lobsters are valuable crustaceans known for their rich, succulent meat. Lobsters are most active in the summer to autumn, and are commonly caught in crab cages during calm clear days.
Ancient_Lobster.intro: Ancient Lobster is an Extinct fish found in Lobster Shores.

Ancient_Megalodon.description: The Ancient Megalodon is a colossal predatory shark from prehistoric times, unmatched in size and ferocity. With its massive mouth and serrated teeth, it can effortlessly rip through any obstacle. A true apex predator of the Ancient Isle, it offers an incredible battle for those daring to catch it.
Ancient_Megalodon.intro: Ancient Megalodon is an Exotic fish found in the Ancient Isle.
trivia: The Ancient Megalodon is likely a reference to the ' Shrouded Ghost ' enemy from Sea of Thieves.
Catching 3 Ancient Megalodons will award the player the ' Ancient's Chosen One ' Title.
The Ancient Megalodon is a John Doe skin in another Roblox game, Forsaken.

Ancient_Orca.description: A rare orca, tend to migrate from time to time.
Ancient_Orca.intro: Ancient Orca is a Secret fish found during the Albine Orca Migration event in the Ocean.
trivia: Catching an Ancient Orca will award the player the ' Sea Whisperer ' Title.

Ancient_Serpent_Skull.description: A haunting, bone-chilling relic from a monstrous, lost predator, shrouded in eerie mystery. Beware... Locals say the skull holds a haunting power...
Ancient_Serpent_Skull.intro: Ancient Serpent Skull is a Limited fish found in Forsaken Shores during the Archaeological Hunt event.

Ancient_Serpent_Spine.description: A chilling relic of a fearsome, long-forgotten creature, radiating an aura of dread.
Ancient_Serpent_Spine.intro: Ancient Serpent Spine is a Limited fish found in Forsaken Shores during the Archaeological Hunt event.

Ancient_Skin_Crate.intro: Skins offer a way to change the appearance of player belongings. Currently, they can only be applied to Fishing Rods.

Ancient_Thread.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Ancient_Wood.description: Reputed to harbor the essence of Ancient Wisdom, etched into the very grain of its timeless wood.
Ancient_Wood.intro: Ancient Wood is a Legendary Crafting Ingredient found on Sunstone Island.

Angelfish.description: Angelfish are colorful and striking reef dwellers, known for their vibrant patterns and graceful swimming. Found in Roslit bays coral reef, they are a fun and elegant part of Roslits ecosystem.
Angelfish.intro: Angelfish is an Unusual fish found in Roslit Bay.

Angler%27s_Glove.intro: The Angler's Glove is a gloves equipment that enhances all bait stats by 1.1× in fishing, no matter if its negative or positive. It also grants a 50% chance not to consume bait.

Anglerfish.description: The anglerfish is a deep-sea predator known for it's bioluminescent lure that dangles in front of its mouth to attract prey. With its menacing appearance, sharp teeth, and eerie glow, the Anglerfish thrives in dark, deep waters, making it a rare and exciting catch in the Deep Ocean.
Anglerfish.intro: Anglerfish is a Rare fish found in the Ocean.

Anglers_Lantern.description: A glowing anglerfish lantern with eerie deep-sea bioluminescence and sharp teeth.
Anglers_Lantern.intro: Anglers Lantern is an Exotic fish obtained from the Anglerfish Puzzle in the Abyssal Zenith.

Anomalocaris.description: The Anomalocaris is a large predator of the Ancient Isle. They flex their fins in a wave-like motion to generate speed, which they use to pursue prey. They bear strong armor-like scales on their backs, making them quite strong. The Anomalocaris went extinct around 485 million years ago at the end of the Ordovician period.
Anomalocaris.intro: Anomalocaris is an Uncommon fish found in the Ancient Isle.

Antarctic_Icefish.description: The Antarctic Icefish is a unique pale fish with transparent blood, lacking hemoglobin, adapted to the freezing waters around Antarctica.
Antarctic_Icefish.intro: Antarctic Icefish is a Rare fish found in Boreal Pines.

Antarctic_Whitefish.description: A cold-hardened salmonid with pale silver scales adapted to frigid sub-zero ponds.
Antarctic_Whitefish.intro: Antarctic Whitefish is an Uncommon fish found in the Astral Observatory - Boreal Pines.

Apex_Leviathan.description: A shadowed serpent of the abyss, vast and coiling, its pale eyes pierce the darkness as it swallows ships whole.
Apex_Leviathan.intro: Apex Leviathan is an Extinct fish found in the Open Ocean during Apex Fish Hunts.

Aphrodite_Anthias.description: A mesmerizing mesophotic reef species covered in neon pink and electric yellow vertical bands, named after the goddess of beauty.
Aphrodite_Anthias.intro: Aphrodite Anthias is a Mythical fish found in the Skycrest.

Aqua_Scribe.description: These peculiar fish are often seen tracing patterns in the ethereal silt that resemble ancient script. Some scholars believe they're connected to the abyss's lost knowledge.
Aqua_Scribe.intro: Aqua Scribe is a Common fish found in Atlantis.

Aquatic_Tackle_Box.description: A sealed utility container packed with specialized trench grubs, chitin pellets, and glowing phosphor jellies.
Aquatic_Tackle_Box.intro: Aquatic Tackle Box is an Unusual fish found at Outer Deep of The Deep.

Arapaima.description: Arapaima are massive freshwater fish with large, broad bodies and a distinctive, armor-like scaled appearance. They have a unique respiratory system that allows them to breathe air, as well as gills.
Arapaima.intro: Arapaima is a Rare fish found in Roslit Bay.

Arbiter_Snailfish.description: A rare ultra-abyssal liparid patrolling extreme depths where few other vertebrates survive.
Arbiter_Snailfish.intro: Arbiter Snailfish is a Legendary fish found at Lower Deep of The Deep.

Arcflash_Koi.description: A koi that flickers between visibility like a living arc of light.
Arcflash_Koi.intro: Arcflash Koi is an Unusual fish found in Zeus's Thunder of Chaos.

Arctic_Char.description: The Arctic Char is a striking fish commonly known for its vibrant reddish-orange belly and long mouth. They can be found in the cold salt-waters of Snowcap Island.
Arctic_Char.intro: Arctic Char is an Uncommon fish found in Snowcap Island.

Argosgeorgiae_Snailfish.description: A southern ocean bathyal snailfish species residing within freezing crevice bottoms.
Argosgeorgiae_Snailfish.intro: Argosgeorgiae Snailfish is a Rare fish found in the Gloomy Crevice.

Armorhead.description: A large fish with a bony, armored head and strong jaws.
Armorhead.intro: Armorhead is an Unusual fish found in Crowned Ruins.

Ash-Cloud_Angelfish.description: A laterally compressed reef fish with smoky gray, veil-like fins that resemble rising plumes of volcanic ash.
Ash-Cloud_Angelfish.intro: Ash-Cloud Angelfish is an Uncommon fish found in Obsidian Trench of Mariana's Veil.

Ashclaw.description: Born from magma and fury, the Ashclaw scuttles through the lowest point of lava within Roslit Bay's volcano. Its shell burns with the heat of a thousand eruptions, and its claws leave trails of ember wherever it walks.
Ashclaw.intro: Ashclaw is an Apex fish found in Roslit Volcano during Eruptions.

Ashcloud_Archerfish.description: The guardian of Ashfall, wreathing in plumes of smoke and flickering embers. With masterful precision, the Ashcloud Archerfish shoots scorching lava at its targets with ferocious intent. Nothing is left behind...
Ashcloud_Archerfish.intro: Ashcloud Archerfish is a Limited fish found in Roslit Bay 's saltwater during the Ashfall event.

Ashen_Gem.description: A gemstone only found in the Scoria Mines, quite a pretty find!
Ashen_Gem.intro: Ashen Gem is a Gemstone found in Scoria Reach.

Ashscale_Minnow.description: A small, ashen-hued fish, flickering through the haze with subtle shadows.
Ashscale_Minnow.intro: Ashscale Minnow is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Ashy_Pearl.description: A pearl covered in ash and soot, seems to be pretty fresh.
Ashy_Pearl.intro: Ashy Pearl is a Common fish found in Lava Clams at a 75.188% chance.

Astronomical_Fretboard.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Atlantean_Alchemist.description: These fish have evolved to process magical minerals, causing their scales to transmute between different precious metals. They're living examples of ancient alchemy.
Atlantean_Alchemist.intro: Atlantean Alchemist is a Rare fish found in Sunken Depths.

Atlantean_Anchovy.description: These small silver fish gather in massive schools throughout the sunken depths. Their scales have taken on a slight golden tinge from generations of exposure to ancient magic.
Atlantean_Anchovy.intro: Atlantean Anchovy is a Common fish found in Atlantis.

Atlantean_Guardian.description: These impressive fish patrol the ancient ruins like sentinels. Their scales bear markings reminiscent of ancient armor, and they're known to chase away threatening predators.
Atlantean_Guardian.intro: Atlantean Guardian is an Unusual fish found in Sunken Depths.

Atlantean_Sardine.description: These tiny fish have evolved to navigate the narrow ethereal currents. Their scales have a unique blue-green tint from consuming the abyss's ancient algae.
Atlantean_Sardine.intro: Atlantean Sardine is a Common fish found in Ethereal Abyss.

Atlantic_Dragonfish.description: A ferocious stomiid predator armed with long fang-like teeth and bioluminescent chin barbels.
Atlantic_Dragonfish.intro: Atlantic Dragonfish is an Unusual fish found at Lower Deep of The Deep.

Atlantic_Goliath_Grouper.description: A titanic, slow-moving grouper that inhabits wrecks and reefs. Bestairy Entry
Atlantic_Goliath_Grouper.intro: Atlantic Goliath Grouper is a Legendary fish found in Coral Bastion.

Atlantic_Halosaur.description: An eel-like fish with a distinctive upturned tail, probing the mud with its snout.
Atlantic_Halosaur.intro: Atlantic Halosaur is an Uncommon fish found in Collapsed Ruins.

Atlantis_Skin_Crate.intro: Skins offer a way to change the appearance of player belongings.

Atolla_Jellyfish.description: A crown-shaped jelly pulsing blue flashes to startle predators in the deep.
Atolla_Jellyfish.intro: Atolla Jellyfish is a Mythical fish found in the Luminescent Cavern.

Atomic_Nuke.intro: Atomic Nukes are a localized event in Fisch that allow the player to catch the Atomic Mutation when fishing.

Auric_Angelfish.description: A regal angelfish coated in a deep, polished gold sheen.
Auric_Angelfish.intro: Auric Angelfish is a Rare fish found in Apollo's Song of Light.

Aurora_Gar.description: A mythical gar variant whose elongated body glows with shifting polar auroral hues.
Aurora_Gar.intro: Aurora Gar is a Mythical fish found in the Astral Observatory - Boreal Pines.

Aurora_Pearl.description: The colors and light of the Aurora Borealis is prevalent within this glowing pearl.
Aurora_Pearl.intro: Aurora Pearl is a Mythical fish found in Clams behind Roslit Bay at a 1.96% chance.

Aurora_Totem.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Aurora_Trout.description: A radiant trout with iridescent scales that glow faintly, resembling the northern lights.
Aurora_Trout.intro: Aurora Trout is a Mythical fish found in the Cryogenic Canal.

Avalanche_Totem.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Awakened_Omnithal.description: A bioluminescent leviathan with multiple glowing eyes, said to guard the deepest, oldest wrecks.
Awakened_Omnithal.intro: Awakened Omnithal is a Secret fish found in Sunken Reliquary.

Awakening_Serum.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Axolotl.description: Axolotls are small carnivorous creatures who reside in the Roslit Bay pond. They are nocturnal creatures and are known to hunt primarily worms. They are well known for their ability to regenerate and adorable faces.
Axolotl.intro: Axolotl is a Legendary fish found in Roslit Bay.
trivia: When caught with a Shiny Attributes, the Axolotl will have a crispy, fried-style texture, with one of its eyes being red.

Azure_Prowler.description: A blue fish with golden fins, prowling the lagoon with regal grace.
Azure_Prowler.intro: Azure Prowler is an Extinct fish found in the Azure Lagoon.

Azure_Studfish.description: A vibrant blue fish adorned with LEGO studs, shimmering like a sapphire in the sea.
Azure_Studfish.intro: Azure Studfish is a Limited fish found in LEGO Pools during the LEGO Event.
trivia: The Azure Studfish is from LEGO® Set 31122; Product page.

Azureback_Haddock_School.intro: Azureback Haddock School is an Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

BBQ_Bass.description: A bass that brought its own grill. Smells like charcoal and good times.
BBQ_Bass.intro: BBQ Bass is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Baby%27s_First_Balloon.description: A giant balloon shaped like the number 1, the first of many birthdays!
Baby%27s_First_Balloon.intro: Baby's First Balloon is a Limited fish found in any body of water during the Anniversary event.
trivia: Catching the Baby's First Balloon rewards the player with the " 🎈 " title.

Baby_Bloop_Fish.intro: Baby Bloop Fish is an Exotic fish found during a Baby Bloop Fish Hunt, in Bloop Cosmetic Crates, and various Admin Events.

Baby_Chick.description: A tiny, peeping fluffball that skitters across the shallows in search of crumbs. Baby Chicks are very small, making them easy and quick to catch.
Baby_Chick.intro: Baby Chick is a Limited fish found in any body of water during the Easter 2 event.

Baby_Lovestorm_Turtle.description: A baby variant of the Lovestorm Turtle!
Baby_Lovestorm_Turtle.intro: Baby Lovestorm Turtle is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Mini Lovestorm Admin Event.

Baby_Nessie.description: A cute baby version of the legendary Nessie, with a spooky twist.
Baby_Nessie.intro: Baby Nessie is a Limited fish obtained from Trick-or-Treating during the FischFright 2025 event.

Baby_Oakling.description: An Oakling that seems to have fallen into a lake in the Everturn Forest! It seems pretty docile...
Baby_Oakling.intro: Baby Oakling is an Exotic fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Baby_Pond_Emperor.intro: Baby Pond Emperor is an Exotic fish found in Snowcap Island.
trivia: The shiny variant will play a squeaking noise when interacted with.

Back_Fins.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Bait_Crate.description: A wooden crate with fabric over top to preserve the bait inside. Seemingly lost from a fishing boat of some kind. The bait is still alive and fresh. Therefore, finders keepers?- Opening it might give you an array of common and rare baits!
Bait_Crate.intro: Bait Crate is an Uncommon Crate found in any body of water.

Banana.description: A simple banana, rich in potassium. How did it get in the water?
Banana.intro: Banana is a Secret fish found in the Ancient Isle.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Banana is a reference to the dancing banana from the ' Peanut Butter Jelly Time ' flash animation. When interacted with, it plays a short snippet of the song used in the meme.

Banana_Eel.description: A bright yellow eel curved in a distinct crescent shape, looking suspiciously like peelable tropical fruit.
Banana_Eel.intro: Banana Eel is a Limited fish found in Skycrest.

Banded_Dragonfish.description: A predatory mesopelagic fish featuring dark vertical bands and a barbel used for luring prey.
Banded_Dragonfish.intro: Banded Dragonfish is an Unusual fish found at Outer Deep of The Deep.

Banded_Snailfish.description: A striking snailfish variant featuring distinct dark rings around its translucent body.
Banded_Snailfish.intro: Banded Snailfish is a Mythical fish found at Lower Deep of The Deep.

Banditfish.description: Banditfish are insanely fast hunters and swimmers, hence their name. They have a single rudder-like fin at the back of their bodies, which they move in a swaying motion to glide throughout the waters. Despite being remarkably good at hunting smaller prey, they are still no match for the greater creatures within the Desolate Deep.
Banditfish.intro: Banditfish is a Rare fish found in the Desolate Deep.

Barbed_Shark.description: The Barbed Shark, a fierce apex predator within the Desolate Deep, is not a fish to be messed with. When they bite on to a hook, they put up a fierce fight, but give a great reward due to the valuable materials that make up their many scales.
Barbed_Shark.intro: Barbed Shark is a Legendary fish found in the Desolate Deep.

Barbed_Spearhead.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Barracuda.description: Barracudas are large predatory fish, known for their fearsome appearance and ferocious behaviour. The barracuda is an adept saltwater hunter and are commonly mistaken as a hazard towards humans, when in reality they are reletively comfortable and friendly swimmers. They can be found in deep oceans, and near Moosewood.
Barracuda.intro: Barracuda is an Uncommon fish found in the Ocean.

Barracuda%27s_Spine.intro: Barracuda's Spine is a Limited fish found in Moosewood during the Archaeological Hunt event.

Barreleye_Fish.description: A transparent fish with a dome-shaped head and large, upward-facing eyes, adapted for deep waters with it's [ sic ] 3 eyes. The third eye has a similar effect that night-vision goggles have, giving it full 20/20 vision, even in the darkest of waters.
Barreleye_Fish.intro: Barreleye Fish is a Mythical fish found in The Depths of Vertigo.

Basalt.description: Basalt, also known as Lava Rock, is an igneous volcanic rock that forms when molten lava cools and solidifies. Very common to find when in a volcanic area.
Basalt.intro: Basalt is Trash found while fishing in lava.

Basalt_Loach.description: A hardy bottom-dweller that blends perfectly with volcanic rock. Its dark coloration helps it ambush prey in the dimly lit lava tubes.
Basalt_Loach.intro: Basalt Loach is a Common fish found in Scoria Reach.

Basalt_Pike.description: A rugged fish, its form dark and unyielding as stone forged in fire.
Basalt_Pike.intro: Basalt Pike is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Basic_Diving_Gear.intro: The Basic Diving Gear is a diving gear equipment that can be used to aid in swimming and breathing underwater.

Basic_Oxygen_Tank.intro: The Basic Oxygen Tank is an oxygen tank equipment that allows the player to breathe for longer. This oxygen tank is the most basic and is only recommended to be used until the player reaches the camp with the Beginner Oxygen Tank.

Basic_Present.description: A nice christmas present wrapped in white and red gift paper. Maybe it has some goodies inside!
Basic_Present.intro: Basic Present is a Limited Crate found in the Winter Village during the Fischmas 1 event.

Basketback_Tortoise.description: Carries a woven, basket-like shell said to collect lost eggs drifting through the tides. Slow-moving, but always seems to know where easter eggs wash ashore.
Basketback_Tortoise.intro: Basketback Tortoise is a Limited fish found in Easter 2.

Batfish.description: A strangely shaped fish with elongated fins that resemble wings.
Batfish.intro: Batfish is a Common fish found in Coral Bastion.

Battery_Casing.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Battlescarred_Serpent.description: A scarred serpentine fish that bears the marks of countless battles in the Atlantean Storm. Its damaged fins only seem to make it faster and more aggressive.
Battlescarred_Serpent.intro: Battlescarred Serpent is a Limited fish found in the Atlantean Storm during the Olympian Storm event.

Bauble_Bass.description: Bass shaped like a dangling bauble. Rolls around, shiny and dizzy.
Bauble_Bass.intro: Bauble Bass is a Limited fish found in the Glacial Ridge during the Fischmas 2 event.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Bauble Bass resembles a Christmas ornament.

Beach_Crate.description: A beachy wooden crate with patterned fabric over top to preserve the bait inside. It looks like it drifted ashore after a long walk at the beach! Opening it might reveal an assortment of sunny, seaside baits!
Beach_Crate.intro: Beach Crate is a Limited Crate found in the Fischfest 1 island.

Beach_Radio.description: Tuned to the only station that plays 24/7 tropical beats and seagull gossip. Turn it up and the whole beach starts swaying. Warning: may cause involuntary limbo.
Beach_Radio.intro: Beach Radio is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Beach_Towel.description: A towel; the most useful item in the universe. Always ready to dry off or claim your spot on the sand.
Beach_Towel.intro: Beach Towel is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Beached_Relic.description: A relic that hums with beached energy. Smells faintly of sand and secrets.
Beached_Relic.intro: Beached Relic is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Beamtail_Koi.description: A graceful koi whose tail trails light like a streaming ribbon.
Beamtail_Koi.intro: Beamtail Koi is an Uncommon fish found in Apollo's Song of Light.

Bearded_Toadfish.description: A whiskered, elusive toadfish blending into rocky crevices.
Bearded_Toadfish.intro: Bearded Toadfish is an Extinct fish found in Whale Interior.

Bee.description: A cute little bee that took a break in some honey.
Bee.intro: Bee is a Legendary fish found in the Nectar Den.

Beginner_Oxygen_Tank.intro: The Beginner Oxygen Tank is an oxygen tank equipment that acts as a direct upgrade from the Basic Oxygen Tank, allowing the player to breathe for longer. This oxygen tank is only recommended to be used until the player reaches the camp with the Intermediate Oxygen Tank.

Bellfin.description: Fish with jingly bell fins. Rings every time it flops in panic.
Bellfin.intro: Bellfin is a Limited fish found in the Glacial Ridge during the Fischmas 2 event.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Bellfin resembles a gong. When interacted with, it plays a gong sound effect.

Bellona_Sword.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Beluga.description: A sociable white whale with a rounded forehead, typically known for its vocal chirps and playful personality.
Beluga.intro: Beluga is an Apex fish found in the Ocean during Narwhal Hunts.

Bent_Harpoon.description: An ancient metal harpoon head, twisted and rusted beyond repair by immense ocean pressure.
Bent_Harpoon.intro: Bent Harpoon is a Trash fish found at Lower Deep of The Deep.

Bestiary.intro: The Bestiary is a starter item which keeps a detailed record of all Fish and Fishing Rods in the game. It can be opened by pressing H.

Bigeye_Houndshark.description: A slender shark with enormous eyes for hunting in dim light.
Bigeye_Houndshark.intro: Bigeye Houndshark is an Unusual fish found in Collapsed Ruins.

Bigeye_Trevally.description: A powerful, silvery predator with large eyes, hunting in schools.
Bigeye_Trevally.intro: Bigeye Trevally is an Unusual fish found in Coral Bastion.

Bigfin_Squid.description: A unique black squid with absurdly long, thin tentacles and light teal accents.
Bigfin_Squid.intro: Bigfin Squid is an Extinct fish found in the Open Ocean.

Bigspine_Spookfish.description: A ghost shark variant featuring a prominent venomous spine situated in front of its dorsal fin.
Bigspine_Spookfish.intro: Bigspine Spookfish is a Rare fish found at Lower Deep of The Deep.

Birgeria.description: Birgeria is a genus of extinct fish from the Late Triassic period, recognized for its large size and long, slender body. It was a carnivorous predator that roamed ancient seas, hunting smaller fish and invertebrates.
Birgeria.intro: Birgeria is an Unusual fish found in the Ancient Archives.

Birthday_Cake.description: Seems to be a cake, but why is there a Sea Bass in it? Someone call the chef!
Birthday_Cake.intro: Birthday Cake is a Limited fish found in any body of water during the Anniversary event.
trivia: Catching the Birthday Cake rewards the player with the " 🎂 " title.

Birthday_Dumbo_Octopus.description: A dumbo octopus in party mode, every puff sounds like a party horn!
Birthday_Dumbo_Octopus.intro: Birthday Dumbo Octopus is a Limited fish found in Birthday Megalodon Hunts during the Anniversary event.

Birthday_Gift.description: A wrapped present with paper tearing at the corner... is that a Fisch toy peeking out?
Birthday_Gift.intro: Birthday Gift is a Limited fish found in any body of water during the Anniversary event.
trivia: Catching the Birthday Gift rewards the player with the " 🎁 " title.

Birthday_Goldfish.description: A goldfish... but baked into cake form? Let's try not to eat our friend!
Birthday_Goldfish.intro: Birthday Goldfish is a Limited fish found in Birthday Megalodon Hunts during the Anniversary event.

Birthday_Megalodon.description: Even a Megalodon deserves cake; this one came smiling for Fisch's birthday!
Birthday_Megalodon.intro: Birthday Megalodon is a Limited fish that was found in Birthday Megalodon Hunt during the Anniversary event.
trivia: Catching the Birthday Megalodon rewards the player with the " 🎉🦈 " title.

Birthday_Squid.description: A squid dressed for the party, with a balloon in its clutch. Give it a poke and it bursts into confetti!
Birthday_Squid.intro: Birthday Squid is a Limited fish found in Birthday Megalodon Hunts during the Anniversary event.

Black-mouth_Beardfish.description: Characterized by a pair of long hyoid barbels hanging from its dark lower jaw.
Black-mouth_Beardfish.intro: Black-mouth Beardfish is an Uncommon fish found at Lower Deep of The Deep.

Black_Dragon_Fish.description: A menacing fish with sharp fins and an eerie, black-scaled body.
Black_Dragon_Fish.intro: Black Dragon Fish is a Rare fish found in The Depths of Vertigo.

Black_Ghost_Knifefish.description: An electric-sensing nocturnal fish, gliding like a shadow.
Black_Ghost_Knifefish.intro: Black Ghost Knifefish is a Rare fish found in the Lost Jungle.

Black_Grouper.description: A shadowy behemoth lurking in wintry depths.
Black_Grouper.intro: Black Grouper is an Extinct fish found in Gilded Arch.

Black_Iron_Bucket.intro: Black Iron Bucket is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Semi Chaos, MADNESS, Skies of Anguish, MAYHEM, MEGA MAYHEM, and Pure Chaos Admin Events.

Black_Snoek.description: A long, slender predatory fish with a pointed snout and dark coloration.
Black_Snoek.intro: Black Snoek is a Legendary fish found in Crowned Ruins.

Black_Swallower.description: A black fish with a large belly and blurple fins, swallowing more than it should.
Black_Swallower.intro: Black Swallower is an Extinct fish found in the Open Ocean.

Black_Veil_Ray.intro: Black Veil Ray is a Limited fish found in the Crypt of the Green One.

Blackcap_Basslet.description: A striking deep-reef basslet boasting a brilliant royal magenta body topped with a sharp jet-black head cap.
Blackcap_Basslet.intro: Blackcap Basslet is a Rare fish found in Skycrest.

Blackfin_Barracuda.description: A sleek, torpedo-shaped predator with jet-black fins and razor teeth.
Blackfin_Barracuda.intro: Blackfin Barracuda is a Legendary fish found in Collapsed Ruins.

Blackfin_Icefish.description: A pale, translucent fish adapted to freezing Antarctic waters.
Blackfin_Icefish.intro: Blackfin Icefish is an Uncommon fish found in Collapsed Ruins.

Blackfish.description: Blackfish are small, black, nighttime swimmers that can be most commonly found in the cold the rocky waters of Snowcap Pond.
Blackfish.intro: Blackfish is an Uncommon fish found in Snowcap Island.

Blackmouth_Catshark.description: A small shark with a distinctive black interior to its mouth.
Blackmouth_Catshark.intro: Blackmouth Catshark is a Mythical fish found in Crowned Ruins.

Blackspot_Tuskfish.description: A colorful reef fish with prominent canine teeth and a black spot on its back.
Blackspot_Tuskfish.intro: Blackspot Tuskfish is an Unusual fish found in Crowned Ruins.

Bladeback_Perch.description: A perch with a dorsal ridge as sharp as a drawn blade.
Bladeback_Perch.intro: Bladeback Perch is an Uncommon fish found in the Bellona's Frenzy of War.

Blarney_McBreeze.description: A sleek blue fish that rides warm currents, its scales sparkle like shamrocks. A St. Patrick's breezy delight!
Blarney_McBreeze.intro: Blarney McBreeze is a Limited fish found within blue-colored abundances during the Lucky Event.

Blazebelly.description: A dark fish, its underbelly and fins pulsing with inner warmth.
Blazebelly.intro: Blazebelly is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Blazed_Handle.intro: FischFright (2025) is the Halloween-themed annual event that occured during 2025 which lasted from October 18, 2025 - November 3, 2025. It featured the Crook's Hallow, new NPCs with unique quests and new Event fishes.

Blight_Idol.description: A cursed idol pulsing with blight energy. Touching it spreads rot instantly.
Blight_Idol.intro: Blight Idol is a Secret fish found in the Toxic Grove.

Blight_Pufferfish.description: Puffs up with blight spores when threatened, releasing a toxic cloud that withers nearby plants.
Blight_Pufferfish.intro: Blight Pufferfish is an Uncommon fish found in the Toxic Grove.

Blind_Swamp_Eel.description: An elongated, blind swamp eel from Mexican cave systems, burrowing in muddy substrates.
Blind_Swamp_Eel.intro: Blind Swamp Eel is an Unusual fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Blinking_Egg.intro: Blinking Egg is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Egg Horde Admin Event.

Blisterback_Blenny.description: A colossal fish with jagged, obsidian fins and an inner fire that lights up its body. It is said to be faster than a tsunami.
Blisterback_Blenny.intro: Blisterback Blenny is a Mythical fish found in Volcanic Vents of Mariana's Veil.

Blistered_Eel.description: Despite blistering skin, the Blistered Eel is capable of withstanding extreme temperatures.
Blistered_Eel.intro: Blistered Eel is a Limited fish found in Roslit Bay 's saltwater during the Ashfall event.

Blisterfish.description: A relentless survivor that thrives where others falter.
Blisterfish.intro: Blisterfish is a Common fish found in The Cursed Shores.

Blizzard_Totem.intro: Totems are a type of consumable item which allows the player to manipulate Weather and start Localized Events. There are currently 28 totems in Fisch, with 2 of them being unobtainable.

Blobfish.description: A blobfish is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives in deep waters, with a unique, squishy structure that helps it float effortlessly without expending much energy. Makes for a great best friend!
Blobfish.intro: Blobfish is an Exotic fish found in the Ocean.

Blobfish_School.intro: Blobfish School is an Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

Bloodfang_Barracuda.description: A vicious barracuda with long crimson-stained fangs and a brutal lunge.
Bloodfang_Barracuda.intro: Bloodfang Barracuda is a Legendary fish found in the Bellona's Frenzy of War.

Bloodied_Aegis_Shard.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Bloodscript_Eel.description: Slithering through scarlet currents, the Bloodscript Eel etches itself within the veins of the unwary.
Bloodscript_Eel.intro: Bloodscript Eel is a Limited fish found within the Cults Curse event.

Bloom_Sprout.description: A sprouting fish that grows mini-blooms on its fins. Perfect for garden aquariums.
Bloom_Sprout.intro: Bloom Sprout is a Common fish found in Living Garden.

Bloom_Totem.intro: Totems are a type of consumable item which allows the player to manipulate Weather and start Localized Events. There are currently 28 totems in Fisch, with 2 of them being unobtainable.

Bloomback_Turtle.description: Its back is covered in soft, velvet-like blooms that release calming pollen.
Bloomback_Turtle.intro: Bloomback Turtle is a Rare fish found in Living Garden.

Bloomfin_Trout.description: A trout whose fins bloom with fresh spring flowers, perfectly camouflaged among forest flora.
Bloomfin_Trout.intro: Bloomfin Trout is an Uncommon fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Bloomtail.description: A dark blue fish with light blue fins, its tail blooming like a lagoon flower.
Bloomtail.intro: Bloomtail is an Extinct fish found in the Azure Lagoon.

Bloop_Cosmetic_Crate.intro: Bloop Cosmetic Crate is a Secret fish that can be caught during certain Admin Events or as a rare drop from Personal Aquarium.

Bloop_Fish.description: A colossal, elusive deep-sea creature said to dwell in the lightless abyss of the ocean, surfacing only when the water is deathly still. Its presence heralded by a haunting, low-frequency sound that rattles sonar equipment and stirs ancient maritime fears.
Bloop_Fish.intro: Bloop Fish is an Apex fish found during Bloop Fish Hunts.

Bloop_Whistle.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Bloxy_Cola.description: Warning: Bloxy Cola may be habit-forming.
Bloxy_Cola.intro: Bloxy Cola is a Special fish found in any body of water during the MEGA MAYHEM and Food Admin Events.

Blue_Conch.intro: Fischfest 2 is a summer-themed Event which lasts from June 20th until September 5th, 2026. The event features a new island which can be accessed through the use of the Magical Conch, several NPCs, and a new 'Sunshells' currency which can be exchanged for limited items.

Blue_Energy_Crystal.description: A blue-hued crystal, told to possess mystical powers.
Blue_Energy_Crystal.intro: Blue Energy Crystal is a Mythical fish found in a cave near the Northern Summit.

Blue_Foamtail.description: A swift swimmer that foams with blue energy.
Blue_Foamtail.intro: Blue Foamtail is an Extinct fish found in Pine Shoals.

Blue_Frightful_Skull.intro: FischFright (2025) is the Halloween-themed annual event that occured during 2025 which lasted from October 18, 2025 - November 3, 2025. It featured the Crook's Hallow, new NPCs with unique quests and new Event fishes.

Blue_Langanose.description: A long fish with a deep blue hue, blending into the icy abyss.
Blue_Langanose.intro: Blue Langanose is an Unusual fish found in Blue Moon events at Snowcap Island.

Blue_Moon_Totem.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Blue_Ribbon_Eel.description: A slender blue eel undulating from cavern burrows, hunting with open jaws.
Blue_Ribbon_Eel.intro: Blue Ribbon Eel is a Rare fish found in the Luminescent Cavern.

Blue_Sea_Slug.description: A tiny blue drifter storing venomous stings, floating in cavern currents.
Blue_Sea_Slug.intro: Blue Sea Slug is a Secret fish found in the Luminescent Cavern.

Blue_Tang.description: The Blue Tang is most renowned for its vivid blue coloration and yellow tail. Often found alongside coral and see anemones inside the reef of Roslit Bay. Best paired with the Clownfish!
Blue_Tang.intro: Blue Tang is an Uncommon fish found in Roslit Bay.

Blue_Whale.description: A massive whale, often seen in cold waters during feeding season.
Blue_Whale.intro: Blue Whale is an Exotic fish found during the Whale Migration event in the Ocean.

Bluefin_Tuna.description: The Bluefin Tuna is a very large and strong species of Tuna. They are highly migratory and can travel extremely long distances. Their population is critically low due to overfishing; Making them rarer than other Tuna.
Bluefin_Tuna.intro: Bluefin Tuna is a Rare fish found in the Ocean.

Bluefin_Tuna_School.intro: Bluefin Tuna School is an Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

Bluefish.description: Bluefish are found inside Keepers Altar. They can inhabit some of the powerful keepers power that is present in Keepers Altars water. They are only awake during the day, as the power of the Altar is too much for them to handle during the night.
Bluefish.intro: Bluefish is an Unusual fish found in the Keepers Altar.

Bluegem_Angelfish.description: A glimmering prize from the ocean's hidden vaults.
Bluegem_Angelfish.intro: Bluegem Angelfish is a Common fish found in Treasure Island.

Bluegill.description: A small, round freshwater fish with bright blue and orange hues, easily recognized by its distinct gill spot. It can be found all over the waters of Snowcap.
Bluegill.intro: Bluegill is a Common fish found in Snowcap Island.

Bluehead_Wrasse.description: A swift dart weaving through vibrant coral jungles.
Bluehead_Wrasse.intro: Bluehead Wrasse is an Extinct fish found in Gilded Arch.

Bluelip_Batfish.description: A bizarre bottom-dweller with vivid blue lips, waddling on cavern sands.
Bluelip_Batfish.intro: Bluelip Batfish is a Common fish found in the Luminescent Cavern.

Bluesteel_Egg.description: Heard to be the strongest egg..
Bluesteel_Egg.intro: Bluesteel Egg is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Egg Horde Admin Event.

Boarfish.description: A dark red fish with yellow fins, charging through the currents.
Boarfish.intro: Boarfish is an Extinct fish found in the Open Ocean.

Bog_Lantern_Goby.description: A tiny fish with a large black eyes, looming within the bog's depths.
Bog_Lantern_Goby.intro: Bog Lantern Goby is a Legendary fish found in Blue Moon events at Snowcap Island.

Bog_Skulker.description: A camouflaged scavenger that skulks through the bogs, feeding on toxic debris.
Bog_Skulker.intro: Bog Skulker is a Common fish found in the Toxic Grove.

Bogscale.description: A brown fish cloaked in grassy tendrils, blending into the muddy waters like a living mire.
Bogscale.intro: Bogscale is an Extinct fish found in Lushgrove.

Bombastic_Egg.intro: Bombastic Egg is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Egg Horde Admin Event.

Bone.description: A bone from the remains of a dissolved creature.
Bone.intro: Bones are Trash found in certain bodies of water.

Bone-Plate_Dace.description: A swift sand-swimmer covered in rigid bone plates that protect it from abrasive sand friction.
Bone-Plate_Dace.intro: Bone-Plate Dace is an Uncommon fish found in the Drylands.

Bone_Lanternfish.intro: Bone Lanternfish is a Limited fish found in the Crypt of the Green One.

Boot.description: Who would leave this in an ocean? Seems to be in great condition too. A common boot, must of fallen off of a boat?.. Or Someone must of [ sic ] fallen off of a boat.. Whatever. either way, it's yours now!
Boot.intro: Boots are Trash found in various bodies of water.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Boot resembles the Hermes Boots from Terraria.

Boots.intro: Boots is an Exotic fish found in the Ocean.

Boreal_Man_o%27_War.description: A hydrozoan colony drifting via an icy blue, gas-filled float with long venomous fishing tentacles.
Boreal_Man_o%27_War.intro: Boreal Man o' War is a Mythical fish found in the Astral Observatory - Boreal Hollow.

Borealis_Snapper.description: A vibrant fish with glowing, aurora-like patterns across its scales and frosted fins.
Borealis_Snapper.intro: Borealis Snapper is a Legendary fish found in the Glacial Grotto.

Boulder.description: It’s not a boulder, it’s a-... Nevermind.
Boulder.intro: Boulder is a Divine Secret fish found rarely in Keepers Altar.

Bouncing_Egg.description: This egg just had its first coffee.
Bouncing_Egg.intro: Bouncing Egg is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Egg Horde Admin Event.

Bountiful_Bait_Crate.description: A bountiful wooden crate with Autumn themed fabric over top to preserve the bait inside. It looks like it drifted ashore after a Thanksgiving dinner! Opening it might reveal an assortment of seasonal, delicious baits!
Bountiful_Bait_Crate.intro: Bountiful Bait Crate is a Limited Crate found during Fischgiving 2.

Bowfin.description: The Mudfish, also known as Bowfin, is a resilient, ancient fish species known for its ability to survive in harsh, low-oxygen environments like swamps and muddy waters. They can be found all over Mushgrove Swamp, especially lurking in dense vegetation and during the night.
Bowfin.intro: Bowfin is an Uncommon fish found in Mushgrove Swamp.

Box_of_Chocolate.description: A soggy but inact box of Valentide's chocolates, tempting even underwater creatures!
Box_of_Chocolate.intro: Box of Chocolate is a Limited Crate found in any body of water during the Valentides 2 event.

Brackscale.description: A dirt-brown fish with yellow-green fins, blending into brackish waters.
Brackscale.intro: Brackscale is an Extinct fish found in the Azure Lagoon.

Brainfreeze_Egg.intro: Brainfreeze Egg is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Egg Horde Admin Event.

Breaker_Moth.description: A grey fish with sharp teeth, golden accents, and light purple fins, snapping through the tide.
Breaker_Moth.intro: Breaker Moth is an Extinct fish found at Waveborne.

Bream.description: Breams are school fish with deep bodies, flat sides and a small head. The bream loves worms and is most commonly found in Moosewoods freshwater.
Bream.intro: Bream is a Common fish found in Moosewood.

Brickhorse.description: A majestic seahorse crafted from purple LEGO bricks, elegant and cute.
Brickhorse.intro: Brickhorse is a Limited fish found in LEGO Pools during the LEGO Event.
trivia: The Brickhorse is from LEGO® Set 31158; Product page.

Brighteyes_Egg.description: Lavender is such a cool color
Brighteyes_Egg.intro: Brighteyes Egg is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Egg Horde Admin Event.

Brimstone_Angler.description: A mysterious fish, its fins casting an eerie glow in the mist.
Brimstone_Angler.intro: Brimstone Angler is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Brine_Phantom.description: The Brine Phantom is a hostile predator of the Desolate Deep Brine Pool. They possess several sharp mandibles on the front of their face, which they use to subdue prey. The Brine Phantom inhibits aggressive behaviour towards other creatures that happen to come anywhere close to it.
Brine_Phantom.intro: Brine Phantom is a Legendary fish found in the Desolate Deep 's Brine Pool.

Brine_Shrimp.description: The Brine Shrimp is a small crustacean abundant in the Brine Pool within the Desolate Deep. They possess the ability to adapt and survive within harsh conditions, particularly incredibly salty water like the Brine Pool. They feed on microorganisms during the day, and are at the bottom of the food chain within the Brine Pool.
Brine_Shrimp.intro: Brine Shrimp is an Uncommon fish found in the Desolate Deep 's Brine Pool.

Brine_Sovereign.description: The Brine Sovereign is an extremely lethal variant of the Brine Phantom that manifests exclusively during severe Brine Storms. Its mandibles are elongated and heavily mineralized, stained white from extreme salt saturation, allowing it to shear through bone and hardened shell with little resistance. Unlike lesser phantoms, the Sovereign exerts a subtle osmotic influence on the surrounding brine, causing nearby sediment and debris to drift toward it as through pulled by an unseen current.
Brine_Sovereign.intro: Brine Sovereign is an Exotic fish found in the Desolate Deep 's Brine Pool during a Brine Storm.

Broken_Arrow.description: A splintered arrow lost to time, faintly warm to the touch.
Broken_Arrow.intro: Broken Arrow is a Trash fish found in Apollo's Song of Light.

Broken_Flashlight.description: A corroded plastic flashlight cast off from the surface, long drained of batteries.
Broken_Flashlight.intro: Broken Flashlight is a Trash fish found at Outer Deep of The Deep.

Broken_Gear.description: A shattered mechanical gear, faintly humming with residual energy.
Broken_Gear.intro: Broken Gear is a Trash fish found in Zeus's Thunder of Chaos.

Broken_Phone.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Broken_Scylla.intro: Broken Scylla is a Special fish found in any body of water during the MEGA MAYHEM, MADNESS, and Glitchstorm Admin Events.

Bronze_Corydoras.description: A bottom-dwelling catfish with bronze armor plates.
Bronze_Corydoras.intro: Bronze Corydoras is an Uncommon fish found in the Lost Jungle.

Buccaneer_Barracuda.description: Known for its sharp teeth, the Buccaneer Barracuda lurks near reefs, making it a thrilling catch for the daring.
Buccaneer_Barracuda.intro: Buccaneer Barracuda is an Uncommon fish found in the Forsaken Shores.

Bull_Shark.description: Bull sharks have robust bodies, and an extremely powerful nature. They have a special ability to adapt to both saltwater and freshwater, which is quite rare for sharks. Bull Sharks can be found most commonly near coats, and in freshwaters.
Bull_Shark.intro: Bull Shark is a Legendary fish found in the Ocean.

Bumpy_Snailfish.description: A soft-bodied, gelatinous fish adapted to extreme depths.
Bumpy_Snailfish.intro: Bumpy Snailfish is an Uncommon fish found in the Tidefall.

Bunch_of_Balloons.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Burbot.description: The Burbot is a long, slender freshwater fish with a mottled brown and green appearance, resembling a cross between a catfish and an eel. Burbots are known for being active in colder temperatures, particularly under the ice in Snowcap Pond.
Burbot.intro: Burbot is an Uncommon fish found in Snowcap Island.

Burnt_Betta.description: With fierce intent, the Burnt Betta thrives in molten lava.
Burnt_Betta.intro: Burnt Betta is a Limited fish found in Roslit Bay 's saltwater during the Ashfall event.

Butterfly.description: A delicate butterfly-fish that flutters through petal storms.
Butterfly.intro: Butterfly is a Rare fish found in Living Garden.

Butterflyfish.description: Butterflyfish are vibrant reef fish known for their striking colors and elaborate patterns. They feed and behave similar to other fish found in Roslit Bays coral reef.
Butterflyfish.intro: Butterflyfish is an Uncommon fish found in Roslit Bay.

Cabana_Carp.description: A festive carp clad in bright yellow and white resort cabana stripes, celebrating the season in style.
Cabana_Carp.intro: Cabana Carp is a Limited fish found in the Skycrest.

Cactus-Feeder_Barb.description: A spike-covered fish that congregates near claypan edges to consume fallen cactus needles and pulp.
Cactus-Feeder_Barb.intro: Cactus-Feeder Barb is an Uncommon fish found in the Drylands.

Cake.intro: Anniversary was an Event that lasted from October 5, 2025 - October 6, 2025.

Calcified_Trilobite.description: A petrified, multi-segmented ancient arthropod perfectly preserved within the shifting desert sands.
Calcified_Trilobite.intro: Calcified Trilobite is a Common fish found in the Drylands.

Calm_Gauntlets.intro: The Calm Gauntlets are a gloves equipment that grants +3% Shiny & Sparkling Chance and +25% Luck.

Canary_Seed.description: A seed found from flowers within the Living Garden
Canary_Seed.intro: Canary Seed is a Seed fish found in the Living Garden.

Candle_Carp.description: A carp with a little spin on it, don't hold it for too long.

Candle_of_Compassion.intro: Valentides (2026) was a seasonal event on Fisch which contributed to the 2026 Valentines which lasted from February 7, 2026 - February 21, 2026. It featured a new Event area with new NPCs, unique quests, puzzles and Event fishes.

Candy_Bucket.intro: FischFright (2025) is the Halloween-themed annual event that occured during 2025 which lasted from October 18, 2025 - November 1, 2025. It featured the Crook's Hallow, new NPCs with unique quests and new Event fishes.

Candy_Cane.description: A giant candy cane that swam away from the tree. Sticky hook trouble.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Candy Cane resembles a stick of cinnamon.

Candy_Cane_Carp.description: Candy Cane Carps are an interesting Fischmas fish. They exhibit coloration like that of a candy cane, as well as having a bunch of candy canes sticking out all round their body. They also taste like peppermint!
Candy_Cane_Carp.intro: Candy Cane Carp is a Limited fish found in the Winter Village during the Fischmas 1 event.

Candy_Cane_Cod.description: Cod curved like a candy cane. Sweet on the outside, fishy within.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Candy Cane Cod resembles two candy canes in the shape of a heart. When interacted with, it plays a licking sound effect.

Candy_Corn_Cod.description: It's very similar to a normal cod but this one was candified.

Candy_Fish.description: The Candy Fisch is a vibrant, bright coloured fish, formed from glucose and carbon. Known for their playful nature, and sweet gummy texture. Only can be caught during FischFright.
Candy_Fish.intro: Candy Fish is a Limited fish found in Frightful Pools during FischFright (2024).
trivia: The Candy Fish may be a reference to the Swedish Fish brand of gummy candy.

Canopy_Dartfish.description: A speedy dartfish that zips between hanging vines and leaves in the upper forest waters.
Canopy_Dartfish.intro: Canopy Dartfish is a Common fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Canopy_Tetra.description: A light green fish with yellow fins and a faint blue shimmer, flitting like a leaf in the canopy’s shade.
Canopy_Tetra.intro: Canopy Tetra is an Extinct fish found in Lushgrove.

Captain%27s_Goldfish.description: A mythical, elusive goldfish found beneath waterfalls, said to bring fortune to rare finders.
Captain%27s_Goldfish.intro: Captain's Goldfish is a Mythical fish found in the Forsaken Shores.
trivia: Upon release, Captain's Goldfish became an easy money farm due to its abnormally high catch rate and sell price of ~5k, which was quickly decreased.

Capybass.description: A laid-back fish with a friendly snout, basking in calm waters.
Capybass.intro: Capybass is a Limited fish that was found in Animal Hunts in the Second Sea.

Caramel_Chub.description: You might not want to eat this, yeah it's caramel but I would be careful.

Carbon_Crate.description: A large military grade crate, lost from some sort of commercial fishing boat. The date of it's disappearance is unknown. Therefore, finders keepers?- Opening it might give you an array of fish, bait, and money!
Carbon_Crate.intro: Carbon Crate is a Rare Crate found in any body of water.

Cardinal_Studfish.description: A striking black & white fish with LEGO studs, resembling a cardinal's vibrant crest.
Cardinal_Studfish.intro: Cardinal Studfish is a Limited fish found in LEGO Pools during the LEGO Event.
trivia: The Cardinal Studfish is from LEGO® Set 31158; Product page.

Cardinal_Tetra.description: A tiny fish with a full crimson belly and a shining stripe.
Cardinal_Tetra.intro: Cardinal Tetra is a Common fish found in the Lost Jungle.

Carol_Carp.description: Carp that hums carols underwater. Sings while it swims away.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Carol Carp adds a Santa hat to the fish. When interacted with, it plays a short snippet of the song 'Hark! The Herald Angels Sing.'

Carp.description: Carps are freshwater fish that are known for their whisker-like barbels around their mouth. Carps can adapt to plenty of different environments, as they can thrive in various water conditions. Due to their resilience, they are a common choice for stocking man-made ponds and lakes! They are also pretty cute, in my opinion.
Carp.intro: Carp is an Uncommon fish found in Moosewood.
trivia: When caught with the Shiny attribute, this fish will take the appearance of Magikarp from the Pokémon series.

Carrot_Eel.description: A graceful eel with light-brown skin and green bands, gliding smoothly.
Carrot_Eel.intro: Carrot Eel is an Uncommon fish found in Carrot Garden.

Carrot_Goldfish.description: A shy goldfish with a soft carrot glow and green sprouts, drifting in the murk.
Carrot_Goldfish.intro: Carrot Goldfish is a Common fish found in Carrot Garden.

Carrot_Minnow.description: A zippy minnow with a grubby sheen and sprouting streaks, flashing through the soil.
Carrot_Minnow.intro: Carrot Minnow is an Uncommon fish found in Carrot Garden.

Carrot_Pufferfish.description: A cute pufferfish with carrot-dusted scales and green fins, puffing in the roots.
Carrot_Pufferfish.intro: Carrot Pufferfish is a Common fish found in Carrot Garden.

Carrot_Salmon.description: A lively salmon with dirty tones and green flecks, swimming energetically.
Carrot_Salmon.intro: Carrot Salmon is a Rare fish found in Carrot Garden.

Carrot_Shark.description: A grand shark with a dusty carrot sheen and a growing sprout, cruising the gardens.
Carrot_Shark.intro: Carrot Shark is an Exotic fish found in Carrot Garden.

Carrot_Snapper.description: A calm snapper with covered in dirt and natural green highlights, nibbling gently.
Carrot_Snapper.intro: Carrot Snapper is a Mythical fish found in Carrot Garden.

Carrot_Turtle.description: A serene turtle with a natural green shell, ambling peacefully.
Carrot_Turtle.intro: Carrot Turtle is a Legendary fish found in Carrot Garden.

Cataclysm_Carp.description: A carp infested with pure evil!
Cataclysm_Carp.intro: Cataclysm Carp is a Divine Secret fish found rarely in Moosewood.

Catfish.description: The Catfish is a large, whiskered bottom-dweller with a sturdy build and smooth, scale-less skin. Known for its whisker-like barbels, which help it sense food in murky waters of Mushgrove Swamp, the catfish is a resilient and adaptable fish.
Catfish.intro: Catfish is a Rare fish found in Mushgrove Swamp.

Cathulid.description: A fictional eldritch abomination whispering from the cultist depths.
Cathulid.intro: Cathulid is an Exotic fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Cathulith.description: A fictional ancient abomination writhing in cultist shadows.
Cathulith.intro: Cathulith is an Exotic fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Caustic_Starwyrm.description: The Caustic Starwyrm is a colossal storm-born variant of the Spectral Serpent, rarely observed outside the deepest layers of the Brine Pool during a Brine Storm, Its translucent exo-membrane is threaded with star-like bioluminescent nodes that pulse in slow, radial patterns along its body, illuminating vast sections of the abyss as it moves. The brine surrounding the Starwyrm becomes visibly unstable, forming luminous eddies that persist long after it has passed.
Caustic_Starwyrm.intro: Caustic Starwyrm is a Secret fish found in the Desolate Deep 's Brine Pool during a Brine Storm.

Cave_Angel_Fish.description: A waterfall-climbing cave loach from Thai subterranean streams.
Cave_Angel_Fish.intro: Cave Angel Fish is an Exotic fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Cave_Loach.description: A bottom-dwelling loach adapted to cave streams, using barbels to forage in darkness.
Cave_Loach.intro: Cave Loach is a Common fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Celestial_Crab.description: A small benthic crab covered in iridescent mineral deposits resembling star constellations.
Celestial_Crab.intro: Celestial Crab is a Common fish found in the Boreal Hollow.

Celestial_Koi.description: A Celestial koi fish that ancient texts claim once guided lost souls through the depths. Its scales shine with otherworldly light, and its presence causes the surrounding waters to swirl with magical energy.
Celestial_Koi.intro: Celestial Koi is a Mythical fish found in Sunken Depths.

Celestial_Pearl_Danio.description: A tiny freshwater micro-cyprinid adorned with iridescent pearl-like spots and vivid orange fins, native to shallow highland pools.
Celestial_Pearl_Danio.intro: Celestial Pearl Danio is a Common fish found in Skycrest.

Celestial_Waders.intro: The Celestial Waders are a reusable piece of equipment which can be used to increase the player’s movement speed on land.

Cepo%27s_Fragment.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Challenger%27s_Gauntlets.intro: The Challenger's Gauntlets are a gloves equipment that have a chance to briefly freeze the fish whenever it moves.

Chargeback_Bass.description: A rective bass that lashes back with sudden bursts of force.
Chargeback_Bass.intro: Chargeback Bass is an Uncommon fish found in Zeus's Thunder of Chaos.

Charred_Coelacanth.description: A prehistoric, lobe-finned relic that thrives near superheated hydrothermal vents, its thick scales blackened by volcanic ash.
Charred_Coelacanth.intro: Charred Coelacanth is a Rare fish found in Volcanic Vents of Mariana's Veil.

Charybdis.description: A colossal vortex given form; Charybdis devours all who draw near. Said to have once been a goddess cursed to hunger eternally, her swirling maw still consumes ships, storms, and even the sea itself.
Charybdis.intro: Charybdis is an Apex fish found during an Earthquake, and was formerly found anywhere during Continental Drift.

Chasm_Leech.description: A tenacious parasite that drains the life from the abyss.
Chasm_Leech.intro: Chasm Leech is a Mythical fish found in Cursed Isle, and formerly in The Cursed Shores.

Cheezburger.intro: Cheezburger is a Special fish found in any body of water during the MEGA MAYHEM, MADNESS and Food Admin Events.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Cheezburger is a reference to the Space Sandwich Roblox gear.

Chillback_Whitefish.description: A plump fish with a glimmering white body and pale silver fins.
Chillback_Whitefish.intro: Chillback Whitefish is an Unusual fish found in the Glacial Grotto.

Chillfin_Chimaera.description: A ghostly fish with glowing fins and a long, whip-like frosty tail.
Chillfin_Chimaera.intro: Chillfin Chimaera is a Mythical fish found in the Challenger's Deep of Mariana's Veil.

Chillfin_Herring.description: A sleek fish with a reflective, icy-gray body and frost-tipped fins.
Chillfin_Herring.intro: Chillfin Herring is a Rare fish found in the Cryogenic Canal.

Chillin%27_Crab.description: A crab in a Hawaiian shirt with a tiny drink. Living its best life without a single worry in the world.
Chillin%27_Crab.intro: Chillin' Crab is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Chillshadow_Chub.description: A small fish that blends into the icy shadows of the deep.
Chillshadow_Chub.intro: Chillshadow Chub is an Uncommon fish found in the Challenger's Deep of Mariana's Veil.

Chinfish.description: The Chinfish is a peculiar species with a distinct chin-like protrusion on its lower jaw. They are sluggish swimmers and are an interesting catch to have on the otherside of your line.
Chinfish.intro: Chinfish is an Uncommon fish found in Sunstone Island.

Chinook_Salmon.description: The Chinook Salmon, also known as King Salmon, are large silver fish with a slightly forked tail and a black mouth. They are highly prized; and are a common target for sport and commercial fishing. The King Salmon are commonly in ocean waters, but during the Autumn they migrate to Terrapin Island to lay eggs.
Chinook_Salmon.intro: Chinook Salmon is an Unusual fish found in Terrapin Island.

Chipped_Crown.description: A battered crown fragment worn smooth by endless currents.
Chipped_Crown.intro: Chipped Crown is a Trash fish found in Poseidon's Storm of Floods.

Chlorophage.description: A massive phage that devours chlorophyll, turning vibrant plants to ash in its wake.
Chlorophage.intro: Chlorophage is a Mythical fish found in the Toxic Grove.

Chocolate_Milk_(Item).intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Christmas_Ancient_Kraken.intro: Christmas Ancient Kraken is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Fischmas Day Admin Event.

Christmas_Ancient_Megalodon.intro: Christmas Ancient Megalodon is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Fischmas Day Admin Event.

Christmas_Bloop_Fish.intro: Christmas Bloop Fish is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Christmas Tide and Fischmas Day Admin Events.

Christmas_Kraken.intro: Christmas Kraken is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Fischmas Day Admin Event.

Christmas_Leviathan.intro: Christmas Leviathan is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Christmas Tide and Fischmas Day Admin Events.

Christmas_Megalodon.intro: Christmas Megalodon is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Fischmas Day Admin Event.

Christmas_Mossjaw.intro: Christmas Mossjaw is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Fischmas Day Admin Event.

Christmas_Music_Box.intro: Fischmas 2 was the Christmas-themed annual event that occurred during 2025 from December 13, 2025 - January 3, 2026. It featured a new Event area with new NPCs, unique quests, puzzles and Event fish.

Christmas_Phantom_Megalodon.intro: Christmas Phantom Megalodon is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Fischmas Day Admin Event.

Christmas_Scylla.intro: Christmas Scylla is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Christmas Tide and Fischmas Day Admin Events.

Chronos_Deep_Swimmer.description: These enigmatic fish appear to bend time around them, moving in impossible patterns through the abyss. Their very presence seems to distort the flow of time in ancient ruins.
Chronos_Deep_Swimmer.intro: Chronos Deep Swimmer is an Unusual fish found in Ethereal Abyss.

Chub.description: The Chub is a hardy and adaptable freshwater fish, typically found in Roslit Pond. The Chub is an easy catch for novice anglers and is thankfully a common catch.
Chub.intro: Chub is a Common fish found in Roslit Bay.

Cinder_Carp.description: Despite its small size, the Cinder Carp packs incomprehensible heat.
Cinder_Carp.intro: Cinder Carp is a Limited fish found in Roslit Bay 's saltwater during the Ashfall event.

Cinder_Crystal.description: A crystal only found in the Scoria Mines, not the prettiest but it surely has some value.
Cinder_Crystal.intro: Cinder Crystal is a Gemstone found in Scoria Reach.

Cinder_Dart.description: A swift fish, its long fins trailing like embers in the wind.
Cinder_Dart.intro: Cinder Dart is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Cindercoil_Eel.description: An electric eel that has adapted to Scoria's unique environment, its bio-electricity manifesting as visible sparks of heat. It coils around thermal vents to recharge.
Cindercoil_Eel.intro: Cindercoil Eel is a Legendary fish found in Scoria Reach.

Cladoselache.description: Cladoselache is a sleek, agile predator from the Devonian era, hunting fish and cephalopods.
Cladoselache.intro: Cladoselache is a Common fish found in the Ancient Isle.

Clam.description: The Clam is an interesting fish that is found behind Roslit Bay. They are quite sought after because they yield a valuable pearl once caught. [Contribution by @Johnny_D3pp]
Clam.intro: Clam is an Unusual fish found in Roslit Bay.

Claw_Gill.description: Are these Claws or are they gills? All we know is, these are remains from fish that went extinct long ago...
Claw_Gill.intro: Claw Gill is a Limited fish found in Moosewood during the Archaeological Hunt event.

Claypan_Guppy.description: Despite its name, this rare survivor grows to monumental scale by dominating localized desert oases.
Claypan_Guppy.intro: Claypan Guppy is a Legendary fish found in the Drylands.

Cleansing_Potion.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Clearcast_Totem.intro: Totems are a type of consumable item which allows the player to manipulate Weather and start Localized Events. There are currently 28 totems in Fisch, with 2 of them being unobtainable.

Cloud.intro: Cloud is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Rainstorm Admin Event.

Clout_Carp.description: A typical carp; but it loves feeling popular!
Clout_Carp.intro: Clout Carp is a Limited fish found in Streamer Hideout.

Clover_Carp.description: A carp here to celebrate St. Patrick's, it's  [ sic ] eyes have become clovers!
Clover_Carp.intro: Clover Carp is a Limited fish found in Lucky Gold Abundances during the Shamrock Seas event.

Clown_Brickfish.description: A playful orange fish, with bright black & white blocky patterns.
Clown_Brickfish.intro: Clown Brickfish is a Limited fish found in LEGO Pools during the LEGO Event.
trivia: The Clown Brickfish is from LEGO® Set 31122; Product page.

Clowned_Triggerfish.description: A colorful fish with vibrant patterns, blending into coral shadows.
Clowned_Triggerfish.intro: Clowned Triggerfish is a Common fish found in Castaway Cliffs.

Clownfish.description: The clownfish, known for its vibrant orange and white stripes, is a small, hardy reef dweller. Often found alongside coral and see anemones inside the reef of Roslit Bay. Best paired with the Blue Tang!
Clownfish.intro: Clownfish is an Uncommon fish found in Roslit Bay.

Cluckfin.description: A feathered fish, crowing beneath the waves.
Cluckfin.intro: Cluckfin is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the First Sea.

Clumsy_Smurf.description: A well-meaning Smurf who trips over everything.
