Clumsy_Smurf.intro: Clumsy Smurf is a Limited fish found in the Smurf Movie Event pools.

Coalfin_Darter.description: A quick, energetic fish with fins that shimmer like fresh coal. They dart between thermal vents in large schools, their scales catching the orange glow.
Coalfin_Darter.intro: Coalfin Darter is an Uncommon fish found in Scoria Reach.

Coastal_Crate.description: A crate full of Fischfest goodies. What's inside? Probably a souvenir you'll never use.
Coastal_Crate.intro: Coastal Crate is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Cobalt_Angelfish.description: A sleek fish with deep blue hues, gliding gracefully.
Cobalt_Angelfish.intro: Cobalt Angelfish is an Uncommon fish found in Castaway Cliffs.

Cobia.description: The Cobia is a long fish with dark scales throughout the top half of its body, and a lighter underbelly. The torpedo-shaped structure it possesses allows it to dart towards any prey, or swiftly evade larger predators. They feed on smaller fish during the day, and lurk near cover during the night. Their dark body provides nocturnal camoflauge to stay hidden from any nearby prey or predators.
Cobia.intro: Cobia is a Rare fish found in the Ancient Isle.

Cockatoo_Squid.description: The Cockatoo Squid is an intriguing species of squid. Their bodies are almost entirely translucent and bioluminescent, which they can use to hide from possible predators. They typically leave their hiding spots at night in search of microorganisms to feed on. [Contribution by @Johnny_D3pp]
Cockatoo_Squid.intro: Cockatoo Squid is an Unusual fish found in the Desolate Deep.

Coconut.description: A ripe coconut floating in the ocean, embodying the tropical essence of summer vacations.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Coconut resembles a "Crazy Coconut" drink. When interacted with, it plays a bonk sound effect.

Coconut_Cooler.intro: Fischfest 2 is a summer-themed Event which lasts from June 20th until September 5th, 2026. The event features a new island which can be accessed through the use of the Magical Conch, several NPCs, and a new 'Sunshells' currency which can be exchanged for limited items.

Coconut_Crabstle.description: A massive coconut crab that constructed a fortified sandcastle fortress directly onto its fibrous husk shell.
Coconut_Crabstle.intro: Coconut Crabstle is a Limited fish found in the Skycrest.

Cod.description: Cod are robust, deep-water fish. Best found in the open cold oceans during winter and spring. Cods are a reliable and rewarding catch with substantial size and strong fighting ability.
Cod.intro: Cod is an Uncommon fish found in the Ocean.

Coelacanth.description: The Coelacanth is an ancient fish with a distinctive shape and strong swimming behaviours Known as a 'living fossil,' this fish was thought to be extinct until its rediscovery in 1938. Coelacanths are deep-sea dwellers, often found in underwater caves and steep slopes.
Coelacanth.intro: Coelacanth is a Rare fish found in the Ocean.

Coffin_Crab.description: A crab that hides in coffin-like shells, emerging only to pinch.
Coffin_Crab.intro: Coffin Crab is a Limited fish found from Trick-or-Treating during the FischFright 2 event.

Coin_Piranha.description: A sunken coin, representative of a ferocious piranha.
Coin_Piranha.intro: Coin Piranha is a Rare fish found in Treasure Island.

Coin_Squid.description: A sunken coin, representative of an inky marvel.
Coin_Squid.intro: Coin Squid is an Unusual fish found in Treasure Island.

Coin_Triggerfish.description: A sparkling relic of sunken riches.
Coin_Triggerfish.intro: Coin Triggerfish is a Common fish found in Treasure Island.

Colossal_Ancient_Dragon.description: Its worn fins are etched with cracks like old stone, and barnacle-like growths glimmer faintly across its body. Said to have drifted through the currents since before the first sailors, it moves with patient dignity; a relic of an ocean that has long forgotten its age.
Colossal_Ancient_Dragon.intro: Colossal Ancient Dragon is an Exotic fish found in the Crimson Cavern.

Colossal_Blue_Dragon.description: A breathtakingly massive form of the blue dragon, its wing-like fins ripple like banners as it drifts through the open sea. Though its size is staggering, it moves with a slow, graceful rhythm, glowing softly as if lit from within. Sailors say spotting one is a once-in-a-lifetime event; a fleeting glimpse of living ocean light.
Colossal_Blue_Dragon.intro: Colossal Blue Dragon is an Exotic fish found in the Luminescent Cavern.
trivia: The Colossal Blue Dragon is based on the real world species called Glaucus atlanticus, or the Blue Glaucus. It is a species of small sea slugs that float upside-down near the ocean's surface, with a gas bubble located in its stomach allowing for it to have buoyancy. This is mentioned in the description of the fish, where it is seen by sailors through its brilliant blue shine reflected off from the sun. The average KG listed in-game is heavily inaccurate to the real Blue Glaucus species, as they can't even exceed 100 grams (0.1KG) in weight.

Colossal_Carp.description: A normally peaceful species grown enormous in Poseidon's waters. Their size alone commands respect from other inhabitants.
Colossal_Carp.intro: Colossal Carp is an Uncommon fish found in Atlantis.

Colossal_Dragon_Hunt_Totem.intro: Totems are a type of consumable item which allows the player to manipulate Weather and start Localized Events. There are currently 28 totems in Fisch, with 2 of them being unobtainable.

Colossal_Ethereal_Dragon.description: So faint it seems half made of light, this delicate being drifts like a waking dream. Its body shimmers with shifting colors that fade when touched, as though it exists only in the corner of one's vision; a fleeting illusion of the sea's imagination.
Colossal_Ethereal_Dragon.intro: Colossal Ethereal Dragon is a Secret fish found in the Luminescent Cavern and Crimson Cavern.

Colossal_Nico.intro: Colossal Nico is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Nico Invasion Admin Event.

Colossal_Saccopharynx.description: A large, eel-like fish with a jaw that can unhinge to swallow prey whole.
Colossal_Saccopharynx.intro: Colossal Saccopharynx is an Uncommon fish found in the Abyssal Zenith of Mariana's Veil.

Colossal_Squid.description: The Colossal Squid is a massive, deep-sea creature with enormous tentacles and large appetite for anglers. Known for its incredible size and strength, it lurks in the deepest parts of the ocean, only occasionally venturing near the surface during the nights.
Colossal_Squid.intro: Colossal Squid is a Mythical fish found in the Ocean.
trivia: It is possible that the Colossal Squid's existence in Snowcap's surrounding ocean is a reference to real-world colossal squids being theorised to exist in the waters surrounding Antarctica.

Colossus_Reef_Titan.description: A mythical, extra collosal creature that is part of the reef itself. Its movements cause tremors, and its size defies belief.
Colossus_Reef_Titan.intro: Colossus Reef Titan is a Secret fish found in the Coral Bastion during a Colossus Reef Titan Hunt.

Column_Crawler.description: These agile fish have adapted to life among the ethereal columns. Their flattened bodies allow them to slip through the narrowest gaps in the mysterious structures.

Dreamer%27s_Amulet.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Dreaming_Aberration.description: A twisted nightmare that defies the waking world.
Dreaming_Aberration.intro: Dreaming Aberration is an Exotic fish found in the Cursed Isle, and formerly in The Cursed Shores.

Drift_Claw.description: A darker red fish with vivid bright red accents, lurking like a crimson shadow in the currents.
Drift_Claw.intro: Drift Claw is an Extinct fish found at Waveborne.

Driftfin.description: A dirt-colored fish with sleek black fins, drifting silently with the current.
Driftfin.intro: Driftfin is an Extinct fish found in the Isle of New Beginnings.

Drifting_Gildfin.description: A wanderer that drifts with gilded grace.
Drifting_Gildfin.intro: Drifting Gildfin is an Extinct fish found in Pine Shoals.

Driftwood.description: A wood that has been washed up onto the shore by the tides. Could be great for a crafts project!
Driftwood.intro: Driftwood is Trash found in certain bodies of water.

Drill.intro: The Drill is a Reusable Item that can be used to break rocks around Roslit Bay and Mariana's Veil to obtain parts used to construct and upgrade the Submarine.
trivia: The drill uses sounds from Subnautica's Prawn Suit.

Dripstone.description: A giant piece of slate that fell from the roof of Tidefall, nobody knows how a rod could ever pick this up...
Dripstone.intro: Dripstone is a Trash fish found in the Tidefall.

Dripstone_Collapse_Totem.intro: Totems are a type of consumable item which allows the player to manipulate Weather and start Localized Events. There are currently 28 totems in Fisch, with 2 of them being unobtainable.

Duckfin_Tuna.description: A quacking tuna with webbed fins, paddling through the deep.
Duckfin_Tuna.intro: Duckfin Tuna is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the First Sea.

Dumbo_Octopus.description: The Dumbo Octopus is a deep-sea dweller, named for its ear like fins that resemble the ears of Disney's famous elephant character. With a soft, gelatinous body and gentle movements, it glides through the oceans and coral reefs of Roslit Bay.
Dumbo_Octopus.intro: Dumbo Octopus is a Legendary fish found in Roslit Bay.

Dune_Boots.intro: The Dune Boots are a reusable piece of equipment which can be used to increase the player’s movement speed on sand.

Dune_Goggles.intro: The Dune Goggles are a reusable piece of equipment which can be used to increase the player’s vision during a Dust Storm.

Dune_Relic.description: An immortal stone filled with the essence of a Divine Lantern Keeper.. Returning it to it's throne under the Statue of Sovereignty will result in your currently equipped rod being blessed with, uh, sand?
Dune_Relic.intro: Dune Relic is a Relic found in the Drylands.

Dune_Thread.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Dunkleosteus.description: The Dunkleosteus is a large predatory fish, bearing an armored skull and jaw. Its reinforced exoskull gives it the ability to easily crush any prey to bits. They went extinct around 360 million years ago, during the Late Devonian period.
Dunkleosteus.intro: Dunkleosteus is a Legendary fish found in the Ancient Isle.

Duskbriar_Gar.description: A gar with thorny briars and dusky scales, hunting as twilight settles over the forest.
Duskbriar_Gar.intro: Duskbriar Gar is a Rare fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Duskscale_Carp.description: A quiet carp with muted scales that darken toward its spine.
Duskscale_Carp.intro: Duskscale Carp is a Common fish found in the Hades' Underworld of Indefinite.

Duskwave_Herring_School.intro: Duskwave Herring School is an Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

Dusky_Blobfish.description: A shadowy blobfish from the deepest trenches of the underworld seas. Its body seems to absorb light around it, leaving a trail of darkness wherever it swims.
Dusky_Blobfish.intro: Dusky Blobfish is a Limited fish found in the Atlantean Storm during the Olympian Storm event.

Dusky_Thread.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Dustscale_Dace.description: Dustscale Dace are small cave fish commonly found around the Enchanted Crevice. Their scales are usually covered in loose stone dust and mineral specks from the breach, making them look for older than they really are..
Dustscale_Dace.intro: Dustscale Dace is a Common fish found in Enchanted Crevice.

Dustveil_Ray.description: A massive flat-bodied ray that glides across underwater cavern floors kicking up thick blinding dust screens.
Dustveil_Ray.intro: Dustveil Ray is a Rare fish found in the Drylands.

Dwarf_Pea_Puffer.description: The world's smallest freshwater pufferfish, possessing independently moving eyes and a feisty, inquisitive nature.
Dwarf_Pea_Puffer.intro: Dwarf Pea Puffer is an Unusual fish found in the Skycrest.

Dweller_Catfish.description: The Dweller Catfish is found near the bottom of the Desolate Brine Pool. They have bright fins and dark scales throughout their whole body, which they use to camouflage from possible predators within the Brine Pool.
Dweller_Catfish.intro: Dweller Catfish is a Rare fish found in the Desolate Deep 's Brine Pool.

Earth_Fragment.description: A magical stone with an etching representing the life on planet Earth.
Earth_Fragment.intro: Earth Fragment is a Fragment found in the Ancient Isle.

Easter_Bunny.description: A rare and elusive bunny that appears only during Easter. Said to leave behind colorful eggs wherever it lands, then vanish without a trace.
Easter_Bunny.intro: Easter Bunny is a Limited fish found any body of water during the Easter 2 event.

Echo_Fisher.description: These clever fish use echolocation to navigate the darkest corners of the abyss. Their clicking sounds bounce off the ancient walls in patterns that some say form words in the old tongue.
Echo_Fisher.intro: Echo Fisher is an Uncommon fish found in Ethereal Abyss.

Echo_Koi.description: A long fish with strange light blue whiskers and fins, its dark blue accents whispering secrets of the deep.
Echo_Koi.intro: Echo Koi is an Extinct fish found in Lushgrove.

Eclipse_Totem.intro: Totems are a type of consumable item which allows the player to manipulate Weather and start Localized Events. There are currently 28 totems in Fisch, with 1 of them being unobtainable.

Ectoplasm_Eel.description: An eel made of glowing ectoplasm, slippery and supernatural.
Ectoplasm_Eel.intro: Ectoplasm Eel is a Limited fish found from fishing in Crook's Hallow during the FischFright 2025 event.

Edestus.description: A bizarre, scissor-jawed predator of ancient oceans.
Edestus.intro: Edestus is a Limited fish found in the Jurassic Island.

Eel.description: Eels are a long snake-like, ray-finned fish that is primarily nocturnal. They have a keen sense of smell and can be harmful to humans due to their strong jaws with sharp teeth. Some eels also contain toxins that will destroy red blood cells. Eels move in an interesting way due to them not having pelvic or pectoral fins. To swim, eels generate waves that travel the length of their body, animating them similar to snakes.
Eel.intro: Eel is an Unusual fish found in Moosewood.

Eelpout.description: The Eelpout is an elongated, eel-like fish with a large head, dwelling on the bottom in cold marine waters.
Eelpout.intro: Eelpout is an Unusual fish found in Boreal Pines.

Eerie_Relic.description: A stone filled with the blessing of the Werewolf King. Returning it to its throne under the Statue of Sovereignty will result in your currently equipped rod being engulfed in its power.
Eerie_Relic.intro: Eerie Relic is a Limited Relic obtained from the Flying Dutchman and Trick-or-Treating during the FischFright 2025 event.

Egg_Basket.intro: Easter 2 was the Easter-themed annual event that occurred during 2026 which lasted from April 4th, 2026 - April 18th, 2026. It featured the Egg Hunt quest, with its own milestone rewards, various eggs scattered throughout the map in-game, Easter Cove island, the Bloom Bunny NPC, and Event fish.

Elder_Mossjaw.description: Older than memory, the Elder Mossjaw is whispered of in fearful stories. It has a moss-draped hide, and its eyes gleam with a cruel, ancient intelligence. To face it is to face the jungle's oldest terror.
Elder_Mossjaw.intro: Elder Mossjaw is a Secret fish found in Elder Mossjaw Hunts.
trivia: Catching the Elder Mossjaw rewards the player with the Elder Slayer title.

Eldran%27s_Amulet_Fragment.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Eldritch_Horror.description: A being whose very existence defies comprehension. Its body seems to exist in multiple dimensions at once, making it difficult to perceive or understand.
Eldritch_Horror.intro: Eldritch Horror is a Rare fish found in Atlantis.

Eldritch_Spineback.description: Ancient and wrecked, the Eldritch Spineback lurks, with jagged spines whispering secrets of the forgotten age.
Eldritch_Spineback.intro: Eldritch Spineback is a Limited fish found within the Cults Curse event.

Electric_Blue_Seahorse.description: A vibrant blue seahorse clinging to cavern corals, swaying in glowing currents.
Electric_Blue_Seahorse.intro: Electric Blue Seahorse is a Mythical fish found in the Luminescent Cavern.

Electric_Eel.description: A long eel capable of delivering dangerous electric shocks.
Electric_Eel.intro: Electric Eel is a Legendary fish found in the Lost Jungle.

Elf_Eel.description: Slippery elf eel in pointy hat. Makes toys while tying your line in knots.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Elf Eel adds a belt buckle to the fish and replaces its hat with an Elf hat.

Ember_Catfish.description: A faintly glowing body with whiskers that spark indefinitely, the Ember Catfish is a peculiar fish.
Ember_Catfish.intro: Ember Catfish is a Limited fish found in Roslit Bay 's saltwater during the Ashfall event.

Ember_Perch.description: The Ember Perch is a lava swimming fish with a resemblance to the fresh water 'Perch'. The Ember Perch is acute in volcanic habitats due to their thick skin and ability to turn coal and carbon into a food source.
Ember_Perch.intro: Ember Perch is an Unusual fish found in the Volcano in Roslit Bay.

Ember_Snapper.description: The Ember Snapper is a lava swimming fish with a resemblance to the salt water 'Red Snapper'. The Ember Snapper is acute in volcanic habitats due to their thick skin and strong dorsal fins.
Ember_Snapper.intro: Ember Snapper is an Unusual fish found in the Volcano in Roslit Bay.

Embertail_Eel.description: A small eel with molten stripes that shimmer in the dark. It glows faintly at night.
Embertail_Eel.intro: Embertail Eel is an Uncommon fish found in Volcanic Vents of Mariana's Veil.

Emberwing.description: A shadowed fish, its fins flaring like wisps of flame.
Emberwing.intro: Emberwing is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Emerald_Angelfish.description: A verdant sparkle from a pirate's hoard.
Emerald_Angelfish.intro: Emerald Angelfish is a Common fish found in Treasure Island.

Emerald_Elephantnose.description: A small fish with an elongated nose and emerald-green scales.
Emerald_Elephantnose.intro: Emerald Elephantnose is an Uncommon fish found in the Calm Zone of Mariana's Veil.

Emperor_Angelfish.description: A stunningly vibrant reef fiish with bold blue and yellow stripes.
Emperor_Angelfish.intro: Emperor Angelfish is an Uncommon fish found in Coral Bastion.

Emperor_Jellyfish.description: The Emperor Jellyfish is a very unique and incredibly rare breed of jellyfish, only found in the gloomy waters of the Desolate Deep. They carry around a stalactite in which they use as an offense mechanism against their prey. They are extremely electrifying to the touch, which makes them a menacing catch for most anglers.
Emperor_Jellyfish.intro: Emperor Jellyfish is a Mythical fish found in the Desolate Deep.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Emperor Jellyfish is a reference to King Jellyfish from SpongeBob SquarePants.

Empyrean_Relic.intro: Empyrean Relic is a Relic fish primarily found in Skycrest.

Empyrean_Sunwhale.description: A heavenly whale bathed in blazing gold, vast enough to dim the world around it.
Empyrean_Sunwhale.intro: Empyrean Sunwhale is a Mythical fish found in Apollo's Song of Light during Solar Chorus.

Enchant_Relic.description: A stone filled with the blessing of a Divine Lantern Keeper.. Returning it to it's throne under the Statue of Sovereignty will result in your currently equipped rod being engulfed in its power.
Enchant_Relic.intro: Enchant Relic is a Relic with a low chance to be found when fishing in any location. They are primarily used for applying a random enchantment to any fishing rod.

Endler%27s_Livebearer.description: A vibrant livebearing fish displaying brilliant metallic green, orange, and black streaks across its tiny body.
Endler%27s_Livebearer.intro: Endler's Livebearer is a Common fish found in Skycrest.

Equipment_Bag.intro: The Equipment Bag is a key item used for accessing the player's equippable belongings.

Escolar.description: A fast, waxy-fleshed predator of the deep open ocean.
Escolar.intro: Escolar is an Unusual fish found in Sunken Reliquary.

Essence_of_Starfrost.intro: Fischmas 2 was the Christmas-themed annual event that occurred during 2025 from December 13, 2025 - January 3, 2026. It featured a new Event area with new NPCs, unique quests, puzzles and Event fish.

Essence_of_Winter.intro: Fischmas 2 was the Christmas-themed annual event that occurred during 2025 from December 13, 2025 - January 3, 2026. It featured a new Event area with new NPCs, unique quests, puzzles and Event fish.

Eternal_Frostwhale.description: An ancient behemoth that emerges only during the Golden Tide, its crystalline body seemming to contain an entire frozen cosmos. This legendary creature is said to have witnessed countless celebrations, its presence marking truly special occasions.
Eternal_Frostwhale.intro: Eternal Frostwhale is a Limited fish found in special pools in the Ocean during the Golden Tide event.
trivia: Carbon Meister lost an Eternal Frostwhale on a live stream which is now named the 'Eternal Frostwhale Incident', he lost the fish while using the Rod Of The Exalted One which has a control of 0.15 and 20% resilience. His NPC (Construction Steel) has dialogue that points to this moment.

Eternal_Fuel.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Ethereal_Glass.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Everfrost_Key.intro: Fischmas 2 was the Christmas-themed annual event that occurred during 2025 from December 13, 2025 - January 3, 2026. It featured a new Event area with new NPCs, unique quests, puzzles and Event fish.

Everturn_Cloak.intro: The Everturn Cloak is a suit equipment that decreases Evil Oakling detection range.

Evil_Gurt.intro: Evil Gurt is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Gurt Nightmare Admin Event.

Evil_Sigil.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Exalted_Relic.description: An immortal stone filled with the essence of a Divine Lantern Keeper.. Returning it to it's throne under the Statue of Sovereignty will result in your currently equipped rod being blessed with its immense power.
Exalted_Relic.intro: Exalted Relic is a Relic primarily found when fishing in any location.

Experimental_Salmon.description: Common near Salmon Sockeye are Moosewood for known colours green vibrant red their, habits eggs laying interesting. Colder during such are very seasons Autumn most common, eggs the lay Salmon time as Sockeye is that.
Experimental_Salmon.intro: Experimental Salmon is a Secret fish rewarded for completing the "Extreme Challenge!" from Takeover Challenger during the Takeover Event.

Extra_Colossal_Nico.intro: Extra Colossal Nico is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Nico Invasion Admin Event.

Faberge_Egg.intro: Eggs are a type of item obtainable in Fisch. They can be opened to receive items such as Bait and C$, or more rarely contain unique Egg-exclusive items.

Faceless_Cusk.description: An unusual cusk-eel lacking visible exterior eyes, its nostrils and mouth positioned beneath its bulbous head.
Faceless_Cusk.intro: Faceless Cusk is a Mythical fish found in the Gloomy Crevice.

Fading_Guppy.description: A flickering guppy that seems to slip in and out of existence.
Fading_Guppy.intro: Fading Guppy is a Uncommon fish found in the Hades' Underworld of Indefinite while a Soul Pool is active.

Fairy_Penguin.description: The smallest penguin species, featuring slate-blue plumage and agile underwater diving movements.
Fairy_Penguin.intro: Fairy Penguin is a Mythical fish found in the Snowcap Island - Astral Cavern.

Fangborn_Gar.description: The Fangborn Gar is a vicious Voidwater fish that is completely blind. They roam the waters aimlessly and use a sense of smell to track food in Vertigo Dip.
Fangborn_Gar.intro: Fangborn Gar is an Unusual fish found in Vertigo.

Fangtooth.description: A dark fish with large green eyes and sharp teeth, a menace of the deep.
Fangtooth.intro: Fangtooth is an Extinct fish found in the Open Ocean.

Fern.intro: Fern is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Buffed Overgrowth and Overgrowth Admin Events.

Festive_Bait_Crate.description: A festive wooden crate with patterend fabric over top to preserve the bait inside. Seems like it fell off of santa's sleigh! Opening it might give you an array of jolly baits!
Festive_Bait_Crate.intro: Festive Bait Crate is a Limited Crate found in the Winter Village during the Fischmas 1 event.

Festive_Relic.description: Ancient relic pulsing with festive magic. Older than Santa, twice as mysterious.
Festive_Relic.intro: Festive Relic is a Limited Relic found in the Glacial Ridge during the Fischmas 2 event.

Fillionaire.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Fin_Whale.description: The Fin Whale is a colossal, swift-moving leviathan that patrols the deepest waters in search of dense schools of prey. Though enormous, it is surprisingly elusive, making every encounter a memorable challenge for skilled anglers.
Fin_Whale.intro: Fin Whale is an Exotic fish found in the Ocean.

Firecracker_Crab.description: A crab that snaps like a firecracker — pop, pop, POP!
Firecracker_Crab.intro: Firecracker Crab is a Limited fish found in the Patriotic Seas.

Firecrest.description: A bold fish, its fins sharp and crowned with a fiery gleam.
Firecrest.intro: Firecrest is an Extinct fish found at Emberreach.

Firework.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Fischipedia_Accurate_Pickle.intro: Fischipedia Accurate Pickle is a Special fish found in any body of water during the HEAVENLY SPARKLES and MADNESS Admin Events.
trivia: When interacting with the equipped Fischipedia Accurate Pickle, its iconic line "IM PICKLE RICK!!" is played.
Fischipedia Accurate Pickle is a reference to this wiki, Fischipedia.

Fischversation_Hearts_Box.description: A box of conversation hearts with sweet messages, perfect for rarer Valentides fish!
Fischversation_Hearts_Box.intro: Fischervation Hearts Box is a Limited Crate found in any body of water during the Valentides 2 event.

Fish_Barrel.description: A large wooden barrel with iron hoops. The barrel filled with a large array of ocean and freshwater fish that all seem pretty fresh. Therefore, finders keeps?- Opening it might give you an assortment of fish
Fish_Barrel.intro: Fish Barrel is an Uncommon Crate found in any body of water.

Fish_Radar.intro: The Fish Radar is a reusable item that can be used to show abundances for fish, with the exception of hidden fish abundances.

Flamangler.description: A graceful fish with pink fins and a beak-like snout, wading through coral shallows.
Flamangler.intro: Flamangler is a Limited fish found in Octophant Hunts in the Second Sea.

Flamekissed_Hawkfish.description: A fiery-hued fish darting through warm, shallow reefs.
Flamekissed_Hawkfish.intro: Flamekissed Hawkfish is a Common fish found in Castaway Cliffs.

Flameslasher.description: Below Fischfest Island sleeps a magma serpent older than the ocean. The Flameslasher stirs only once; a cataclysm of molten rock and silent fury, drawn by the heat of the Tropical Sun. Land one hook into its flaming hide, and you will have fished a myth. No one has ever caught it twice.
Flameslasher.intro: Flameslasher is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Flashlight.description: It doesn't seem to turn off...
Flashlight.intro: Flashlight is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Blackout, Semi Chaos, MADNESS, MAYHEM, MEGA MAYHEM, and Pure Chaos Admin Events.

Flimsy_Rod.intro: The Flimsy Rod is a Stage 1 Fishing Rod obtained at the start of the game.
trivia: The design and name of the Flimsy Rod is likely inspired by Animal Crossing: New Horizons item of the same name.
When using this rod, there is an image of a fishing rod above the bar in the fishing minigame.
If one somehow loses their Flimsy Rod, if they attempt to buy the rod from the Merchant at Moosewood, an error will pop up preventing the purchase.
This is the only rod that could catch Limited fish from the First Chamber of the Crypt during The Hunt: Mega Edition.

Flipflopper.description: A flip‑flop that grew eyes and fins. It slaps the water like a disappointed parent.
Flipflopper.intro: Flipflopper is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Flippers.intro: The Flippers are a flippers equipment that can be used to aid in underwater maneuverability.

Floatie_Fugu.description: A pufferfish wearing a floatie. Because safety first, even for the most inflatable of fish.
Floatie_Fugu.intro: Floatie Fugu is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Floppy.description: The Floppy is an interesting fish in the Ancient Isle. Exhibiting signs of intense energy, attempting to catch the Floppy will not be an easy task. They spend most of the day swimming around the pond,
Floppy.intro: Floppy is a Legendary fish found in the Ancient Isle.
trivia: Floppy may be a reference to the ' Flopper ' fish item from the popular battle royale game Fortnite.

Floraseer_Sturgeon.description: A wise sturgeon adorned with living flowers, foreseeing the bloom of spring. Only visible at night.
Floraseer_Sturgeon.intro: Floraseer Sturgeon is a Mythical fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Flounder.description: Flounders are a demersal flatfish- meaning they feed at the bottom of the ocean, and has a flat body to blend in with the seafloor. Both of a flounders eyes are on one side, pointing upwars to the sky. They are easy to find in dark areas with a lot of surface or at night near Moosewood Docks.
Flounder.intro: Flounder is an Unusual fish found in Moosewood.

Flower_Flounder.description: A flat flounder camouflaged as a bed of flowers on the garden floor.
Flower_Flounder.intro: Flower Flounder is an Uncommon fish found in Living Garden.

Flower_Guardian.description: A majestic guardian spirit of the garden, manifesting as a colossal flower beast.
Flower_Guardian.intro: Flower Guardian is an Exotic fish found in the Living Garden.
trivia: The Flower Guardian bears resemblance to the Legendary Pokémon Necrozma

Fluffy_Unicorn.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Flying_Fish.description: The Flying Fish is a unique fish, renowned for their wing-like fins which give them the ability to soar above the ocean's surface. They use this ability to swiftly evade predators as well as dwelling near the surface to find small organisms to feed on.
Flying_Fish.intro: Flying Fish is a Legendary fish found in the Ocean.

Flying_Gurnard.description: A bizarre fish with wing-like pectoral fins that 'walk' on the seafloor.
Flying_Gurnard.intro: Flying Gurnard is a Legendary fish found in Sunken Reliquary.

Flying_Pufferfish.description: A Pufferfish that rose into the skies, and has lived there ever since.
Flying_Pufferfish.intro: Flying Pufferfish is a Rare fish found in Above The Clouds.

Foamcrest_Koi.description: A graceful koi crowned with pale markings like sea foam on a cresting tide.
Foamcrest_Koi.intro: Foamcrest Koi is an Unusual fish found in Poseidon's Storm of Floods.

Foamrunner.description: A light blue fish speckled with bright light blue spots, skimming the surface like sea foam.
Foamrunner.intro: Foamrunner is an Extinct fish found at Waveborne.

Fogstripe.description: A green fish with beige stripes and translucent fins, fading into the mist like a ghostly streak.
Fogstripe.intro: Fogstripe is an Extinct fish found in Lushgrove.

Forbidden_Plesiosaur.description: A prehistoric marine reptile, long-necked and powerful, thought extinct for millions of years.
Forbidden_Plesiosaur.intro: Forbidden Plesiosaur is a Divine Secret fish found rarely in Tidefall.

Formosa_Seabass.description: A robust deep-reef seabass inhabiting rocky slopes far below the photic zone.
Formosa_Seabass.intro: Formosa Seabass is an Unusual fish found at Outer Deep of The Deep.

Forsaken_Algae.intro: Forsaken Algae is a Limited fish found in Algae Hunts during the Golden Tide event.

Fortune_Flounder.description: A flounder composed purely of gold, and covered in diamonds!
Fortune_Flounder.intro: Fortune Flounder is a Limited fish found in Lucky Gold Abundances during the Shamrock Seas event.

Fossil_Fan.description: An ancient, fan-shaped fossil etched with intricate patterns, a true underwater treasure.
Fossil_Fan.intro: Fossil Fan is a Limited fish found in Moosewood during the Archaeological Hunt event.

Four_Eyes_Fish.description: A lilac fish with light purple fins, sporting four curious eyes.
Four_Eyes_Fish.intro: Four Eyes Fish is an Extinct fish found in the Open Ocean.

Four_Leaf_Clover.intro: Shamrock Seas was a seasonal event on Fisch which is a St. Patrick's Day-themed Event which lasted from March 14, 2026 - March 21, 2026. It featured a new Event area with new NPCs, unique quests and Event fish.

Fourhorn_Sculpin.description: The Fourhorn Sculpin is a bottom-dwelling fish with distinctive bony horns on its head, found in Arctic coastal waters.
Fourhorn_Sculpin.intro: Fourhorn Sculpin is an Uncommon fish found in Boreal Pines.

Fractured_Minnow.description: A small fish whose body appears split into offset fragments that barely align.
Fractured_Minnow.intro: Fractured Minnow is a Common fish found in Olympian Fissure.

Frank.intro: Frank is a Special fish found in any body of water during the 67 Warriors and MADNESS Admin Events.

Frankenshrimp.description: A shrimp that was deconstructed and reconstructed in the form of a zombie.

Freezing_Shroom.description: A frost-covered mushroom that thrives in Snowburrow's icy crevices. Its brittle, chilled cap glows faintly under moonlight, often mistaken for a frozen gem by novice anglers.
Freezing_Shroom.intro: Freezing Shroom is Trash found in Snowburrow.

French_Grunt.description: A striped wanderer patrolling warm, shallow reefs.
French_Grunt.intro: French Grunt is an Extinct fish found in Gilded Arch.

Freshwater_Pacu.description: A massive vegetarian relative of the piranha.
Freshwater_Pacu.intro: Freshwater Pacu is an Unusual fish found in Lost Jungle.

Fridge.intro: Fridge is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Semi Chaos, MADNESS, MAYHEM, Snowstorm, MEGA MAYHEM, and Pure Chaos Admin Events.
trivia: The dog on the Fridge is known as the Ropopo dog, aka "The Smirking Dog." This dog is part of a popular meme trend on platforms like TikTok, characterized by humorous videos and catchy phrases associated with dogs.

Friend_Fish.intro: Friend Fish is a Secret fish which can only be caught with the Friendly Rod.
trivia: It is the only fish in the game which is strictly exclusive to a specific rod when catching via normal means.
It is the only fish in the game which can have variations without having a Mutation.

Friendly_Skin_Crate.intro: Skins offer a way to change the appearance of player belongings.

Frightful_Crate.description: A spooky wooden crate with fabric over top to preserve the bait inside. Seems like it came straight from the Pumpkin King. Opening it might give you an array of spooky baits.
Frightful_Crate.intro: Frightful Crate is a Limited Crate found in Crook's Hallow during the FischFright 2025 event.

Frightful_Mirror.intro: FischFright (2025) is the Halloween-themed annual event that occured during 2025 which lasted from October 18, 2025 - November 3, 2025. It featured the Crook's Hallow, new NPCs with unique quests and new Event fishes.

Frightful_Pool_Totem.intro: FischFright (2025) is the Halloween-themed annual event that occured during 2025 which lasted from October 18, 2025 - November 3, 2025. It featured the Crook's Hallow, new NPCs with unique quests and new Event fishes.

Frightful_Relic.description: A stone filled with the blessing of the Pumpkin King. Returning it to its throne under the Statue of Sovereignty will result in your currently equipped rod being engulfed in its power.
Frightful_Relic.intro: Frightful Relic is a Limited Relic obtained from the Flying Dutchman and Trick-or-Treating during the FischFright 2025 event.

Frigid_Antlers.description: Ancient reindeer antlers preserved perfectly in magical ice, still radiating a mysterious energy.
Frigid_Antlers.intro: Frigid Antlers is a Legendary fish found in the Overgrowth Caves.

Frigid_Crab.description: A uniquely adapted crab with a shell that resembles cracked ice.
Frigid_Crab.intro: Frigid Crab is an Unusual fish found in the Overgrowth Caves.

Frigid_Mammoth_Tusk.description: A massive mammoth tusk perfectly preserved in ancient ice, still emanating prehistoric power.
Frigid_Mammoth_Tusk.intro: Frigid Mammoth Tusk is a Mythical fish found in the Frigid Cavern.

Frigid_Shrimp.description: A tiny crustacean whose shell appears to be made of delicate frost crystals.
Frigid_Shrimp.intro: Frigid Shrimp is an Uncommon fish found in the Frigid Cavern.

Frigid_Taco.description: A perfectly preserved taco frozen in magical ice, somehow maintaining its original form.
Frigid_Taco.intro: Frigid Taco is a Rare fish found in the Frigid Cavern.
trivia: The filling of the taco inside appears to only consist of lettuce and beef.
The Shiny variant of the frigid taco is instead unfrozen and plays the song It's Raining Tacos when held out

Frilled_Shark.description: A serpentine predator with a ruffled neck and razor-sharp teeth, ancient and elusive.
Frilled_Shark.intro: Frilled Shark is an Unusual fish found in The Depths of Vertigo.

Frost_Minnow.description: A tiny, silver fish with faint ice-like patterns on its scales.
Frost_Minnow.intro: Frost Minnow is an Uncommon fish found in the Cryogenic Canal.

Frost_Moon_Totem.intro: Fischmas 2 was the Christmas-themed annual event that occurred during 2025 from December 13, 2025 - January 3, 2026. It featured a new Event area with new NPCs, unique quests, puzzles and Event fish.

Frost_Ray.description: A flat, icy creature with wings that ripple like frozen waves.
Frost_Ray.intro: Frost Ray is an Uncommon fish found in Blue Moon events at Snowcap Island.

Frostbite_Flounder.description: A flat fish with an ice-like sheen and speckled, snowflake-shaped patterns across its body.
Frostbite_Flounder.intro: Frostbite Flounder is a Rare fish found in the Glacial Grotto.

Frostbreaker.intro: Fischmas 2 was the Christmas-themed annual event that occurred during 2025 from December 13, 2025 - January 3, 2026. It featured a new Event area with new NPCs, unique quests, puzzles and Event fish.

Frostjaw_Cod.description: A large, muscular fish with icy blue scales and jagged, frozen-like teeth.
Frostjaw_Cod.intro: Frostjaw Cod is a Legendary fish found in the Cryogenic Canal.

Frostling_Goby.description: A tiny, bottom-dwelling fish with a speckled body resembling frost-dusted pebbles.
Frostling_Goby.intro: Frostling Goby is an Uncommon fish found in the Glacial Grotto.

Frostpetal_Minnow.description: A delicate minnow with petals of frost that shimmer in the cold light. It darts between icy roots.
Frostpetal_Minnow.intro: Frostpetal Minnow is a Common fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Frostscale_Fangtooth.description: A small, sharp-toothed fish with icy blue scales that shimmer in the dark.
Frostscale_Fangtooth.intro: Frostscale Fangtooth is a Common fish found in the Challenger's Deep of Mariana's Veil.

Frostwyrm.description: The Frostwyrm is a colossal, dragon-long leviathan that coils through frozen seas, its scales etched with ancient ice. Each surge of its body brings biting cold and unstoppable force, as if the ocean itself bends to its frostbound will.
Frostwyrm.intro: Frostwyrm is an Exotic fish found in Boreal Pines.

Frosty_Turkey.description: Coated in crystalline frost and ice shards, this wintry turkey chills autumn waters with its frosty breath. Thaw the chill for a cool Fischgiving centerpiece!
Frosty_Turkey.intro: Frosty Turkey is a Limited fish found at Snowcap Island during the Fischgiving 2 event.
trivia: The Shiny Frosty Turkey is based on the Developer Sno (@rDevSno).

Frozen_Char.description: A heavily armored freshwater fish whose scales remain slick with a layer of slush and ice.
Frozen_Char.intro: Frozen Char is a Common fish found in the Astral Observatory - Boreal Pines.

Frozen_Fangfish.description: Icy predator with razor fins, feared in frozen depths.
Frozen_Fangfish.intro: Frozen Fangfish is a Limited fish found in the Ocean during the Winter's Edge event.

Frozen_Glass.description: A sheet of observatory glass permanently encrusted in intricate, frost-like ice patterns.
Frozen_Glass.intro: Frozen Glass is a Exotic fish found in the Astral Observatory - Snowcap Island.

Frozen_Leviathan.description: A chilling creature with icy tentacles that can freeze anything it touches. Legends say it guards the deepest parts of the ocean.
Frozen_Leviathan.intro: Frozen Leviathan is an Exotic fish found in the Challenger's Deep of Mariana's Veil.

Frozen_Pike.description: A long and sleek predator fish, its body covered in frost-like patterns and icy fins.
Frozen_Pike.intro: Frozen Pike is a Rare fish found in the Cryogenic Canal.

Frozen_Walnut.description: A prehistoric walnut encased in magical ice, perfectly preserved from the age of giants.
Frozen_Walnut.intro: Frozen Walnut is a Mythical fish found in the Overgrowth Caves.
trivia: The Frozen Walnut is likely a reference to Scrat's Acorn from the Ice Age movie franchise.
Despite its name, the Frozen Walnut resembles an acorn more than a walnut.

Fruitcake_Flounder.description: Dense flounder made of fruitcake. Sinks like a brick, tastes like regret.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Fruitcake Flounder resembles a fruitcake loaf. When interacted with, it plays a chomp sound effect.

Fruity_Abaia.description: A tropical mockery of the great serpent, drawn out by an offering of every limited delicacy at once. Smells faintly of smoothies.
Fruity_Abaia.intro: Fruity Abaia is a Limited fish found in the Skycrest.

Fulmina_Serpent.description: A serpentine creature formed of coiling lightning and fury.
Fulmina_Serpent.intro: Fulmina Serpent is a Legendary fish found in Zeus's Thunder of Chaos.

Fungal_Cluster.description: Offspring of the Giant Fungal Trees of Mushgrove Swamp. These mushrooms produce heavy spores which pollute the surrounding area and sky; giving everything an uncomfortable and green feel.
Fungal_Cluster.intro: Fungal Cluster is Trash found in Mushgrove Swamp.

Furnace_Leaper.description: A robust fish, its fins alight with the heat of hidden flames.
Furnace_Leaper.intro: Furnace Leaper is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

GPS.intro: The GPS is a reusable item that can be used to display the player's positional information.

Gale_Snapper.description: A sleek grey fish adorned with shimmering blue stripes, darting through the shallows like a fleeting gust.
Gale_Snapper.intro: Gale Snapper is an Extinct fish found at Waveborne.

Galleon_Goliath.description: The Galleon Goliath is a mid-sized, slow-moving fish, often found in deeper seas. Uncommon but worth the haul.
Galleon_Goliath.intro: Galleon Goliath is an Uncommon fish found in Forsaken Shores.

Garden_Crab.description: A cute little crab exclusive to the Living Garden; it's holding a flower!
Garden_Crab.intro: Garden Crab is a Legendary fish found in Living Garden.

Garden_Snail.description: A slow-moving snail with a shell adorned in tiny vines. Leaves a trail of fresh dew.
Garden_Snail.intro: Garden Snail is a Common fish found in Living Garden.

Gargantuan_Taco.intro: Gargantuan Taco is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Tacos and MADNESS Admin Event 's.
trivia: When interacted with, the Gargantuan Taco plays a very loud crunching sound that can be heard by other players at a great distance.

Garra_Andruzzii.description: A blind cave barb from Somali phreatic waters, scaleless and depigmented.
Garra_Andruzzii.intro: Garra Andruzzii is a Rare fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Garra_Typhlops.description: A blind cave barb clinging to rocks in Iranian subterranean streams.
Garra_Typhlops.intro: Garra Typhlops is a Legendary fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Gas_Mask.intro: The Gas Mask is a mask equipment that makes the player immune to Poison.

Gazerfish.description: The Gazerfish is a fast-moving prey fish within the Brine Pool of the Desolate Deep. They have a singular large eyeball on the front of their bodies, which they can close to disguise themselves from possible predators during the night. When they are most active during the day, they swim near the surface looking for smaller creatures to feed on.
Gazerfish.intro: Gazerfish is a Common fish found in the Desolate Deep 's Brine Pool.
trivia: This fish has a resemblance to the Peeper from Subnautica.

Gem_Anchovy.description: A tiny jewel of the sea, sparkling like a forgotten coin.
Gem_Anchovy.intro: Gem Anchovy is a Common fish found in Treasure Island.

Gem_Blobfish.description: The blobfish is a sad, squishy lump with the personality of a deflated balloon... Absolutely lovable.
Gem_Blobfish.intro: Gem Blobfish is a Secret fish found in Treasure Island.

Gem_Dolphin.description: A majestic creature, adorned with the ocean's dazzling jewels.
Gem_Dolphin.intro: Gem Dolphin is a Legendary fish found in Treasure Island.

Gem_Eel.description: A slithering sparkle, woven from the sea's hidden treasures.
Gem_Eel.intro: Gem Eel is an Uncommon fish found in Treasure Island.

Gem_Marlin.description: A colossal prize, flashing with the brilliance of deep-sea riches.
Gem_Marlin.intro: Gem Marlin is a Mythical fish found in Treasure Island.

Gem_Salmon.description: A radiant fish shimmering with the glow of buried ocean gems.
Gem_Salmon.intro: Gem Salmon is a Common fish found in Treasure Island.

Gemscale_Mandarinfish.description: A tiny shimmer from the sea's jeweled caches.
Gemscale_Mandarinfish.intro: Gemscale Mandarinfish is an Uncommon fish found in Treasure Island.

Gemstone_Whale_Shark.description: Massive and jewel covered, from the deepest vault.
Gemstone_Whale_Shark.intro: Gemstone Whale Shark is a Mythical fish found in Treasure Island.

Geode_Grouper.description: A heavy benthic reef-dweller whose rocky exterior is embedded with glowing crystal formations.
Geode_Grouper.intro: Geode Grouper is a Rare fish found in Calm Zone of Mariana's Veil.

Ghost.description: A spectral entity, often a deceased person's spirit, lingering in the physical world.
Ghost.intro: Ghost is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Spectral Tide, MADNESS, GHASTLY TIDE, Semi Chaos, MAYHEM, MEGA MAYHEM, and Pure Chaos Admin Events.

Ghost_Elixir.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Ghost_Minnow.description: The ghost minnow, a distant relative to the normal minnow, the only difference is that one is translucent.
Ghost_Minnow.intro: Ghost Minnow is a Limited fish found from fishing in Crook's Hallow during the FischFright 2025 event.

Ghost_Turkey.description: Translucent and eerie, this spectral turkey drifts through waters with haunting gobbles. Catch its ghostly form before it vanishes into your oven!
trivia: The Shiny Ghost Turkey is based on the Developer Lea (@zzomblea).

Ghosts_Skin_Crate.intro: Skins offer a way to change the appearance of player belongings.

Ghoul.description: A malevolent, ghost-like spirit that preys on the living, far more dangerous than a typical ghost.
Ghoul.intro: Ghoul is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Spectral Tide, MADNESS, Semi Chaos, MAYHEM, MEGA MAYHEM, and Pure Chaos Admin Events.

Ghoulfish.description: The Ghoulfish is known for its eerie appearance. They only appear during FischFright season, and are a scary bite to have on the end of your rod.
Ghoulfish.intro: Ghoulfish is a Limited fish found in Frightful Pools during FischFright (2024).

Giant_Grouper.description: A massive reef predator that lurks in caves and shipwrecks.
Giant_Grouper.intro: Giant Grouper is a Rare fish found in the Tidefall.

Giant_Lamprey.description: A monstrous, jawless parasite of Jurassic seas.

Giant_Manta.description: An enormous manta ray blessed by Poseidon's power. Its wingspan can cast shadows over entire sections of the pool, and its movements create powerful currents.
Giant_Manta.intro: Giant Manta is an Unusual fish found in Atlantis.

Giant_Moray.description: A large, sinuous eel with sharp teeth, ruling tropical coral reefs.
Giant_Moray.intro: Giant Moray is an Extinct fish found in the Whale Interior.

Giant_Seadevil.description: A massive, terrifying fish with a glowing lure and teeth as sharp as the finest of blades.
Giant_Seadevil.intro: Giant Seadevil is a Mythical fish found in the Abyssal Zenith of Mariana's Veil.

Gilded_Pearl.description: A golden pearl with a shiny appearance... Could this hold special powers within it...?
Gilded_Pearl.intro: Gilded Pearl is an Unusual fish found in Clams behind Roslit Bay at a 19.58% chance.

Gillicus.description: A small, swift fish from Jurassic oceans.

Gingerbread_Fish.description: A gingerbread cookie that was decorated with frosting and gumdrops to look like a fish. It seems to have come to life. Also makes for a yummy snack!
Gingerbread_Fish.intro: Gingerbread Fish is a Limited fish found in the Winter Village during the Fischmas 1 event.
trivia: One of the catch quips for the Gingerbread Fish is a famous line from ' The Gingerbread Man ' children's poem

Gingerbread_Man.description: Gingerbread man cookie that grew fins. Runs away... by swimming.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Gingerbread Man resembles a gingerbread house. When interacted with, it plays a chomp sound effect.

Ginsu_Shark.description: The Ginsu Shark, a powerful Cretaceous predator, uses sharp serrated teeth and sleek speed to hunt large fish, marine reptiles, and other sharks.
Ginsu_Shark.intro: Ginsu Shark is a Legendary fish found in the Ancient Isle.

Glacial_Bark_Gar.description: An armored gar with bark-like scales infused with glacial ice. It lurks in the deepest forest channels
Glacial_Bark_Gar.intro: Glacial Bark Gar is a Rare fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Glacial_Crab.description: A frosty crustacean with translucent shell plates that resemble carved ice.
Glacial_Crab.intro: Glacial Crab is an Uncommon fish found in the Cryogenic Canal - Astral Cavern.

Glacial_Fragment.description: A shimmering shard of ancient ice, etched with swirling patterns resembling turbulent ocean waves. Rumored to hold the essence of Snowburrow’s frozen seas.
Glacial_Fragment.intro: Glacial Fragment is a Fragment fish found in Snowburrow.

Glacial_Gulper.description: A bathypelagic eel with an enormous expandable pharynx capable of swallowing prey much larger than itself.
Glacial_Gulper.intro: Glacial Gulper is a Rare fish found in Challenger's Deep of Mariana's Veil.

Glacial_Squid.description: The Glacial Squid is a massive deep-sea creature with hooked tentacles, lurking in freezing abyssal waters.
Glacial_Squid.intro: Glacial Squid is a Mythical fish found in Boreal Pines.

Glacial_Sturgeon.description: A massive, ancient fish with icy armor-like scales and a frosted dorsal fin, marking it as one of the oldest species in these waters.
Glacial_Sturgeon.intro: Glacial Sturgeon is a Mythical fish found in the Cryogenic Canal.

Glaciaseer_Sturgeon.description: A massive sturgeon that glows with inner glacial light, said to forsee winter storms. Only appears at night.
Glaciaseer_Sturgeon.intro: Glaciaseer Sturgeon is a Mythical fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Glacier_Glowfish.description: Glows brightly, guiding travelers through dark, icy waters.
Glacier_Glowfish.intro: Glacier Glowfish is a Limited fish found in the Ocean during the Winter's Edge event.

Glacier_Pike.description: Pikes are a long, predatory freshwater fish known for its aggressive nature and sharp teeth. Glacier Pikes are supremely found in cold freshwaters in Snowcap Island. They can be determined by their unique ice-coloured scales and longer fins.
Glacier_Pike.intro: Glacier Pike is an Unusual fish found in Snowcap Island.

Glacier_Swordfish.description: A sleek, powerful fish with a frosted, icicle-shaped bill. Its body glistens with icy-blue tones.
Glacier_Swordfish.intro: Glacier Swordfish is a Rare fish found in the Glacial Grotto.

Glacierfish.description: Glacierfish are cold saltwater fish with large, broad bodies and a distinctive pink fin colouration. They are an extremely rare fish and can sometimes be a difficult catch for any angler. They can be found more commonly in Snowcap Caves during the night.
Glacierfish.intro: Glacierfish is a Mythical fish found in Snowcap Island.
trivia: This fish is likely a reference to the Glacierfish from the game Stardew Valley.

Glade_Lurker.description: A dark green-yellow fish with menacing fangs, stalking the glades beneath the waves.
Glade_Lurker.intro: Glade Lurker is an Extinct fish found in Lushgrove.

Gladiator_Eel.description: A scarred eel that thrashes with the fury of a trained arena fighter.
Gladiator_Eel.intro: Gladiator Eel is a Legendary fish found in the Bellona's Frenzy of War.

Glass_Diamond.description: An incredibly unique translucent diamond from within the Earth's most frigid caves.
Glass_Diamond.intro: Glass Diamond is a Mythical fish found in the Overgrowth Caves.

Glass_Sand_Castle.intro: Glass Sand Castle is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Heatwave Admin Event.

Glass_of_Eggnog.description: A nice glass of eggnog! Could go well with a gingerbread cookie?
Glass_of_Eggnog.intro: Glass of Eggnog is a Limited fish found in the Glacial Ridge during the Fischmas 2 event.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Glass of Eggnog resembles an egg.

Glass_of_Milk.description: A delicious glass of milk, favored by Santa Claus. Goes well together with a cookie.
Glass_of_Milk.intro: Glass of Milk is a Limited fish found in the Winter Village during the Fischmas (2024) event.

Glassfish.description: The glassfish is a small, transparent fish with a delicate, almost invisible body that makes it well-suited for avoiding predators. It is a common find within the waters of Sunstone Island.
Glassfish.intro: Glassfish is a Common fish found in Sunstone Island.

Gleamfin_Minnow.description: A tiny fish whose fins shimmer softly in bright conditions.
Gleamfin_Minnow.intro: Gleamfin Minnow is a Common fish found in Apollo's Song of Light.

GlimmerSuit_Boots.intro: The GlimmerSuit Boots are a reusable piece of equipment which can be used to increase the player’s movement speed on land.

Glimmer_Guppy.description: A dark pastel purple fish with pink fins and yellow spots, shimmering faintly.
Glimmer_Guppy.intro: Glimmer Guppy is an Extinct fish found in the Azure Lagoon.

Glimmerfin_Suit_Lvl_1.intro: The Glimmerfin Suit Lvl 1 is a suit equipment that prevents the player's temperature bar from increasing. It is a useful item for fishing in the Volcanic Vents.

Glimmerfin_Suit_Lvl_2.intro: The Glimmerfin Suit Lvl 2 is a suit equipment that prevents the player's temperature bar from increasing or decreasing. It is a useful item for fishing in the Volcanic Vents and Challenger's Deep, and can be used as an alternative to the Winter Cloak when climbing the Northern Expedition.

Glimmerfin_Suit_Lvl_3.intro: The Glimmerfin Suit Lvl 3 is a suit equipment that prevents the player's temperature bar from increasing or decreasing. It is a useful item for fishing in the Volcanic Vents and Challenger's Deep, and can be used as an alternative to the Winter Cloak when climbing the Northern Expedition.

Glitch_Cap.intro: Glitch Cap is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Glitchstorm Admin Event.

Glitched_Potion.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Glitched_Shades.intro: Glitched Shades is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Glitchstorm Admin Event.

Gloamfin_Gar.description: A long, sinewy fish with a pattern that glow brightly in the dusk.
Gloamfin_Gar.intro: Gloamfin Gar is a Common fish found in Blue Moon events at Snowcap Island.

Globe_Jellyfish.description: The Globe Jellyfish is a distant relative of the elusive Emperor Jellyfish. They are highly venomous instead of electrifying, which makes it a threat to any unfortunate creatures who come in contact with it.
Globe_Jellyfish.intro: Globe Jellyfish is an Unusual fish found in the Desolate Deep 's Brine Pool.

Gloombiter.description: A fierce biter that claims the shadows as its domain.
Gloombiter.intro: Gloombiter is a Common fish found in the Cursed Isle, and formerly in The Cursed Shores.

Glow_Brick.description: A massive fish that glows with dark LEGO bricks, illuminating the deep sea.
Glow_Brick.intro: Glow Brick is a Limited fish found in LEGO Pools during the LEGO Event.
trivia: The Glow Brick is from LEGO® Set 31088; Product page.

Glowfin_Skipper.description: A radiant fish, its gleam cutting through the smoky veil.
Glowfin_Skipper.intro: Glowfin Skipper is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Glyph_Rune.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Gnomefish.description: A small, stout fish with a grumpy expression and spiny fins.
Gnomefish.intro: Gnomefish is a Common fish found in Crowned Ruins.

Goblin_Shark.description: A deep-sea predator with a protruding snout, jagged teeth, and a ghostly appearance.
Goblin_Shark.intro: Goblin Shark is a Rare fish found in The Depths of Vertigo.

Goggled_Goby.description: A tiny goby sporting oversized swimming goggles. It takes its underwater sightseeing very seriously.
Goggled_Goby.intro: Goggled Goby is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Gold_Coin.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Gold_Piece.description: A shiny fragment of pure gold broken off from a richer vein.
Gold_Piece.intro: Gold Piece is a Rare fish found in the Mineshaft.

Goldband_Butterflyfish.description: A golden glint from the ocean's buried wealth.
Goldband_Butterflyfish.intro: Goldband Butterflyfish is an Uncommon fish found in Treasure Island.

Goldbrick.description: A hefty fish made of gleaming LEGO bricks, shining like a golden treasure.
Goldbrick.intro: Goldbrick is a Limited fish found in LEGO Pools during the LEGO Event.
trivia: The Goldbrick is from LEGO® Set 31158; Product page.

Golden_Coin.description: A coin made of pure gold; a rare find!
Golden_Coin.intro: Golden Coin is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Semi Chaos, Goldstorm, Buffed Goldstorm, MAYHEM, MEGA MAYHEM, MADNESS and Pure Chaos Admin Events.

Golden_Crab_Cage.intro: Crab Cages are special consumable item that can be used as an alternate means of catching fish.

Golden_Dorado.description: A radiant trophy from the sea's golden depths.
Golden_Dorado.intro: Golden Dorado is an Unusual fish found in Treasure Island.

Golden_Egg.intro: Golden Egg is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Egg Horde Admin Event.

Golden_Nessie.description: A once known myth, encased in pure gold...
Golden_Nessie.intro: Golden Nessie is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Semi Chaos, Goldstorm, Buffed Goldstorm, MADNESS, MAYHEM, MEGA MAYHEM, and Pure Chaos Admin Events.

Golden_Rainbow_Leviathan.description: A legendary golden apparition said to embody the ocean's purest fortune, its dazzling scales shimmer with gold and prismatic light as it coils beneath the waves. Many chase the legend; almost none ever see it...
Golden_Rainbow_Leviathan.intro: Golden Rainbow Leviathan is a Limited fish found in Golden Lucky Gold Abundances during the Shamrock Seas event.

Golden_Scylla.description: The mythological, multi-headed being; touched by the purest of gold.
Golden_Scylla.intro: Golden Scylla is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Semi Chaos, Goldstorm, Buffed Goldstorm, MADNESS, MAYHEM, MEGA MAYHEM, and Pure Chaos Admin Events.

Golden_Sea_Pearl.description: A strikingly shiny pearl, rumored to have originated from the deepest depths of Atlantis.
Golden_Sea_Pearl.intro: Golden Sea Pearl is an Exotic fish found in Clams behind Roslit Bay at a 0.16% or a 1 in 625 chance.

Golden_Seahorse.description: Golden Sea Horses are small but enchanting, drifting near seaweed & algae. Gentle and rare, they’re a delight to find.
Golden_Seahorse.intro: Golden Seahorse is a Mythical fish found in Forsaken Shores.

Golden_Smallmouth_Bass.description: A special and extremely rare breed of the Smallmouth Bass. They are extremely scarce in quantity, but they have slightly more haste and resilience than their cousins. Can be found alongside the Common Smallmouth Bass.
Golden_Smallmouth_Bass.intro: Golden Smallmouth Bass is a Legendary fish found in Terrapin Island.

Golden_Trout.description: A shimmering salmonid adorned with radiant golden scales that dazzle in sub-zero canal waters.
Golden_Trout.intro: Golden Trout is a Mythical fish found in the Astral Observatory - Northern Expedition.

Goldfin_Octopus.description: A golden enigma from the sea's most elusive troves.
Goldfin_Octopus.intro: Goldfin Octopus is an Exotic fish found in Treasure Island.

Goldfish.description: Goldfish are found in Moosewoods pond and are best awake during the nice summer days. Even though they look weak, goldfish are highly tolerant of turbid waters, temperature fluctuations, and low levels of dissolved oxygen.
Goldfish.intro: Goldfish is an Uncommon fish found in Moosewood.

Goldwraith.description: A spectral fish made of living gold, said to be the guardian spirit of the Crowned Ruins. Its passage leaves trails of light.
Goldwraith.intro: Goldwraith is an Exotic fish found in Crowned Ruins.

Goliath_Siphonophore.description: A massive, ribbon-like colonial organism stretching dozens of meters through freezing waters.
Goliath_Siphonophore.intro: Goliath Siphonophore is an Exotic fish found in Astral Observatory - Boreal Hollow.

Goliath_Tigerfish.description: A monstrous predator with fangs like knives and unmatched ferocity.
Goliath_Tigerfish.intro: Goliath Tigerfish is a Mythical fish found in the Lost Jungle.

Gollum_Snakehead.description: A blind cavefish from North American karst aquifers, using vibration to navigate.
Gollum_Snakehead.intro: Gollum Snakehead is an Uncommon fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Gorgon_Grouper.description: A stone-like fish with glowing eyes and a body covered in moss.
Gorgon_Grouper.intro: Gorgon Grouper is an Unusual fish found in the Veil of the Forsaken of Mariana's Veil.

Grand_Reef_Guardian.description: An ancient fish species that dwells in the deepest parts of the reef. Their massive size and mysterious bioluminescent patterns have led many to believe they protect the reef's most sacred spaces.
Grand_Reef_Guardian.intro: Grand Reef Guardian is a Mythical fish found in the Grand Reef.

Grandpa_Horseshoe_Crab.description: An old hard shelled crab with a spiffy beard, armoured to protect itself from predators. Their gills have folds of membranes that look like the leaves of a book
Grandpa_Horseshoe_Crab.intro: Grandpa Horseshoe Crab is a Secret fish found in the Desolate Deep.

Grave_Serpent.description: A long, coiling serpent wrapped in decay and lingering energy.
Grave_Serpent.intro: Grave Serpent is a Legendary fish found in the Hades' Underworld of Indefinite.

Gravestone_Stingray.description: A massive stingray shaped like a gravestone, haunting the depths.

Gravity_Coil.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Grayling.description: An interesting, cold-water fish with shimmering silver scales and a signature large, colourful dorsal fin. It is known for it's beauty and its agile swimming behaviour. The Grayling is often found in Snowcap Pond during the day, but it can rarely be found at night.
Grayling.intro: Grayling is a Common fish found in Snowcap Island.

Great_Barracuda.description: A fierce hunter streaking through shadowed waters.
Great_Barracuda.intro: Great Barracuda is an Extinct fish found in Gilded Arch.

Great_Goldcursed_Shark.description: A golden titan shrouded in ancient mystery.
Great_Goldcursed_Shark.intro: Great Goldcursed Shark is a Secret fish found in Castaway Cliffs.

Great_Hammerhead_Shark.description: The Great Hammerhead Shark is a large, powerful predator known for its distinct hammer-shaped head. Its unique head shape improves its ability to track prey, making it a formidable hunter in the ocean, and a prominent catch among anglers.
Great_Hammerhead_Shark.intro: Great Hammerhead Shark is a Mythical fish found in Shark Hunts.

Great_White_Shark.description: Great White Sharks are apex predators and will put up an intense fight when hooked. Their presence is often a sign of rich, diverse marine life in the area. Rare and challenging, they offer one of the biggest rewards for those skilled enough to catch them.
Great_White_Shark.intro: Great White Shark is a Mythical fish found in Shark Hunts.

Greater_Silver_Hatchetfish.description: A thin, blade-like fish coated in mirror-like silver scales that disrupt silhouetting from predators below.
Greater_Silver_Hatchetfish.intro: Greater Silver Hatchetfish is a Rare fish found at Outer Deep of The Deep.

Greater_Weever.description: A venomous fish that buries itself in sand, leaving only its eyes and dorsal spines exposed.
Greater_Weever.intro: Greater Weever is an Uncommon fish found in Crowned Ruins.

Green_Conch.intro: Fischfest 2 is a summer-themed Event which lasts from June 20th until September 5th, 2026. The event features a new island which can be accessed through the use of the Magical Conch, several NPCs, and a new 'Sunshells' currency which can be exchanged for limited items.

Green_Energy_Crystal.description: A green-hued crystal, told to possess mystical powers.
Green_Energy_Crystal.intro: Green Energy Crystal is a Mythical fish found by talking to the "???" NPC in Frigid Cavern.

Green_Frightful_Skull.intro: FischFright (2025) is the Halloween-themed annual event that occured during 2025 which lasted from October 18, 2025 - November 3, 2025. It featured the Crook's Hallow, new NPCs with unique quests and new Event fishes.

Green_Message_in_a_Bottle.intro: Fischfest 2 is a summer-themed Event that lasts from June 20th until September 12th, 2026. The event features a new island that can be accessed using the Magical Conch, several NPCs, and a new Sunshells currency, which can be exchanged for limited items.

Green_Sea_Urchin.description: The Green Sea Urchin is a spiny echinoderm with short spines, grazing on algae in cold northern seas.
Green_Sea_Urchin.intro: Green Sea Urchin is a Common fish found in Boreal Pines.

Greenland_Halibut.description: The Greenland Halibut is a large flatfish with both eyes on one side, thriving in deep cold Arctic waters.
Greenland_Halibut.intro: Greenland Halibut is a Rare fish found in Boreal Pines.

Greenland_Shark.description: One of the longest-living vertebrate species, moving in near-freezing abyssal waters with lethargic grace.
Greenland_Shark.intro: Greenland Shark is a Common fish found in the Gloomy Crevice.

Grey_Carp.description: The Grey Carp is a sturdy freshwater fish known for its strength and adaptability. They can be found in Mushgrove Swamp feeding on plants and small insects. The Grey Carp is extremely strong, and is a tough battle to catch.
Grey_Carp.intro: Grey Carp is an Uncommon fish found in Mushgrove Swamp.

Grouchy_Smurf.description: A grumpy Smurf always being a pessimist.

Gudgeon.description: The Gudgeon is an extremely small, slender fish. They are adaptable and can thrive in a variety of freshwater environments but are native and commonly found near Terrapin Island.
Gudgeon.intro: Gudgeon is a Common fish found in Terrapin Island.

Gulf_Toadfish.description: A mottled beige fish with a croaking call, hiding among reefs.
Gulf_Toadfish.intro: Gulf Toadfish is an Extinct fish found in Whale Interior.

Gulper_Eel.description: A strange deep-sea eel with an enormous pouch-like mouth.
Gulper_Eel.intro: Gulper Eel is an Unusual fish found in the Tidefall.

Gummy_Guppy.description: A chewy guppy made entirely of gummy candy.

Gust_Tail.description: A beige colored fish with piercing yellow eyes and dark grey stripes, riding the gusts below.
Gust_Tail.intro: Gust Tail is an Extinct fish found at Waveborne.

Gygax_Egg.intro: Gygax Egg is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Egg Horde Admin Event.

Haddock.description: Haddock are small, silvery fish found in cold ocean waters. Haddock are often found in large schools, they are relatively easy to catch and are easy to find near their signature 'Haddock Rock'.
Haddock.intro: Haddock is a Common fish found in the Ocean.

Hagfish.description: An ancient, jawless scavenger known for producing thick mounds of slippery defensive slime when threatened.
Hagfish.intro: Hagfish is a Rare fish found in the Abyssal Zenith - Astral Cavern.

Halibut.description: The Halibut is a large flatfish known for their impressive size and strength. They commonly feed on Haddock and can be found hunting near 'Haddock Rock' and in deep waters.
Halibut.intro: Halibut is a Rare fish found in the Ocean.

Halloween_Roped.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Halloween_Sparkler.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Hallucigenia.description: The Hallucigenia is an elongated, worm-like creature with spiney appendages throughout its body. They went extinct around 485 million years ago, at the end of the Ordovician period. They are quite low on the food chain, primarily feeding on small microorganisms.
Hallucigenia.intro: Hallucigenia is a Rare fish found in the Ancient Isle.
trivia: Although the bestiary description claims it went extinct during the Ordovician, there is no concrete proof that the real-world Hallucigenia did. Instead it is widely believed that Hallucigenia went extinct during the Cambrian.

Handfish.description: The Handfish is a unique, small, and critically rare species with pectoral fins that resemble hands, which it uses to 'walk' along the ocean floor rather than swim. They can only be found stomping on the floors of Mushgrove Swamp
Handfish.intro: Handfish is a Mythical fish found in Mushgrove Swamp.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Handfish is a reference to Pochita, a protagonist of the Chainsaw Man manga and anime series.

Harbinger_Koi.intro: Harbinger Koi is a Limited fish found in the Crypt of the Green One.

Hardened_Glass.description: A thick, reinforced pane of observatory lens glass, fused solid under intense pressures and cold.
Hardened_Glass.intro: Hardened Glass is an Exotic fish found in the Astral Observatory - Abyssal Zenith.

Harmonic_Dove.description: A fledgling Harmonic Dove still learning how to fly.
Harmonic_Dove.intro: Harmonic Dove is a Mythical fish found in Above The Clouds.

Harvest_Sunfish.description: A plump sunfish bursting with harvest colors, feeding on fallen fruits and nuts.
Harvest_Sunfish.intro: Harvest Sunfish is an Uncommon fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Haunted_Candle.intro: FischFright (2025) is the Halloween-themed annual event that occured during 2025 which lasted from October 18, 2025 - November 3, 2025. It featured the Crook's Hallow, new NPCs with unique quests and new Event fishes.

Hawaiian_Bobtail_Squid.description: A small squid with a symbiotic glow, camouflaging in shallow cavern sands by night.
Hawaiian_Bobtail_Squid.intro: Hawaiian Bobtail Squid is an Uncommon fish found in the Luminescent Cavern.

Hawaiian_Shirt_Shark.description: A chill reef shark sporting vivid hibiscus floral patterns across its sleek dorsal hide.
Hawaiian_Shirt_Shark.intro: Hawaiian Shirt Shark is a Limited fish found in the Skycrest.

Hawaiian_Ventralis_Anthias.description: An exquisite deep mesophotic anthias sporting long, trailing ventral fins and shimmering neon pink-and-yellow scales.
Hawaiian_Ventralis_Anthias.intro: Hawaiian Ventralis Anthias is a Legendary fish found in the Skycrest.

Heart_Balloon.description: A floating heart-shaped balloon that drifted out to sea, still bouyant and full of Valentine's cheer.
Heart_Balloon.intro: Heart Balloon is a Limited fish found in any body of water during the Valentides 2 event.

Heart_Cookie.description: A heart-shaped cookie that somehow survived the water, sweet and crumbly with Valentine's frosting.
Heart_Cookie.intro: Heart Cookie is a Limited fish found in Sweetheart Shores during the Valentides 2.

Heart_Of_Zeus.intro: The Heart Of Zeus is a Reusable Item necessary for entering Atlantis.

Heart_Sand_Dollar.description: A delicate sand dollar etched with a perfect heart shape, nature's own Valentine's card from the seabed.
Heart_Sand_Dollar.intro: Heart Sand Dollar is a Limited fish found in Sweetheart Shores during the Valentides 2 event.

Heartbreak_Cake.intro: Valentides (2026) was a seasonal event on Fisch which contributed to the 2026 Valentines which lasted from February 7, 2026 - February 21, 2026. It featured a new Event area with new NPCs, unique quests, puzzles and Event fishes.

Heartbreak_Herring.description: A sorrowful little herring with a broken heart pattern on its scales, said to appear when love goes wrong during the Valentine's season.
Heartbreak_Herring.intro: Heartbreak Herring is a Limited fish found in Lovestorm Turtle Pools during the Valentides 2 event.

Hefty.description: A strong Smurf who lifts everyone's spirits.

Heleobia.description: A tiny aquatic snail whose shell stores chemical compounds that lower the freezing point of surrounding water.
Heleobia.intro: Heleobia is a Rare fish found in the Astral Observatory - Northern Expedition.

Helicoprion.description: Helicoprion is a prehistoric shark with a unique, spiral tooth structure, using its powerful jaws to capture prey in the Ancient isles shallow seas.
Helicoprion.intro: Helicoprion is a Mythical fish found in the Ancient Isle.
trivia: The model of Helicoprion lacks it's distinctive "tooth whorl".

Helios_Ray.description: These ray-like fish have skin that seems to capture and store sunlight, making them glow like miniature suns in the darker depths. Ancient texts suggest they once lit the streets of the sunken city.
Helios_Ray.intro: Helios Ray is an Unusual fish found in Atlantis.

Helios_Sunray.description: An immense divine ray with wings of living sunlight, bright enough to make the sea itself feel weightless.
Helios_Sunray.intro: Helios Sunray is an Exotic fish found in Apollo's Song of Light.

Hellfire_Haddock.description: A small, scorching fish that flickers like a dying flame.
Hellfire_Haddock.intro: Hellfire Haddock is a Common fish found in Volcanic Vents of Mariana's Veil.

Hellmaw_Eel.description: A sinuous creature, its jaws wide and lined with crimson hints.
Hellmaw_Eel.intro: Hellmaw Eel is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Herring.description: The Herring is a slender silvery fish known for its schooling behaviour. Herring can often be found in costal waters during the day.
Herring.intro: Herring is a Common fish found in Snowcap Island.

Hexeye_Snapper.intro: Hexeye Snapper is a Limited fish found in the Crypt of the Green One.

Hidden_Filefish.description: A concealed fish among the ocean's secrets.
Hidden_Filefish.intro: Hidden Filefish is an Unusual fish found in Treasure Island.

Hidden_Pipefish.description: A slender enigma weaving through coral mazes.
Hidden_Pipefish.intro: Hidden Pipefish is a Legendary fish found in Castaway Cliffs.

Him.intro: Him is a Divine Secret fish found rarely in any body of water.
trivia: Catching the Him rewards the player with the Him title.
The Shiny version of Him is a classic Roblox Noob.

Hoarfrost_Halibut.description: A colossal flatfish anchored to sub-zero benthic trenches, encrusted with shimmering ice-like frost patterns.
Hoarfrost_Halibut.intro: Hoarfrost Halibut is a Legendary fish found in Challenger's Deep of Mariana's Veil.

Hoarfrost_Pike.description: A sharp-toothed predator coated in hoarfrost, ambushing prey from beneath frozen logs.
Hoarfrost_Pike.intro: Hoarfrost Pike is an Uncommon fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Hogchoker.description: A sandy-colored fish with beige fins, flattening itself against the ocean floor.
Hogchoker.intro: Hogchoker is an Common fish found in Mushgrove Swamp.

Holiday_Ham.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Hollow_Flake_Catfish.description: Ghostly fish with translucent scales, haunting frozen streams.
Hollow_Flake_Catfish.intro: Hollow Flake Catfish is a Limited fish found in the Ocean during the Winter's Edge event.

Hollow_Gazer.description: From darkest depths, the Hollow Gazer stares, with empty eyes inviting the coldest embrace.
Hollow_Gazer.intro: Hollow Gazer is a Limited fish found within the Cults Curse event.

Hollow_Pike.description: A gaunt predator with a skeletal frame and a hollow stare.
Hollow_Pike.intro: Hollow Pike is a Unusual fish found in the Hades' Underworld of Indefinite.

Hollow_Snapper.description: A dark green fish with glowing fins, and a menacing glare that pierces the gloom.
Hollow_Snapper.intro: Hollow Snapper is an Extinct fish found in Lushgrove.

Hollowfin.description: A relentless force that echoes with empty strength.
Hollowfin.intro: Hollowfin is a Rare fish found in the Cursed Isle, and formerly in The Cursed Shores.

Holly_Haddock.description: Haddock decked out in holly leaves. Prickly but jolly on the holidays.
