Holly_Haddock.intro: Holly Haddock is a Limited fish found in the Glacial Ridge during the Fischmas 2 event.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Holly Haddock resembles a piece of holly berry with little fish as the berries.

Hollyscale_Trout.description: Colorful and proud, even if he's not that rare.
Hollyscale_Trout.intro: Hollyscale Trout is a Limited fish found in the Ocean during the Winter's Edge event.

Honey_Clump.description: A glob of pure honey. Sweet, but worthless for selling.
Honey_Clump.intro: Honey Clump is a Trash found in the Nectar Den.

Honey_Drifter.description: A lazy drifter coated in sticky honey; attracting swarms of tiny bees.
Honey_Drifter.intro: Honey Drifter is a Common Fish found in the Nectar Den.

Horizon_Tetra.description: A shimmering metallic blue fish with yellow fins, glinting at the water’s edge.
Horizon_Tetra.intro: Horizon Tetra is an Extinct fish found in the Isle of New Beginnings.

Horseshoe_Crab.description: A hard shelled crab, armoured to protect itself from predators. Their gills have folds of membranes that look like the leaves of a book
Horseshoe_Crab.intro: Horseshoe Crab is a Common fish found in the Desolate Deep.

Hot_Chocolate.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Hot_Cocoa.description: Steaming mug of hot cocoa with marshmallow fins. Warms your hands while reeling.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Hot Cocoa resembles a bar of chocolate. When interacted with, it plays a licking sound effect.

Hourglass_Bass.description: A mesmerizing bass with markings that resemble flowing sand in an hourglass. Its transparent fins seem to sparkle with golden particles, making it a living timekeeper of the Golden Tide celebration.
Hourglass_Bass.intro: Hourglass Bass is a Limited fish found in special pools in the Ocean during the Golden Tide event.

Hourglass_Hull.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Hourglass_Lantern.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Humpback_Anglerfish.description: A iconic deep-sea angler with a globular body and an illicium modified into a glowing bioluminescent bulb.
Humpback_Anglerfish.intro: Humpback Anglerfish is a Common fish found in the Gloomy Crevice.

Humpback_Whale.description: Humpback Whales are enormous ocean travelers known for their haunting songs and powerful leaps above the waves. They spend much of their time migrating across vast distances, and despite their calm nature, their immense size can make them quite a challenge to reel in.
Humpback_Whale.intro: Humpback Whale is an Exotic fish found in the Ocean during Humpback Whale Migrations.

Hydra_Haddock.description: A small, hydra-type fish with dark scales and glowing eyes.
Hydra_Haddock.intro: Hydra Haddock is a Common fish found in the Veil of the Forsaken of Mariana's Veil.

Hydro-Core.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Hyneria.description: Hyneria is a giant, predatory lobe-finned fish from the Devonian, ambushing prey with powerful jaws, sharp teeth, and remarkable swimming agility.
Hyneria.intro: Hyneria is an Unusual fish found in the Ancient Isle.

Hyperbike.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Ice.description: Chunk of ice that broke off from a glacier in Snowcap. Kinda fun to lick..
Ice.intro: Ice is Trash found in Snowcap Island.

Ice_Anchovy.description: A small, silvery fish with crystalline scales that shimmer like fresh frost.
Ice_Anchovy.intro: Ice Anchovy is an Uncommon fish found in the Overgrowth Caves.

Ice_Cream_Carp.description: A carp made entirely of ice cream. Melts faster than your patience in a queue, so enjoy it while it lasts.
Ice_Cream_Carp.intro: Ice Cream Carp is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Ice_Crystal.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Ice_Eel.description: A serpentine creature with translucent skin that seems to blend with the surrounding ice.
Ice_Eel.intro: Ice Eel is an Uncommon fish found in the Frigid Cavern.

Ice_Jellyfish.description: A translucent jellyfish with tentacles that sparkle like icicles in the dim light.
Ice_Jellyfish.intro: Ice Jellyfish is an Unusual fish found in the Frigid Cavern.

Ice_Octopus.description: An intelligent cephalopod with skin that mimics the patterns of frozen cave walls.
Ice_Octopus.intro: Ice Octopus is an Unusual fish found in the Frigid Cavern.

Icebeard_Shark.description: A massive, ancient shark with frost-covered skin and icicle-like protrusions.
Icebeard_Shark.intro: Icebeard Shark is a Mythical fish found in the Glacial Grotto.

Iceberg_Isopod.description: An armored isopod that thrives in the freezing depths.
Iceberg_Isopod.intro: Iceberg Isopod is a Rare fish found in the Challenger's Deep of Mariana's Veil.

Icebloom_Koi.description: A graceful koi whose scales bloom with crystalline ice flowers. Thrives in the frozen pools of the forest.
Icebloom_Koi.intro: Icebloom Koi is an Unusual fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Icebreaker_Haddock.description: A robust fish with frosted silver scales and dark blue streaks.
Icebreaker_Haddock.intro: Icebreaker Haddock is a Rare fish found in the Cryogenic Canal.

Iced_Perch.description: A medium-sized fish with a frosty blue sheen and faint horizontal stripes.
Iced_Perch.intro: Iced Perch is an Unusual fish found in the Cryogenic Canal.

Icefang_Barracuda.description: A long, silver-gray predator with sharp, ice-coated teeth and glowing blue eyes.
Icefang_Barracuda.intro: Icefang Barracuda is a Rare fish found in the Glacial Grotto.

Icicle.description: A strong and frigid ice formation with a pointy end.
Icicle.intro: Icicle is a Limited fish found in the Winter Village during the Fischmas 1 event.

Icy_Carp.description: A hardy carp whose scales have adapted to form intricate ice-crystal patterns.
Icy_Carp.intro: Icy Carp is an Unusual fish found in the Overgrowth Caves.

Icy_Daggerfish.description: A slender, glowing fish with a sharp, icy form that pierces the dark.
Icy_Daggerfish.intro: Icy Daggerfish is a Legendary fish found in Blue Moon events at Snowcap Island.

Icy_Goldfish.description: A mystical goldfish with scales that sparkle like ice crystals in sunlight.
Icy_Goldfish.intro: Icy Goldfish is a Rare fish found in the Overgrowth Caves.

Icy_Salmon.description: A sleek salmon with scales that appear to be coated in a permanent layer of frost.
Icy_Salmon.intro: Icy Salmon is an Uncommon fish found in the Overgrowth Caves.

Icy_Tuna.description: A powerful tuna with fins edged in crystalline ice and a frost-covered body.
Icy_Tuna.intro: Icy Tuna is a Rare fish found in the Overgrowth Caves.

Icy_Walleye.description: A medium-sized predator fish with glowing, frosted eyes and a shimmering gray body.
Icy_Walleye.intro: Icy Walleye is an Unusual fish found in the Glacial Grotto.

Idolfish.description: A white translucent fish adorned with yellow symbols and fins, glowing like a sacred relic.
Idolfish.intro: Idolfish is an Extinct fish found in Lushgrove.

Igneous_Pearl.description: A giant pearl forged of a mysterious element exclusive to Scoria; it seems to hold a lot of power. Very hot power...
Igneous_Pearl.intro: Igneous Pearl is an Exotic fish found in Lava Clams at a 0.752% chance.

Imprinted_Relic.description: An enigmatic stone resembling that of an Enchant Relic, but imbued to mimic the power of a single Enchantment.
Imprinted_Relic.intro: The Imprinted Relic is a Relic fish only given to players that have had a specific Enchantment removed due to changing Enchantment slots or deletion.

Infant_Giant_Seadevil.description: A juvenile version of the Giant Seadevil, with a bright lure and razor-sharp teeth.
Infant_Giant_Seadevil.intro: Infant Giant Seadevil is a Legendary fish found in the Abyssal Zenith of Mariana's Veil.

Infernal_Fragment.description: A fragment of Magma and Basalt; it seems to have unnatural powers...
Infernal_Fragment.intro: Infernal Fragment is a Fragment found in Scoria Reach.

Infernal_Halibut_School.intro: Infernal Halibut School is an Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

Infernal_Iguanafish.description: A fearsome, lizard-like fish with jagged scales that glow like molten rock.
Infernal_Iguanafish.intro: Infernal Iguanafish is an Uncommon fish found in Volcanic Vents of Mariana's Veil.

Infernal_Sky_Crystal.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Inferno_Chaser.description: A slender, fiery fish, its whiskers trailing like sparks in pursuit.
Inferno_Chaser.intro: Inferno Chaser is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Inferno_Hide.description: Inferno Hide.. Used to craft something?
Inferno_Hide.intro: Inferno Hide is a Common fish found in Volcanic Vents of Mariana's Veil.

Inferno_Wood.description: Holds the Power of Earth's Magma Core... Said to be used in crafting one of the strongest Rods...
Inferno_Wood.intro: Inferno Wood is a Mythical Crafting Ingredient obtainable at Roslit Volcano.

Intermediate_Oxygen_Tank.intro: The Intermediate Oxygen Tank is an oxygen tank equipment that acts as a direct upgrade from the Beginner Oxygen Tank, allowing the player to breathe for longer. This oxygen tank is only recommended to be used until the player reaches the camp with the Advanced Oxygen Tank.

Invincible_Relic.description: An immortal stone filled with the essence of a Divine Lantern Keeper.. Returning it to it's [ sic ] throne under the Statue of Sovereignty will result in your currently equipped rod being blessed with its immense strength.
Invincible_Relic.intro: Invincible Relic is a Relic fish obtained from completing the Apprentice Archaeologist 's quest.

Ion_Pike.description: A sharp, fast predator that darts like a bolt through the water.
Ion_Pike.intro: Ion Pike is a Unusual fish found in Zeus's Thunder of Chaos.

Iron_Chunk.description: A heavy lump of raw iron ore ready to be smelted into something useful.
Iron_Chunk.intro: Iron Chunk is a Common fish found in the Mineshaft.

Islandhopper_Butterflyfish.description: A delicate flitter dancing across tropical tides.
Islandhopper_Butterflyfish.intro: Islandhopper Butterflyfish is an Extinct fish found in Gilded Arch.

Isonade.description: The Isonade is a sinister creature that is assumed extinct. They are seeming to be [ sic ] a dream that is possible to be caught and captured. They only circle near Strange Whirlpools, and sometimes can even be the cause for one.
Isonade.intro: Isonade is a Mythical fish found in Strange Whirlpools.
trivia: ' Isonade ' may be in reference to a mythological monster of the same name found in Japanese folklore, said to frequently appear near violent storms.
Isonade is one of the few fish only able to be caught outside their Located area, as it is only caught in strange whirlpools, and not actually Vertigo itself.

Jack%27s_Treads.intro: The Jack's Treads are a limited-time reusable piece of equipment, obtained during FischFright (2025), which can be used to increase the player’s movement speed on land.

Jack-o-Lantern.description: Someone carved this and threw it into the ocean for you to catch...

Jaco_Eelpout.description: A bottom-dwelling zoarcid fish adapted to cold, dark abyssal silt deposits.
Jaco_Eelpout.intro: Jaco Eelpout is a Rare fish found at Lower Deep of The Deep.

Japanese_Dragon_Eel.description: A serpentine eel with crimson scales, coiling through cavern crevices with predatory grace.
Japanese_Dragon_Eel.intro: Japanese Dragon Eel is a Legendary fish found in the Crimson Cavern.

Japanese_Linebelly_Swallower.description: An abyssal predator with a highly distensible stomach enabling it to swallow prey much larger than itself.
Japanese_Linebelly_Swallower.intro: Japanese Linebelly Swallower is a Mythical fish found at Outer Deep of The Deep.

JellyBop.intro: JellyBop is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Aliens Admin Event.

Jellystud.description: A translucent jellyfish with glowing LEGO studs, floating like a soft brick cloud.
Jellystud.intro: Jellystud is a Limited fish found in LEGO Pools during the LEGO Event.
trivia: The Jellystud is from LEGO® Set 31158; Product page.

John_Dory.description: A thin, disc-shaped fish with a prominent black spot on its side.
John_Dory.intro: John Dory is an Uncommon fish found in Sunken Reliquary.

Jolly_Bait_Crate.description: Crate of jolly bait that swims. Bait that catches itself? Cheater!
Jolly_Bait_Crate.intro: Jolly Bait Crate is a Limited Crate found in the Glacial Ridge during the Fischmas 2 event.

Jungle_Phantom.description: A green fish with light green fins and dark green accents, fading into the jungle depths like a specter.
Jungle_Phantom.intro: Jungle Phantom is an Extinct fish found in Lushgrove.

Jurassic_Helicoprion.description: A spiral-jawed predator from Jurassic depths.
Jurassic_Helicoprion.intro: Jurassic Helicoprion is a Limited fish found in the Jurassic Island.

Jurassic_Mosasaurus.description: A massive marine reptile that dominated Jurassic seas.

Kareth%27s_Amulet_Fragment.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Keepers_Guardian.description: Whilst it is named the 'Keepers Guardian', they are actually friendly creatures! The Guardian can sense peoples intentions, and will only become violent when they notice someone with a harmful intention to it or the Keepers Altar.
Keepers_Guardian.intro: Keepers Guardian is a Rare fish found in the Keepers Altar.

Kelpie.description: A mythical water horse with a spooky aura, lurking in the frightful pools.

Ken.description: A cool, laid-back Smurf with a knack for adventure.

Kerauno_Wyrm.description: A colossal wyrm of living thunder, its body composed of blinding arcs of lightning and roaring energy.

Key_of_Oaths.description: This is the Key that leads to the gates of the Passage of Oaths...

Key_of_Whispers.description: This is the Key that leads to the gates of the Hall of Whispers...
Key_of_Whispers.intro: Key of Whispers is an Exotic fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Kind_Egg.description: Aweee its so sweet and caring <3.
Kind_Egg.intro: Kind Egg is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Egg Horde Admin Event.

King%27s_Crest_Eel.description: A regal eel with a sweeping crown-like crest and the temper of a storm tide.
King%27s_Crest_Eel.intro: King's Crest Eel is a Legendary fish found in Poseidon's Storm of Floods.

King_Crab.description: The King Crab is a massive crustacean with long spiny legs and rich meat, from deep cold northern waters.
King_Crab.intro: King Crab is a Legendary fish found in Boreal Pines.

King_Crabstle.description: Hidden beneath a castle of sand and a lonely beach tree, King Crabstle waits patiently for unsuspecting passersby. Disturb its kingdom, and prepare for a royal retreat!!!
King_Crabstle.intro: King Crabstle is a Limited fish found in the King Crabstle Hunt.

King_Jellyfish.description: A behemoth composed partly of pure ethereal energy, this jellyfish is believed to be an ancient guardian of the abyss. It pulses with otherworldly power and commands lesser creatures with its presence.
King_Jellyfish.intro: King Jellyfish is a Mythical fish found in Atlantis.

King_Oyster.description: King Oysters are a special breed of oysters that can only be found around Terrapin Island. They filter almost all salt out of the water, making Terrapins water freshwater.
King_Oyster.intro: King Oyster is a Rare fish found in Terrapin Island.
trivia: The description of this fish contradicts Jack 's explanation on why the island is freshwater. He claims that special algae filter out the salt, while the bestiary entry claims the oyster does it.

Kissing_Gourami.description: These gouramis are often seen 'kissing', a perfect symbol of affection during Valentides.
Kissing_Gourami.intro: Kissing Gourami is a Limited fish found in Sweetheart Shores during the Valentides 2 event.

Kitefin_Shark.description: A glowing deep-sea shark cruising cavern slopes with photophores.
Kitefin_Shark.intro: Kitefin Shark is a Legendary fish found in Luminescent Cavern.

Kittyfish.description: A feline swimmer with whiskers, purring through the warm currents.
Kittyfish.intro: Kittyfish is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the Second Sea.

Knifefish.description: A metallic black fish with blue accents and fins, slicing through the water.

Krabbit.description: A hopping fish with long ears, nibbling through the weeds.
Krabbit.intro: Krabbit is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the Second Sea.

Kraken%27s_Herald.description: A massive creature that serves as the Kraken's messenger. Its presence often precedes great disturbances in the deep, and lesser beings flee at its approach.
Kraken%27s_Herald.intro: Kraken's Herald is a Legendary fish found in Atlantis.

Kraken_Egg.intro: Eggs are a type of items obtainable in Fisch. They can be opened to receive items such as Bait and C$, or more rarely contain unique Egg-exclusive items.

Lagoon_Lobster.description: Lobsters are valuable crustaceans known for their rich, succulent meat. Lobsters are most active in the summer to autumn, and are commonly caught in crab cages during calm clear days.
Lagoon_Lobster.intro: Lagoon Lobster is an Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

Lake_Whitefish.description: The Lake Whitefish is a silvery freshwater fish with a small head, common in cold northern lakes.
Lake_Whitefish.intro: Lake Whitefish is an Unusual fish found in Boreal Pines.

Langoustine.description: Lobsters are valuable crustaceans known for their rich, succulent meat. Lobsters are most active in the summer to autumn, and are commonly caught in crab cages during calm clear days.

Lantern_Parasite.description: A glowing parasite that attaches to hosts, luring them into toxic traps with its bioluminescent lure.

Lantern_Snapper.description: A tiny red fish glowing like a lantern, illuminating the reef’s shadows.
Lantern_Snapper.intro: Lantern Snapper is an Extinct fish found in the Isle of New Beginnings.

Lanternfish.description: A small deep-sea fish with bioluminescent organs.
Lanternfish.intro: Lanternfish is a Common fish found in the Tidefall.

Lapis_Lazuli.description: A deep blue gemstone with a complex shape.
Lapis_Lazuli.intro: Lapis Lazuli is a Gemstone found inside Meteors in the Ancient Isle.

Lapisjack.description: The Lapisjack is a strong, fast-swimming fish known for their vigorous fights and robust body. Mostly active in spring, and only found in Keepers Altar. They are capable of sustaining their conscious when the Altar is active.
Lapisjack.intro: Lapisjack is a Rare fish found in the Keepers Altar.

Lapisjaw_Jack.description: The Lapisjaw Jack is a sturdy fish with sharp lapis-colored mineral growths along its jaw and fins. Similiar to the Lapisjack, it is a fast swimmer that seems capable of withstanding the heavier pressure near the Enchanted Crevice.
Lapisjaw_Jack.intro: Lapisjaw Jack is an Unusual fish found in Enchanted Crevice.

Largemouth_Bass.description: The Largemouth Bass is a common freshwater fish found in Moosewood known for its large mouth and aggressive feeding behaviour. It's found in various habitats, such as lakes, ponds, and rivers, where the water is warm and there's plenty of vegetation. Largemouth Bass are also known for their camouflage, with a greenish color on their backs that helps them blend in with their surroundings.
Largemouth_Bass.intro: Largemouth Bass is a Common fish found in Moosewood.
trivia: According to a loading screen tip, the Largemouth Bass was the first fish to be added to Fisch.

Lava_Bream.description: A dark fish, its fins aglow with the warmth of molten depths.
Lava_Bream.intro: Lava Bream is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Lava_Bucket.intro: Lava Bucket is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Volcano Admin Event.

Lava_Clam.description: A bivalve adapted to extreme temperatures, its shell lined with heat-resistant minerals. Prized for the unique pearls it occasionally produces.

Mackerel.intro: Mackerel is a Common fish found in the Ocean.

Maelstorm_Shark.description: A legendary shark species that seems to control the very currents of the Atlantean Storm. Their presence is said to intensify the surrounding waters, creating massive whirlpools wherever they swim.
Maelstorm_Shark.intro: Maelstorm Shark is a Legendary fish found in the Atlantean Storm.

Mage_Marlin.description: Masters of aquatic magic, these mystical marlins channel the ethereal energies of the abyss through their sword-like bills. Their presence can cause surges of magical power in ancient ruins.
Mage_Marlin.intro: Mage Marlin is a Legendary fish found in Atlantis.

The event featured brand new island, several NPCs, new exclusive currency, and a Shell Merchant where Shells, a limited currency, could be exchanged for a limited Fishing Rod, Boat, Lantern, Bobber, Baits and Items.

Magician_Narwhal.description: A whimsical narwhal with a neat top hat and an enchanted magician's wand, casting spells beneath waves.
Magician_Narwhal.intro: Magician Narwhal is an Apex fish found in the Ocean during Narwhal Hunts.

Magma_Leviathan.description: A behemoth of the volcanic depths, its scales radiate intense heat, turning the water around it into steam. Some say it sleeps for centuries, only waking during great eruptions.
Magma_Leviathan.intro: Magma Leviathan is an Exotic fish found in Volcanic Vents of Mariana's Veil.

Magma_Pike.description: A sturdy fish, its form kissed by the glow of molten veins.
Magma_Pike.intro: Magma Pike is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Magma_Tang.description: The Magma Tang is a rare lava imbued Tang with a resting body temperature of 950C. They are extremely common in the lava, as they practically are part of the lava.
Magma_Tang.intro: Magma Tang is an Uncommon fish found in the Volcano in Roslit Bay.

Magma_Turkey.description: Feathers aglow with crackling lava flows, this fiery turkey erupts from volcanic vents in the pond. Handle its scorching heat; it's magma-ficent for Fischgiving!
trivia: The Shiny Magma Turkey is based on the Developer RoReddo (@RoReddo).

Magmatic_Hermit_Crab.description: A hermit crab that makes its home in discarded obsidian shells. Its body glows with a faint internal heat, and leaves tiny scorch marks wherever it scuttles.
Magmatic_Hermit_Crab.intro: Magmatic Hermit Crab is a Rare fish found in Scoria Reach.

Mahi_Mahi.description: The Mahi Mahi is a vibrant, fast-swimming fish known for its striking colors of blue, green, and yellow. They can be found all around Sunstone island, and is prized by many anglers.
Mahi_Mahi.intro: Mahi Mahi is a Rare fish found in Sunstone Island.

Mained_Lionfish.description: A regal fish with a fiery mane, ruling the coral depths.
Mained_Lionfish.intro: Mained Lionfish is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the First Sea.

Mama_Poot.description: A nurturing Smurf who loves to care for others.
Mama_Poot.intro: Mama Poot is a Limited fish found in the Smurfs Movie Event pools.

Manatee.description: A manatee is a large, slow-moving marine mammal with a rounded body and paddle-like tail. They are herbivores that graze on underwater plants in warm coastal waters.
Manatee.intro: Manatee is a Secret fish found in Terrapin Island.

Mandarinfish.description: A small, ornate fish shimmering in tropical currents.
Mandarinfish.intro: Mandarinfish is an Uncommon fish found in Castaway Cliffs.

Mango.intro: Mango is a Special fish found in any body of water during the 67 Warriors and Mango Admin Events.

Mango_Smoothie.intro: Mango Smoothie is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Mango Admin Event.
trivia: Mango smoothie has the fastest progress speed out of any fish with its unadjustable progress speed of +900%.

Mango_Whale.intro: Mango Whale is a Special fish found in any body of water during the MADNESS and Mango Admin Events.

Manta_Ray.description: Manta Rays are very elegant and remarkably large creatures that coast alongside the coral reefs of Roslit Bay. They move their wing-like fins in a wavy motion to generate enough speed to guide through the ocean. Manta Rays typically feed on small fish during the night.
Manta_Ray.intro: Manta Ray is a Mythical fish found in Roslit Bay.

Mantis_Shrimp.description: A benthic crustacean equipped with powerful raptorial appendages capable of striking prey with immense speed.
Mantis_Shrimp.intro: Mantis Shrimp is a Common fish found at Outer Deep of The Deep.

Marble_Maiden.description: These elegant fish have skin that resembles polished marble, allowing them to blend perfectly with the classical architecture of the depths.
Marble_Maiden.intro: Marble Maiden is an Uncommon fish found in Atlantis.

Mariana%27s_Gauntlets.intro: The Mariana's Gauntlets are a gloves equipment that provides various effects to the player.

Mariana%27s_Skin_Crate.intro: Skins offer a way to change the appearance of player belongings. Currently, they can only be applied to Fishing Rods.

Marrow_Pike.description: An elongated predator that camouflage itself as bleached animal bones sticking out of the wastes.
Marrow_Pike.intro: Marrow Pike is a Unusual fish found in the Drylands.

Marsh_Gar.description: The Marsh Gar is a large vicious marsh water fish that can be found in Mushgrove Swamp. March Gar are extremely strong hunters, using their whiskers to sense prey in foggy waters.
Marsh_Gar.intro: Marsh Gar is a Rare fish found in Mushgrove Swamp.

Marshmallow_Mackerel.description: A sweet mackerel that tastes like toasted marshmallows.

Massive_Marlin.description: A marlin grown to colossal proportions under Poseidon's influence. Its spear-like bill can pierce the strongest materials, and its speed defies its massive size.
Massive_Marlin.intro: Massive Marlin is a Rare fish found in Poseidon Temple.

Meg%27s_Fang.description: The Fang of the Apex Shark, Megalodon

Meg%27s_Spine.description: The Spine of the Apex Shark, Megalodon
Meg%27s_Spine.intro: Meg's Spine is a Mythical Crafting Ingredient found in the Ancient Isle.

Megalodon.description: The Megalodon is a gigantic predatory shark known for its enormous size. It possesses a large mouth with many serrated teeth which can easily rip through anything in its way. They went extinct around 3.6 million years ago, during the early Pliocene epoch. They are one of the apex predators of the Ancient Isle, and will put up an incredible fight when hooked.
Megalodon.intro: Megalodon is an Exotic fish found in the Ancient Isle.
trivia: Catching three Megalodons will award the player the ' Terror of The Depths ' Title.

Megalodon_Egg.intro: Eggs are a type of item obtainable in Fisch. They can be opened to receive items such as Bait and C$, or more rarely contain unique Egg-exclusive items.

Megalodon_Hunt_Totem.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Megamouth_Shark.description: The Megamouth Shark is a rare deep-sea shark that spend much of its life drifting through the darkness with its enormous mouth open, filtering tiny organisms from the water. Despite its strange appearance and massive jaws, it is a slow-moving and harmless creature, only rarely seen near the surface.
Megamouth_Shark.intro: Megamouth Shark is a Mythical fish found in the Ocean during Megamouth Shark Hunts.

Melody_Bridge_Neck.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Mermaid%27s_Favor.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Merry_Manta_Ray.description: Manta ray in a Santa hat, gliding merrily. Spreads joy and wingspans.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Merry Manta Ray adds Santas sack on the back of the fish. When interacted with, it plays a jolly laugh sound effect.

Message_in_a_Bottle.description: A sealed bottle with a secret message inside, carried by summer currents from distant shores.

Metal_Strongbox.description: A large heavy duty crate, lost from some sort of underground civilisation. The date of it's [ sic ] disappearance is unknown. Therefore, finders keepers?- Opening it might give you an array of fish, and money!
Metal_Strongbox.intro: Metal Strongbox is a Rare Crate found in Tidefall.

Meteor_Totem.intro: Totems are a type of consumable item which allows the player to manipulate Weather and start Localized Events. There are currently 28 totems in Fisch, with 2 of them being unobtainable.

Mexican_Tetra.description: A small, schooling characin found in cave pools and streams, often blind in subterranean forms.
Mexican_Tetra.intro: Mexican Tetra is a Common fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Microphone.intro: Microphone is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Disco Dance Admin Event.

Midas%27_Mates_Skin_Crate.intro: Skins offer a way to change the appearance of player belongings. Currently, they can only be applied to Fishing Rods.

Midnight_Axolotl.description: The Midnight Axolotl is a variant of Axolotl that has adapted to the Desolate Deep. Midnight Axolotls are known for their adorable looks and giant size compared to regular Axolotls. They are most commonly seen at night while other fish sleep. It has been theorized that the glowing gills on the sides of their head have evolved, allowing them to use echolocation to see predators in even the darkest waters. Despite being on the lower end of the food chain, they use their agility and abilities to hide within the Desolate Deep. It is currently unknown how many Midnight Axolotls are residing there
Midnight_Axolotl.intro: Midnight Axolotl is a Legendary fish found in the Desolate Deep.
trivia: When caught or appraised with the Shiny attribute, it takes on the appearance of Wumpus, a mascot for the Discord messaging platform. Interacting with it also plays the Discord notification (ping) sound.

Minnow.description: Minnows are found in Roslit Bays pond and are easiest to find during the clear spring days. Minnows are commonly found in schools of 4 to 6 fish. They also create a great baitfish!
Minnow.intro: Minnow is a Common fish found in Roslit Bay.

Minnowse.description: A tiny swimmer with twitching whiskers, scurrying through the shallows.
Minnowse.intro: Minnowse is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the Second Sea.

Mirage_Fin.description: A translucent, shimmering fish whose reflective coating distorts ambient underground light pipelines.
Mirage_Fin.intro: Mirage Fin is an Uncommon fish found in the Drylands.

Mirage_Toadfish.description: A ghostly fish shimmering in the ocean’s depths.
Mirage_Toadfish.intro: Mirage Toadfish is a Mythical fish found in Castaway Cliffs.

Mire_Krakenling.description: A miniature kraken with toxic ink sacs. It ambushes prey in the murky mires of the grove.
Mire_Krakenling.intro: Mire Krakenling is an Unusual fish found in the Toxic Grove.

Mistletoe_Minnow.description: Tiny minnow with mistletoe on its head. Kisses your bait goodbye.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Mistletoe Minnow resembles a piece of mistletoe. When interacted with, it plays a kissing sound effect.

Moby.description: A monstrous whale with a fearsome reputation, known to attack those who dare cross its path
Moby.intro: Moby is a Secret fish found during the Blue Whale Migration event in the Ocean. It is required to obtain a Song of the Deep and The Moby Bobber.
trivia: The Moby is based off the novel " Moby-Dick " by Herman Melville written in 1851 with similar designs to the novel.

Moenkhausia_Pitanga.description: A striking red-finned tetra species named after the pitanga cherry fruit for its deep crimson body coloration.
Moenkhausia_Pitanga.intro: Moenkhausia Pitanga is an Uncommon fish found in the Skycrest.

Molten_Banshee.description: The Molten Banshee is a complex fish of unknown terrestrial origin, that has resided inside the Roslit Volcano. It possesses a torpedo-like body with many sharp mandibles and scorching hot encrustments. They are rumored to have possibly come from another planet, and may be a bio-mechanical lifeform.
Molten_Banshee.intro: Molten Banshee is an Exotic fish found in the Volcano in Roslit Bay.

Molten_Minnow.description: Leaving behind a trail of glowing embers, the Molten Minnow proves to be threatening.
Molten_Minnow.intro: Molten Minnow is a Limited fish found in Roslit Bay 's saltwater during the Ashfall event.

Molten_Moray.description: A long, slender fish with dark, heat-resistant scales. Hot to the touch.
Molten_Moray.intro: Molten Moray is a Rare fish found in Volcanic Vents of Mariana's Veil.

Molten_Ripple.description: A round, cheerful fish, its surface rippling with molten charm.
Molten_Ripple.intro: Molten Ripple is a Secret fish found in the Volcano in Roslit Bay.

Molten_Serpent.description: An ancient serpent whose scales glisten like flowing magma. Legends say it was forged in the heart of a volcano and has swam through lava rivers for millenia.
Molten_Serpent.intro: Molten Serpent is a Mythical fish found in Scoria Reach.

Moltenstripe.description: A fiery-hued fish, marked with streaks of shadow, swift in heated currents.
Moltenstripe.intro: Moltenstripe is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Moneybag.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Monstrous_Cusk.description: A colossal gargantuan relative of the cusk eel, whose terrifying size rivals deep sea leviathans.
Monstrous_Cusk.intro: Monstrous Cusk is an Exotic fish found in the Gloomy Crevice.

Moon.intro: Moon is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Galaxy and MEGA MAYHEM Admin Events.

Moon_Arctic_Char.description: A sleek fish with silvery scales that reflect the moon's gentle glow.
Moon_Arctic_Char.intro: Moon Arctic Char is a Common fish found in Blue Moon events at Snowcap Island.

Moon_Idol.description: A moon shaped stone with an unmatched spirit...
Moon_Idol.intro: Moon Idol is a Secret fish found in Blue Moon events at Snowcap Island.

Moon_Jellyfish.description: A saucer-shaped jellyfish pulsating with soft blue-white luminescence in night ocean tides.
Moon_Jellyfish.intro: Moon Jellyfish is a Legendary fish found in the Astral Observatory - Snowcap Island.

Moon_Wood.description: Legends say, Moon Wood is used in crafting one of the strongest Rods...
Moon_Wood.intro: Moon Wood is a Legendary Crafting Ingredient found at Snowcap Island.

Moonfish.description: The Moonfish is a sizable, flat, bony fish that inhabits deep and occasionally warm waters. While their behaviour resembles that of the Ocean Sunfish, Moonfish are far more aggressive, using their rock-hard skulls to charge at fish, boats, and swimmers.
Moonfish.intro: Moonfish is a Legendary fish found in the Ocean.

Moonridge_Catfish.description: A sleek fish with whiskers that lightly glow like moonlight.
Moonridge_Catfish.intro: Moonridge Catfish is an Unusual fish found in Blue Moon events at Snowcap Island.

Moonstone.description: A white gemstone with a pearlescent shine, typically associated with magic.
Moonstone.intro: Moonstone is a Gemstone found inside Meteors in the Ancient Isle.

Moonveil_Killifish.description: A blue delicate fish with a spotted pattern.
Moonveil_Killifish.intro: Moonveil Killifish is a Common fish found in Blue Moon events at Snowcap Island.

Moonveil_Salmon_School.intro: Moonveil Salmon School is an Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

Moonwalk_Dance_Potion.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Moosewood_Skin_Crate.intro: Skins offer a way to change the appearance of player belongings.

Moray_Eel.description: A sinuous predator with sharp teeth, hiding in reef crevices.
Moray_Eel.intro: Moray Eel is an Unusual fish found in the Tidefall.

Mosaic_Swimmer.description: The scales of these fish form intricate patterns matching the ethereal mosaics. They often gather in groups to create living recreations of the abyss's lost artwork.
Mosaic_Swimmer.intro: Mosaic Swimmer is an Uncommon fish found in Atlantis.

Mosasaurus.description: Mosasaurus is the type genus of the mosasaurs, an extinct group of aquatic squamate reptiles. It exists from about 82 to 66 million years ago during the Campanian and Maastrichtian stages of the Late Cretaceous.
Mosasaurus.intro: Mosasaurus is a Mythical fish found in the Ancient Isle.

Mossjaw.description: A hulking, moss-covered predator that lurks deep within the jungle. Its scales are heavy with age, and its jaws snap through trees as easily as bone. Few dare the temple at night, for the Mossjaw waits there, patient and merciless.
Mossjaw.intro: Mossjaw is an Exotic fish found in the Lost Jungle.
trivia: Catching the Mossjaw rewards the player with the Mossjaw Conquerer  [ sic ] title.

Mossjaw_Jaw.description: A rugged jawbone from an ancient beast, found in Moosewood Island's classic pond.
Mossjaw_Jaw.intro: Mossjaw Jaw is a Limited fish found in Moosewood during the Jungle's Echo event.

Mossjaw_Scapula.description: Some sturdy shoulder blades unearthed from Mushgrove Swamp's murky rivers.
Mossjaw_Scapula.intro: Mossjaw Scapula is a Limited fish found in Mushgrove Swamp during the Jungle's Echo event.

Mossjaw_Skull.description: A weathered, moss-laden skull discovered amidst Forsaken Shores' famous pond.
Mossjaw_Skull.intro: Mossjaw Skull is a Limited fish found in Forsaken Shores during the Jungle's Echo event.

Mossjaw_Spine.description: A massive spine from a prehistoric creature, hidden nearby Sunstone Island.
Mossjaw_Spine.intro: Mossjaw Spine is a Limited fish found in Sunstone Island during the Jungle's Echo event.

Mossjaw_Tail.description: A heavy tailbone recovered from Roslit Bay's fresh waters.
Mossjaw_Tail.intro: Mossjaw Tail is a Limited fish found in Roslit Bay during the Jungle's Echo event.

Mosslurker.description: An ancient, moss-draped titan, its towering shell cradles forests and ruins, moving with the weight of forgotten epochs.
Mosslurker.intro: Mosslurker is an Apex fish found in the Ocean during Apex Fish Hunts.

Mossy_Turkey.description: Blanketed in lush, verdant moss that sways like lily pads, this earthy turkey blends into forested shallows. A not-so fresh, green gobbler for Fischgiving feasting!
Mossy_Turkey.intro: Mossy Turkey is a Limited fish found in Terrapin Island during the Fischgiving 2 event.
trivia: The Shiny Mossy Turkey is based on the Developer Cyz (@cyzrioz).

Motoro_Stingray.description: A patterned freshwater stingray gliding silently along the riverbed.
Motoro_Stingray.intro: Motoro Stingray is a Mythical fish found in the Lost Jungle.

Mourning_Manta_Ray.description: This Manta Ray has been through some things, hope it gets well soon <3.

Moxie.description: A bold Smurf full of courage and spunk.

Mr._Bones.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Mr._Tentacles.description: ZOMG WHAT IS THAT ON YOUR HEAD!!!!! ITS OVAR 9000!!!!!!!!!111111111111111 *HEAD EXPLODES FROM EPIKNESS*
Mr._Tentacles.intro: Mr. Tentacles is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Tentacles Admin Event.

Mrs._Tentacles.description: She eats people, but is otherwise very charming.
Mrs._Tentacles.intro: Mrs. Tentacles is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Tentacles Admin Event.

Mullet.description: The Mullet is a streamlined, silver-scaled fish known for its schooling behaviour and preference for shallow coastal and freshwater environments. Mullets are agile swimmers with a forked tail and a tough, sturdy body, making them a popular catch for beginners and seasoned anglers alike.
Mullet.intro: Mullet is a Common fish found in the Ocean.

Murkback_Bass.description: A heavy bass cloaked in shadowy tones, moving slow but deliberate.
Murkback_Bass.intro: Murkback Bass is a Uncommon fish found in the Hades' Underworld of Indefinite.

Murkdrifter.description: A green fish drifting through murky depths, a silent wanderer of the shadowed waters.
Murkdrifter.intro: Murkdrifter is an Extinct fish found in Lushgrove.

Murkfin.description: A swamp-colored fish with blue fins, lurking in murky shallows.
Murkfin.intro: Murkfin is an Extinct fish found in the Azure Lagoon.

Murkslither.description: A slippery terror that moves unseen through the murk.
Murkslither.intro: Murkslither is an Uncommon fish found in the Cursed Isle, and formerly in The Cursed Shores.

Murky_Thread.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Murky_Turkey.description: Lurking in stagnant swamp waters, this bog-dwelling turkey is covered in slimy algae and sprouting glowing mushrooms from its back and tail. A turkey truly capable of an earthy Fischgiving roast!
Murky_Turkey.intro: Murky Turkey is a Limited fish found in Mushgrove Swamp during the Fischgiving 2 event.
trivia: The Shiny Murky Turkey is based on the Developer Lyth (@newandreformedlyth).

Mushgrove_Crab.description: The Mushgrove Crab is a rare species of crab. They have fully adapted to the Mushgrove Swamp and commonly eat off of the massive fungal life that has over taken the swamp.
Mushgrove_Crab.intro: Mushgrove Crab is a Rare fish found in Mushgrove Swamp.

Musical_Crab.description: A tiny crab with a shell that hums musical notes, scuttling through the Crystal Cove, only caught by the craftiest traps.
Musical_Crab.intro: Musical Crab is a Mythical fish found in the Crystal Cove.
trivia: Interacting with a Musical Crab will play a piano audio.

Mussel.description: Mussels are small mollusc that can be easily found on rocks, near beaches, and near docks. They actually have one food and have very limited movement, so most mussels stay in one place their entire lives.. that's boring!
Mussel.intro: Mussel is a Common fish found in the Ocean.

Mustard.description: A bulbous and rotund yellow pufferfish.
Mustard.intro: Mustard is a Secret fish found in the Ocean.
trivia: Mustard plays the 'Mouse Squeak' sound from Undertale when used.
The Shiny variant of Mustard was made to resemble the avatar of Not_Nert.

Mustard_Hat.description: it seems to have infinite mustard...
Mustard_Hat.intro: Mustard Hat is a Special fish found in any body of water during the 67 Warriors and MADNESS Admin Events.

Mutated_Crystal_Shrimp.description: A radiant shrimp adorned with crystalline growths, glowing vibrantly in the Crystal Cove, only caught by clever traps.
Mutated_Crystal_Shrimp.intro: Mutated Crystal Shrimp is a Rare fish found in the Crystal Cove.

Mutated_Shark.description: A massive, mutated shark with glowing scars, extra fins, and an unsettling, aggressive nature. While it's named [ sic ] suggests it being a shark, it is actually more related to alligators. Using it's [ sic ] sleek body and its strong legs to pounce on unsuspecting prey.
Mutated_Shark.intro: Mutated Shark is a Mythical fish found in The Depths of Vertigo.

Mutation_Totem.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Mycotide_Serpent.description: A serpentine horror woven from mycelium and toxins. Its bite causes instant necrosis.
Mycotide_Serpent.intro: Mycotide Serpent is a Legendary fish found in the Toxic Grove during Toxic Boils.

Myloplus_Sauron.description: A disk-shaped pacu relative boasting a dark vertical stripe and orange-red fin margins resembling the Eye of Sauron.
Myloplus_Sauron.intro: Myloplus Sauron is an Unusual fish found in Skycrest.

Mysterious_Seed.intro: The Jungle Expansion Countdown was a short one-week event in preparation for the Jungle Expansion Update, being added on February 28th, 2026 and featuring a "hype timer" for global luck boosts starting on March 6th.

Mysterious_Skull.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Mystic_Mirror.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Mythic_Fish.description: The Mythic Fish is an extremely rare and beautiful fish. They swim gracefully in couples of two near the surface of the ocean water. They seem weak, but they can oddly put up a strong fight when being caught. This is due to the other Mythic Fish attempting to aid it's partner by pulling it off the hook.
Mythic_Fish.intro: Mythic Fish is a Mythical fish found in the Ocean.

Mythical_Essence.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Napoleonfish.description: The Napoleonfish, also known as the Humphead Wrasse, is a large and brightly coloured fish with a distinctive bump on its forehead. Despite its size, it is surprisingly agile, making it a thrilling challenge for anglers.
Napoleonfish.intro: Napoleonfish is a Rare fish found in Sunstone Island.
trivia: The Shiny Napoleonfish is most likely an imitation of American rapper Travis Scott.

Narwhal.description: A peculiar Arctic whale particularly known for its long, spiral tusk that resembles a unicorn horn.
Narwhal.intro: Narwhal is an Apex fish found in the Ocean during Narwhal Hunts.

Nautilus.description: An ancient, spiral-shelled mollusc with a glowing & graceful body, tentacle-filled movements. The Nautilus is an elusive octopus that creates a thick, spiral-shaped shell around its body for protection.
Nautilus.intro: Nautilus is a Legendary fish found in The Depths of Vertigo.

Nebulous_Comb_Jelly.description: A deep hollow ctenophore pulsing with violet and cyan nebula-like cloud patterns.
Nebulous_Comb_Jelly.intro: Nebulous Comb Jelly is a Rare fish found in the Astral Observatory - Boreal Hollow.

Nectar_Koi.description: A shimmering koi that feeds on sweet nectar. Found in an abundance near the Nectar Den entrance.
Nectar_Koi.intro: Nectar Koi is an Unusual fish found in Living Garden.

Neon_Tetra.description: A shimmering blue and red minnow darting in jungle streams.
Neon_Tetra.intro: Neon Tetra is a Common fish found in the Lost Jungle.

Neptune%27s_Nibbler.description: These small, vibrant fish are known for nibbling on the enchanted coral that grows in the ethereal abyss. Their diet gives them a slight blue glow at night.
Neptune%27s_Nibbler.intro: Neptune's Nibbler is a Common fish found in Atlantis.

Nessie.description: Nessie is thought to be a complete myth. Little did these anglers know, you found the impossible catch... Nessie... Only obtainable during FischFright
Nessie.intro: Nessie is a Limited fish found in Frightful Pools during the FischFright 1 event.
trivia: While 'Nessie' is a reference to the Loch Ness Monster of Scottish folklore, the model itself closely resembles the Nessie plushies from Apex Legends.

Nessie%27s_Spine.description: A mythical vertebra said to belong to the Nessie.
Nessie%27s_Spine.intro: Nessie's Spine is a Limited fish found in any body of water.

Net_Wolffish.description: A fierce guardian of the sea's ancient riches.
Net_Wolffish.intro: Net Wolffish is a Rare fish found in Treasure Island.

New_Years_Firework.intro: New Years Countdown was a New Years-themed Event lasting from December 31, 2025 - January 3, 2026.

New_Years_Firework_Rocket.intro: New Years Countdown was a New Years-themed Event lasting from December 31, 2025 - January 3, 2026.

Nico.intro: Nico is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Nico Invasion Admin Event.

Nico_Potion.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Night_Shrimp.description: Night Shrimp are small, versatile crustaceans that can be found in an abundance in Vertigo's calm water. night Shrimp are predominantly diurnal, making day fishing the most effective time.
Night_Shrimp.intro: Night Shrimp is a Common fish found in Vertigo.

Nkosi_Pygmy_Pipehorse.description: A miniature syngnathid with cryptic camouflage matching deep sea gorgonian corals.
Nkosi_Pygmy_Pipehorse.intro: Nkosi Pygmy Pipehorse is an Unusual fish found at Outer Deep of The Deep.

No_Name.description: A mysterious Smurf with an unknown identity.
No_Name.intro: No Name is a Limited fish found in the Smurfs Movie Event pools.

Noise-Cancelling_Headphones.intro: The Noise-Cancelling Headphones are a miscellaneous equipment that can be used to disable all modified fish chances from Admin Events.

Northern_Krill.description: A tiny pelagic crustacean schooling in vast numbers beneath night moonlit ice sheets.
Northern_Krill.intro: Northern Krill is a Common fish found in the Astral Observatory - Snowcap Island.

Northern_Pike.description: An aggressive ambush predator sporting mottled olive markings that blend into sub-surface pine roots.
Northern_Pike.intro: Northern Pike is a Rare fish found in the Boreal Pines - Astral Cavern.

Northern_Snakehead.description: A fierce predator with a head like a snake and lungs for air.
Northern_Snakehead.intro: Northern Snakehead is a Rare fish found in the Lost Jungle.

Northstar_Serpent.description: The Northstar Serpent is an insanely large and menacing sea serpent species. They have a long and spiny body, with bioluminescent fins throught it. Near their heads, they have six large tentacle-like appendages, which are spun in a screw motion to move at incredible speeds. Attempting to catch the Northstar Serpent will almost always result in catastrophe, those who are capable of hooking and catching such a formidable beast are truly legendary anglers.
Northstar_Serpent.intro: Northstar Serpent is a Limited fish found in the Winter Village during the Fischmas (2024) event.
trivia: Northstar Serpent may be a reference to the Gargantuan Leviathan, a Subnautica creature from a mod called Return of the Ancients

Northstar_Whale.description: Majestic whale glowing like the North Star. Guides lost fish home... or your boat.

Noxious_Catalyst.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Nuke.intro: Nukes are a localized event in Fisch that allows the player to catch the Nuclear Mutation when fished in.

Nurse_Shark.description: Nurse Sharks are a nocturnal bottom feeder, spending most of their time on the ocean floor or in small crevices. Despite their appearance, they are gentle and slow-moving. Nurse Sharks can 'suction feed', using their powerful jaws to scrape algae off surfaces.
Nurse_Shark.intro: Nurse Shark is an Unusual fish found in the Ocean.

Nutcracker_Catfish.description: Catfish dressed as nutcracker. Cracks nuts and your patience.
Nutcracker_Catfish.intro: Nutcracker Catfish is a Limited fish found in the Glacial Ridge during the Fischmas (2025) event.

O%27Mango_Goldgrin.description: An orange fish sporting circular glasses, it grins through warm waters with a St. Patrick's golden glow!
O%27Mango_Goldgrin.intro: O'Mango Goldgrin is a Limited fish found within orange-colored abundances during the Lucky Event.

Oak_Stripetail.description: A resilient striker with a tail of oak strength.
Oak_Stripetail.intro: Oak Stripetail is an Extinct fish found in Pine Shoals.

Oakling.description: An Oakling that seems to have fallen into a lake in the Everturn Forest! It seems pretty docile...
Oakling.intro: Oakling is a Secret fish found in the Everturn Forest

Oarfish.description: The Oarfish is a massive, snake-like creatures that dwell in the deep ocean. they are often mistaken for sea serpents or mythical creatures. Their presence is considered an omen by many ancient cultures.
Oarfish.intro: Oarfish is a Mythical fish found in the Ocean.

Obsidian.description: Maybe with ten of these i can make a portal!!
Obsidian.intro: Obsidian is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Volcano Admin Event.
trivia: The bestiary entry and catch quip are a reference to Minecraft, where 10 obsidian are required to make a Nether Portal.

Obsidian_Fragment.description: A fragment of Obsidian; it seems to have unnatural powers...
Obsidian_Fragment.intro: Obsidian Fragment is a Fragment found in Scoria Reach.

Obsidian_Koi.description: A sleek fish, its fins flowing like dark, polished glass.
Obsidian_Koi.intro: Obsidian Koi is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Obsidian_Pearl.description: A strikingly shiny pearl, rumored to have originated from the deepest depths of Atlantis.
Obsidian_Pearl.intro: Obsidian Pearl is a Mythical fish found in Lava Clams at a 1.504% chance.

Obsidian_Ray.description: A magnificent ray with wings like polished obsidian, gliding silently through the darkest depths. Its underside pulses with a soft, rhythmic glow, like cooling magma.
Obsidian_Ray.intro: Obsidian Ray is a Mythical fish found in Scoria Reach.

Obsidian_Salmon.description: The Obsidian Salmon is an extremely rare breed of Sockeye Salmon. The Obsidian Salmon breeds extremely deep in the heart of Roslit Volcano. They are extremely strong and are twice as dense as a common Sockeye Salmon.
Obsidian_Salmon.intro: Obsidian Salmon is a Legendary fish found in the Volcano in Roslit Bay.

Obsidian_Swordfish.description: Swordfish are extremely strong and notable due to their long flattened bill that resembles a sword, as their name implies. This swordfish has adapted to it's magma filled life, and is now imbued with Obsidian skin.
Obsidian_Swordfish.intro: Obsidian Swordfish is a Mythical fish found in the Volcano in Roslit Bay.
trivia: This fish is potentially a reference to the Obsidian Swordfish from the game Terraria.

Ocean_Triggerfish.description: A bold striker prowling stormy ocean depths.
Ocean_Triggerfish.intro: Ocean Triggerfish is an Extinct fish found in Gilded Arch.

Octophant.description: A massive creature with strong tusks, sifting the ocean floor with ancient grace.
Octophant.intro: Octophant is a Limited fish found in Octophant Hunts in the Second Sea.

Oil_Sardine.description: A small, oily fish that forms massive, shimmering schools.
Oil_Sardine.intro: Oil Sardine is a Common fish found in Crowned Ruins.

Oilfish.description: A deep-water fish with oily indigestible flesh. A challenging catch.
Oilfish.intro: Oilfish is an Unusual fish found in Sunken Reliquary.

Olm.description: The Olm is an aquatic salamander which is an exclusively cave-dwelling species. The olm is mostly found in dark and moist areas of freshwater. They are most notable for their adaptations to a life of darkness with-in their caves. The Olm has severely under underdeveloped eyes, leaving it blind. This blindness gives them an acute sense of smell and hearing.
Olm.intro: Olm is a Legendary fish found in Terrapin Island.

Olmdeer.description: The Olmdeer is a unique species of Olm, possessing two antlers on its head like those of a reindeer, hence its name. They have been heard to lead Santa's sleigh through the night sky.
Olmdeer.intro: Olmdeer is a Limited fish found in the Winter Village during the Fischmas 1 event.

Olympian_Devil.description: A divine anomaly—neither god nor creature—formed from the collapse of Olympian power itself.
Olympian_Devil.intro: Olympian Devil is a Secret fish found in Olympian Fissure during Olympian Devil Hunt.

Omnithal.description: A bioluminescent leviathan with multiple glowing eyes, said to guard the deepest, oldest wrecks.
Omnithal.intro: Omnithal is an Exotic fish found in Sunken Reliquary.

One_Leaf_Clover.intro: Shamrock Seas was a seasonal event on Fisch which was a St. Patrick's Day-themed Event which lasted from March 14, 2026 - March 21, 2026. It featured a new Event area with new NPCs, unique quests and Event fish.

Onychodus.description: Onychodus is a genus of prehistoric lobe-finned fish from the Devonian period, approximately 400 million years ago. Known for its distinctive features, Onychodus was an early example of sarcopterygian fish, which includes ancestors of modern lungfish and tetrapods.
Onychodus.intro: Onychodus is an Uncommon fish found in the Ancient Isle.

Opah.description: A large, disc-shaped, warm-blooded fish with stunning bright red fins.
Opah.intro: Opah is a Rare fish found in Collapsed Ruins.

Opal.description: An iridescent gemstone with an array of different colors.
Opal.intro: Opal is a Gemstone found inside Meteors in the Ancient Isle.

Opalescent_Catfish.description: This shimmering catfish glides through Crystal Cove with iridescent scales that reflect the clear waters of spring and winter, its whisker-like fins glowing softly.
Opalescent_Catfish.intro: Opalescent Catfish is a Rare fish found in the Crystal Cove.
trivia: When caught or appraised with the Shiny attribute, it takes on the appearance of a cat, with added cat ears and eyes. Interacting with it also plays a 'Meow' sound.

Oracle%27s_Eye.description: These unusual fish have eye-like patterns that seem to shimmer with prophetic visions. Ancient mystics believed they could see glimpses of the future in their scales.
Oracle%27s_Eye.intro: Oracle's Eye is an Unusual fish found in Atlantis.

Oracle_Minnow.description: These prophetic little fish are said to gather where important events will occur. Ancient civilizations would watch their schooling patterns to predict the future.
Oracle_Minnow.intro: Oracle Minnow is a Common fish found in Atlantis.

Orange_Conch.intro: Fischfest 2 is a summer-themed Event which lasts from June 20th until September 5th, 2026. The event features a new island which can be accessed through the use of the Magical Conch, several NPCs, and a new 'Sunshells' currency which can be exchanged for limited items.

Orange_Frightful_Skull.intro: FischFright (2025) is the Halloween-themed annual event that occured during 2025 which lasted from October 18, 2025 - November 3, 2025. It featured the Crook's Hallow, new NPCs with unique quests and new Event fishes.

Orange_Message_in_a_Bottle.intro: Fischfest 2 is a summer-themed Event which lasts from June 20th until September 5th, 2026. The event features a new island which can be accessed through the use of the Magical Conch, several NPCs, and a new 'Sunshells' currency which can be exchanged for limited items.

Orca.description: Orcas tend to migrate from time to time.
Orca.intro: Orca is an Exotic fish found during the Orca Migration event in the Ocean.

Orca_Egg.intro: Eggs are a type of items obtainable in Fisch. They can be opened to receive items such as Bait and C$, or more rarely contain unique Egg-exclusive items.

Orcanda.description: A large, slow-moving beast with a dorsal fin that cuts through the sea like a plow.
Orcanda.intro: Orcanda is a Limited fish found in Octophant Hunts in the Second Sea.

Orchid_Anglerfish.description: Lures prey with an orchid-like esca that blooms hypnotically.
Orchid_Anglerfish.intro: Orchid Anglerfish is a Rare fish found in Living Garden.

Oreochima.description: A sleek, predatory fish of Jurassic waters.

Ornament_Fish.description: An decorative ornament in the shape of a fish. Seems to exhibit signs of low intelligence.
Ornament_Fish.intro: Ornament Fish is a Limited fish found in the Winter Village during the Fischmas 1 event.

Ornament_Pufferfish.description: Pufferfish puffed up like a shiny ornament. Pops with holiday bling.
Ornament_Pufferfish.intro: Ornament Pufferfish is a Limited fish found in the Glacial Ridge during the Fischmas 2 event.

Oscar_Cichlid.description: A bold, patterned cichlid with fiery orange patches.
Oscar_Cichlid.intro: Oscar Cichlid is an Unusual fish found in the Lost Jungle.

Oversized_Leaf.description: Just a really big leaf. Floats around annoyingly.
Oversized_Leaf.intro: Oversized Leaf is a Trash fish found in the Living Garden.

Oyster.description: Oysters are bivalve molluscs with rough, irregularly shaped shells. They are typically found in clusters, attached to submerged rocks and roots. They can be found all over Terapin Islands; The Oysters help filter the water of Terrapin, leaving making it nearly a freshwater island.
Oyster.intro: Oyster is an Uncommon fish found in the Ocean.

Oyster_Toadfish.description: A sneaky ambush predator lurking in oyster beds and muddy bottoms.
Oyster_Toadfish.intro: Oyster Toadfish is an Extinct fish found in Whale Interior.

Ozark_Cavefish.description: A translucent, blind cavefish from Ozark karst aquifers.
Ozark_Cavefish.intro: Ozark Cavefish is a Legendary fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Pacific_Blackdragon.description: A sexually dimorphic deep-sea predator; females possess long, slender black bodies with light-producing organs along their belly.
Pacific_Blackdragon.intro: Pacific Blackdragon is a Rare fish found at Outer Deep of The Deep.

Pacific_Flatnose.description: A deep-water morid fish possessing a flattened snout and sensitive barbels to search soft sediment.
Pacific_Flatnose.intro: Pacific Flatnose is an Uncommon fish found in the Gloomy Crevice.

Pacific_Footballfish.description: A globose anglerfish species whose females display a luminous esca lure to draw in unsuspecting prey.
Pacific_Footballfish.intro: Pacific Footballfish is an Uncommon fish found at Lower Deep of The Deep.

Pacific_Hatchetfish.description: A delicate mesopelagic fish featuring tube-shaped eyes aimed upward to detect prey silhouettes.
Pacific_Hatchetfish.intro: Pacific Hatchetfish is a Mythical fish found at Outer Deep of The Deep.

Pacific_Longnose_Chimaera.description: A strange cartilaginous fish with an elongated, pointed paddle-like snout used to detect electrical fields.
Pacific_Longnose_Chimaera.intro: Pacific Longnose Chimaera is a Rare fish found at Lower Deep of The Deep.

Palaeoniscum.description: Palaeoniscum is an ancient ray-finned fish from the Early Permian period, approximately 290 million years ago. Known for its robust ganoid scales and streamlined body, it represents early actinopterygian evolution, the ancestor of most modern fish.
Palaeoniscum.intro: Palaeoniscum is an Unusual fish found in the Ancient Archives.

Pale_Crevice_Tang.description: The Pale Crevice Tang is a warped relative of the Pale Tang, adapted to the waters around the altar's breach. Its washed out body and thin blue veins suggest it has been exposed to leaking Keeper power for far too long.
Pale_Crevice_Tang.intro: Pale Crevice Tang is an Uncommon fish found in Enchanted Crevice.

Pale_Ghost_Lumpfish.description: A round, pallid fish that clings to ice with an eerie, spectral presence.
Pale_Ghost_Lumpfish.intro: Pale Ghost Lumpfish is an Uncommon fish found in Blue Moon events at Snowcap Island.

Pale_Tang.description: The Pale Tang is a relatively common catch within Keepers Altar. Very similar to other Tangs such as the Red Tang, just pale!- No one is sure of the Pale Tangs origin, and how it got accustomed to the Keepers Altar.
Pale_Tang.intro: Pale Tang is an Uncommon fish found in the Keepers Altar.

Papa_Smurf.description: The wise leader of the Smurf village.
Papa_Smurf.intro: Papa Smurf is a Limited fish found in the Smurfs Movie Event pools.

Papillated_Redbait.description: A small red-pigmented fish found schooling along upper bathyal slopes.
Papillated_Redbait.intro: Papillated Redbait is an Uncommon fish found at Outer Deep of The Deep.

Paradise_Relic.description: A relic that hums with the energy of paradise. Smells faintly of sweet drinks and secrets.
Paradise_Relic.intro: Paradise Relic is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Paradox_Piranha.intro: Paradox Piranha is a Divine Secret fish found rarely at Lost Jungle.

Parasite.intro: Parasite is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Aliens Admin Event.

Paresca_Whipnose_Anglerfish.description: An anglerfish with an exceptionally long, whip-like lure extending far past its body snout.
Paresca_Whipnose_Anglerfish.intro: Paresca Whipnose Anglerfish is an Uncommon fish found at Lower Deep of The Deep.

Parktail_Spinesnapper.description: A fierce snapper with a tail born of parkland fury.
Parktail_Spinesnapper.intro: Parktail Spinesnapper is an Extinct fish found in Pine Shoals.

Parotocinclus_Halys.description: A small armored catfish with mottled golden-brown plating, native to fast-flowing streams of northeastern Brazil.
Parotocinclus_Halys.intro: Parotocinclus Halys is an Uncommon fish found in the Skycrest.

Parrotfish.description: A vibrant fish with a beak, squawking through the coral reefs.
Parrotfish.intro: Parrotfish is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the Second Sea.

Party_Cooler.description: A cooler packed with cold drinks, bobbing along after the cookout.
Party_Cooler.intro: Party Cooler is a Limited fish found in the Patriotic Seas.

Patriot_Whale_Shark.description: A gentle giant draped in bunting, cruising the bay for the celebration.
Patriot_Whale_Shark.intro: Patriot Whale Shark is a Limited fish found in the Patriotic Seas.

Payara.description: The vampire fish, with enormous fangs jutting from its jaws.
Payara.intro: Payara is a Rare fish found in the Lost Jungle.

Peacock_Squid.description: A small glass squid with vivid chromatophores and bioluminescent spots along its transparent body.
Peacock_Squid.intro: Peacock Squid is a Common fish found in the Astral Observatory - Boreal Hollow.

Pearl.description: A common pearl with some imperfections. [Contribution by @Johnny_D3pp]
Pearl.intro: Pearl is a Common fish found in Clams behind Roslit Bay at a 46.99% chance.

Pearl-Plated_Pleco.description: A peaceful armored catfish with an iridescent, mother-of-pearl sheen on its bony scutes.
Pearl-Plated_Pleco.intro: Pearl-Plated Pleco is a Common fish found in Calm Zone of Mariana's Veil.

Pelagic_Cod.description: A silvery fish that schools in open water far from the bottom.
Pelagic_Cod.intro: Pelagic Cod is a Common fish found in the Tidefall.

Pelican_Eel.description: A deadly blue eel with a giant mouth and sharp teeth, swallowing the ocean whole.
Pelican_Eel.intro: Pelican Eel is an Extinct fish found in the Open Ocean.

Penguin.description: A playful penguin, waddling gracefully on the icy slopes. Rarely caught, it’s known for its curious nature and habit of stealing from traps.
Penguin.intro: Penguin is a Mythical fish found in Snowburrow inside of Snowcap Island.

Pengwhal.description: A sleek swimmer with a horned snout, waddling through icy seas.
Pengwhal.intro: Pengwhal is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the Second Sea.

Peppermint_Pike.description: A feisty pike striped like peppermint candy. Bites with a minty fresh snap!
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Peppermint Pike resembles a circle peppermint candy. When interacted with, it plays a licking sound effect.

Perch.description: The Perch is a common freshwater fish that is best found in Roslit Bays fresh water. They are known for their striped bodies and a playful behaviour.
Perch.intro: Perch is a Common fish found in Roslit Bay.

Petal_Ray.description: A graceful ray with wings covered in flowers. It glides through floral currents, pollinating as it hunts.
Petal_Ray.intro: Petal Ray is a Mythical fish found in Living Garden.

Petaldrift_Koi.description: A drifting koi with soft petals that float away as it swims, carried by spring breezes.
Petaldrift_Koi.intro: Petaldrift Koi is an Unusual fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Petrified_Ammonite.description: The heavy, fossilized spiral shell of a prehistoric marine creature long swallowed by the desert expansion.
Petrified_Ammonite.intro: Petrified Ammonite is a Common fish found in the Drylands.

Phanerorhynchus.description: Phanerorhynchus is an extinct, predatory fish from the Late Devonian period. Known for its elongated body and sharp, backward-curving teeth, it was a formidable predator in ancient aquatic ecosystems.
Phanerorhynchus.intro: Phanerorhynchus is a Rare fish found in the Ancient Archives.

Phantom_Brine.description: A grey-green fish with translucent fins, haunting the briny depths.
Phantom_Brine.intro: Phantom Brine is a Extinct fish found in the Azure Lagoon.

Phantom_Jellyfish.description: A ghostly jellyfish that floats ethereally through the water.
Phantom_Jellyfish.intro: Phantom Jellyfish is a Limited fish found in Frightful Pools during the FischFright 2025 event.

Phantom_Koi.description: A white koi with grey accents and ornate fins, a spectral beauty of the depths.
Phantom_Koi.intro: Phantom Koi is an Extinct fish found in the Isle of New Beginnings.

Phantom_Megalodon.description: The Phantom Meg is a spectral version of the ancient Megalodon, haunting the waters with an ethereal glow. Its serrated teeth remain just as fearsome, tearing through anything in its way. Though extinct for millions of years, this ghostly apex predator dominates the Ancient Isle and will challenge any angler brave enough to hook it.
Phantom_Megalodon.intro: Phantom Megalodon is a Limited fish found in the Ancient Isle.
trivia: Catching a Phantom Megalodon will award the player with the ' Nightmare Conqueror ' Title.
Catching 3 Phantom Megalodons and keeping them in the inventory will award the player with the ' Deep Sea Phenomenon ' Title.

Phantom_Ray.description: The Phantom Ray is a menacing yet beautiful species of ray, resembling the shape of an anchor with bioluminescent engravings throughout its body, as well as a translucent fin that they use to move around. They typically like to feed on microorganisms during the night, and spend most of the day sitting underneath ledges or large vegetation.
Phantom_Ray.intro: Phantom Ray is an Uncommon fish found in the Desolate Deep.

Philosopher%27s_Fish.description: These contemplative creatures gather in ancient libraries. They swim in complex patterns that some scholars believe correspond to mathematical formulas.
Philosopher%27s_Fish.intro: Philosopher's Fish is an Unusual fish found in Atlantis.

Photic_Terrosunder.description: A blinding, luminescent variant of the sand king. The Photic Terrosunder converts absorbed desert sun rays into pure heat energy, burning all who challenge its lineage.
Photic_Terrosunder.intro: Photic Terrosunder is a Secret fish found in the Drylands.

Pickaxe.intro: The Pickaxe is a Reusable Item that can be used to break open ice in the Northern Expedition.

Piglet_Pike.description: A stout fish with a snout, wallowing in the muddy depths.
Piglet_Pike.intro: Piglet Pike is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the First Sea.

Pike.description: Pikes are a freshwater predator known for its elongated body, sharp teeth, and aggressive hunting behaviour. It's a voracious carnivore that preys on smaller fish, frogs, and even small mammals near the water's edge. Pikes have a unique ability to ambush their prey by remaining almost motionless in the water, then striking with incredible speed to catch their meal.
Pike.intro: Pike is an Unusual fish found in Moosewood.

Pilgrim_Hat.description: It seem's Pilgrim lost his hat at sea...
Pilgrim_Hat.intro: Pilgrim Hat is a Limited fish found during the Fischgiving 2 event.

Pine_Tree.intro: Pine Tree is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Buffed Overgrowth and Overgrowth Admin Events.

Pine_Zephyrfish.description: A swift zephyr that dances with pine’s might.
Pine_Zephyrfish.intro: Pine Zephyrfish is a Extinct fish found in Pine Shoals.

Pineapple_Pufferfish.description: A festive tropical pufferfish covered in spiky yellow diamond scales and topped with a crown of leafy green dorsal fins.
Pineapple_Pufferfish.intro: Pineapple Pufferfish is a Limited fish found in the Skycrest.

Pineapple_Punch.intro: Fischfest 2 is a summer-themed Event that lasts from June 20th until September 12th, 2026. The event features a new island that can be accessed using the Magical Conch, several NPCs, and a new Sunshells currency, which can be exchanged for limited items.

Pink-Spotted_Shrimpgoby.description: A burrowing marine goby featuring iridescent pink spots that shares sandy burrows with snapping pistol shrimp.
Pink-Spotted_Shrimpgoby.intro: Pink-Spotted Shrimpgoby is an Unusual fish found in the Skycrest.

Pink_Betta.description: A vibrant pink betta with flowing fins that shimmer like Valentine's ribbons, fiercely territorial yet beautifully romantic.
Pink_Betta.intro: Pink Betta is a Limited fish found in Lovestorm Turtle Pools during the Valentides 2 event.

Pink_Blossom.intro: Valentides (2026) was a seasonal event on Fisch which contributed to the 2026 Valentines which lasted from February 7, 2026 - February 21, 2026. It featured a new Event area with new NPCs, unique quests, puzzles and Event fishes.

Pink_Conch.intro: Fischfest 2 is a summer-themed Event that lasts from June 20th until September 12th, 2026. The event features a new island that can be accessed using the Magical Conch, several NPCs, and a new Sunshells currency, which can be exchanged for limited items.

Pioneer_Turkey.description: Wearing a weathered bucket hat covered in dangling fish hooks, this old-school turkey proudly sports the classic look. The original fisching pioneer, now ready to be the centerpiece of your Fischgiving feast!
Pioneer_Turkey.intro: Pioneer Turkey is a Limited fish found at Moosewood during the Fischgiving 2 event.
trivia: The Shiny Pioneer Turkey is based on the Creator Nate (@WoozyNate).

Piraiba.description: A giant catfish of the Amazon, stretching meters long.
Piraiba.intro: Piraiba is a Legendary fish found in the Lost Jungle.

Piranha.description: Piranhas are aggressive fish with incredibly sharp teeth, which they use to hunt their prey. Ranking high on the local food chain, they are still no match for the larger and fiercer apex predators of the Ancient Isle.
Piranha.intro: Piranha is a Common fish found in the Ancient Isle.

Piranhamunk.description: A chittering fish with razor teeth, gnawing through the shadows.
Piranhamunk.intro: Piranhamunk is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the First Sea.

Pirarucu.description: The Arapaima, a colossal air-breathing fish of the Amazon.
Pirarucu.intro: Pirarucu is a Legendary fish found in the Lost Jungle.

Pirate_Captain%27s_Goldfish.description: A mythical, elusive goldfish found beneath waterfalls, said to bring fortune to rare finders.
Pirate_Captain%27s_Goldfish.intro: Pirate Captain's Goldfish is a Secret fish found in Forsaken Shores.

Pirate_Turkey.description: This swashbuckling buccaneer of the ponds sports an eyepatch, tricorn hat, peg leg, and a thirst for treasure in the form of your bait. Arrr, but even pirates make fine Fischgiving dinners!
Pirate_Turkey.intro: Pirate Turkey is a Limited fish found at Forsaken Shores during the Fischgiving (2025) event.
trivia: The Shiny Pirate Turkey is based on the Lead Developer Nicholas (@animepunk).

Pitchshift_Reel.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Pizza_(Item).intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Planterech.description: A toxic leech with tendrils that plant spores into the sediment. Thrives in the toxic muck near splashes.
Planterech.intro: Planterech is an Unusual fish found in the Toxic Grove.

Plastic_Shovel.description: The flimsiest digging tool known to beachcombers. Breaks if you look at it wrong.
Plastic_Shovel.intro: Plastic Shovel is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Plesiosaur.description: A prehistoric marine reptile, long necked and powerful, thought extinct for millions of years.
Plesiosaur.intro: The Plesiosaur is an Exotic fish found in the Tidefall Castle.

Pliosaur.description: A monstrous marine reptile from the age of dinosaurs, with a skull larger than a man and jaws built to crush.
Pliosaur.intro: Pliosaur is an Exotic fish found in Collapsed Ruins.
trivia: Pliosaur is based on the real-life prehistoric marine reptile Pliosaurus.

Plumrick_O%27Luck.description: A hefty purple fish with stylish shades, it glides through pools where St. Patrick's luck runs deep!
Plumrick_O%27Luck.intro: Plumrick O'Luck is a Limited fish found within purple-colored abundances during the Lucky Event.

Pogo_Stick.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Poisonous_Spearhead.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Polar_Alligator.description: A fearsome predator adapted to icy waters, with frost-covered scales and crystal-like teeth.
Polar_Alligator.intro: Polar Alligator is a Legendary fish found in the Frigid Cavern.

Polar_Cod.description: The Polar Cod is a small, abundant fish adapted to icy Arctic waters, often found under sea ice.
Polar_Cod.intro: Polar Cod is an Uncommon fish found in Boreal Pines.

Polar_Prowler.description: A sleek, predatory fish that hunts in the freezing cold with unmatched speed.
Polar_Prowler.intro: Polar Prowler is a Legendary fish found in the Challenger's Deep of Mariana's Veil.

Pollen_Guppy.description: A tiny guppy dusted in golden pollen that leaves a shimmering trail in the water.
Pollen_Guppy.intro: Pollen Guppy is a Common fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Pollock.description: Pollock are sleek, silver fish with a light belly contrasting a darker dorsal. They are fast swimmers and often found feeding under Snowcap Islands docks.
Pollock.intro: Pollock is a Common fish found in Snowcap Island.

Poltergeist.description: A malevolent and chaotic spirit with destructive power, capable of violently hurling objects, manipulating environments, and instilling terror through aggressive, unpredictable disturbances.
Poltergeist.intro: Poltergeist is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Spectral Tide, Semi Chaos, MADNESS, MAYHEM, MEGA MAYHEM, and Pure Chaos Admin Events.
