Pond_Emperor.description: Pond Emperors are highly territorial, powerful swimmers that will consume almost anything. Their striking coloration, aggressive nature, and rare appearances make them a prized and fortunate catch for anglers.
Pond_Emperor.intro: Pond Emperor is a Legendary fish found in Snowcap Island.
trivia: Pond Emperor is a reference to the 'King of the Pond' featured on Nintendo's Wii Play fishing game.

Pool_Noodle_Eel.description: An eel that got itself stuck in a pool noodle. Squeaky and mildly confused.
Pool_Noodle_Eel.intro: Pool Noodle Eel is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Popsicle.description: A melting popsicle lost in the water, a refreshing remnant of summer heatwaves.

Popsicle_Pike.description: A fish so cold it gave itself brain freeze. Lick it quickly before it melts into a sticky puddle. Tastes like regret and sugar.
Popsicle_Pike.intro: Popsicle Pike is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.
trivia: When interacted with Popsicle Pike, it plays a licking sound effect.
The Shiny variant of the Popsicle Pike resembles to 🐟 fish.

Populi_Blind_Catfish.description: A troglobitic, eyeless pink catfish adapted exclusively to pitch-black subterranean aquifers and underground cave systems.
Populi_Blind_Catfish.intro: Populi Blind Catfish is a Rare fish found in the Skycrest.

Porcufish.description: A spiky swimmer with quills that shimmer in the dark waters.
Porcufish.intro: Porcufish is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the First Sea.

Porcupinefish.description: A fish that inflates into a spiny ball when threatened.
Porcupinefish.intro: Porcupinefish is an Uncommon fish found in Sunken Reliquary.

Porgy.description: Porgies are a common catch for coastal anglers. They are a relatively easy to catch ocean fish with no real special qualities besides their taste and fun to say name.
Porgy.intro: Porgy is a Common fish found in the Ocean.

Portable_Fan.description: Battery‑powered breeze that cuts through the summer heat like a cool whisper.
Portable_Fan.intro: Portable Fan is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Portable Fan resembles a Oscillating Fan.

Poseidon%27s_Perch.description: These curious fish inhabit the grand sunken temples. Their fins have patterns resembling ancient waves, leading many to believe they were blessed by ancient gods.
Poseidon%27s_Perch.intro: Poseidon's Perch is a Common fish found in Atlantis.

Poseidon_Turkey.description: Topped with Poseidon's crown and gripping a miniature trident, this regal turkey commands the depths like the sea god himself. Bow before its might, then cook it up for Fischgiving!
trivia: The Shiny Poseidon Turkey is based on the Developer Plutoly (@Plutoly).

Poseidon_Wrath_Totem.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Potion_Perch.description: A perch that brews mysterious potions in its belly.

Prawn.description: Prawns are prized crustaceans known for their delicate flavour and versatility. they are most active in summer, and can be found in an abundance in deep oceans. Prawns; similar to shrimp-- are predominantly nocturnal, making night fishing the most effective time.
Prawn.intro: Prawn is an Uncommon fish found in the Ocean.

Present.description: Gift-wrapped present bobbing along. Shake it to hear the mystery rattle.
Present.intro: Present is a Limited Crate found in the Glacial Ridge during the Fischmas 2 event.

Prickly_Gurnard.description: An exotic bottom feeder possessing walking-spines and armored plates designed to scale cavern water-walls.
Prickly_Gurnard.intro: Prickly Gurnard is a Legendary fish found in the Drylands.

Primordial_Devourer.description: An ancient entity that consumes matter and form alike, leaving distortion behind.
Primordial_Devourer.intro: Primordial Devourer is a Mythical fish found in Olympian Fissure.

Primordial_Levi.description: A near-black fish with bright red accents, its menacing form a relic of a primal age.
Primordial_Levi.intro: Primordial Levi is a Extinct fish found in Lushgrove.

Prismatic_Parrotfish.description: A colorful fish with scales that reflect every color of the rainbow.
Prismatic_Parrotfish.intro: Prismatic Parrotfish is a Rare fish found in the Calm Zone of Mariana's Veil.

Prismfin_Trout.description: A trout whose fins scatter light into shifting spectral tones.
Prismfin_Trout.intro: Prismfin Trout is an Unusual fish found in Apollo's Song of Light.

Profane_Leviathan.intro: Profane Leviathan is a Secret fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Profane_Ray.description: Displaying an unholy glow, the Profane Ray glides, with wings casting silhouettes that profane the silence.
Profane_Ray.intro: Profane Ray is a Limited fish found within the Cults Curse event.

Prototype_Noxious_Catalyst.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Psychedelic_Frogfish.description: A red fish with cyan accents, gold-cyan fins, hopping around like a disco disaster.
Psychedelic_Frogfish.intro: Psychedelic Frogfish is a Extinct fish found in the Open Ocean.

Puad_Launcher.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Pufferfish.description: Pufferfish are clumsy swimmers that can fill their elastic stomachs with huge amounts of water & air to blow themselves up to several times their normal size. They do this to evade and scare of predators. On top of their bloating abilities, they also are one of the most poisonous fish in the sea... Also they are the only bony fish which can close their eyes!
Pufferfish.intro: Pufferfish is a Rare fish found in the Ocean.
trivia: The Shiny Pufferfish takes on the appearance of the fish from the 'Pufferfish Eating Carrot' meme.
The Pufferfish plays the 'Mouse Squeak' sound from Undertale. This changes to the 'Augh' sound effect when Shiny.

Pufferfish_Floatie.description: A giant inflatable pufferfish floatie, perfect for lounging in the shallows. He's so cute!
Pufferfish_Floatie.intro: Pufferfish Floatie is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Pufferflute.description: A curious fish with a flute-like body that inflates under clear conditions, creating melodic bubbles that echo through Crystal Cove.
Pufferflute.intro: Pufferflute is a Rare fish found in the Crystal Cove.
trivia: Interacting with the Pufferflute plays a flute audio.

Pufferling_School.intro: Pufferling School is a Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

Pumpkin_Pufferfish.description: A pufferfish with a spooky twist.
Pumpkin_Pufferfish.intro: Pumpkin Pufferfish is a Limited fish found from fishing in Crook's Hallow during the FischFright 2025 event.
trivia: Like the Pufferfish, Pumpkin Pufferfish make a sound when interacted with. The normal variant plays the 'Mouse Squeak' https://fischipedia.org/wiki/File:Squish.mp3 sound from Undertale.

Pumpkinseed.description: Pumpkinseed are known for their distinctive red or orange edge on the ear flap and their round body shape. They prefer warmer waters and are often found in Roslit Bays freshwater. Pumpkinseed are also much less aggressive compared to other sunfish species.
Pumpkinseed.intro: Pumpkinseed is an Uncommon fish found in Roslit Bay.

Pupfish.description: A small blue fish with light blue fins, darting in playful schools.
Pupfish.intro: Pupfish is an Extinct fish found in the Open Ocean.

Purple_Frightful_Skull.intro: FischFright (2025) is the Halloween-themed annual event that occured during 2025 which lasted from October 18, 2025 - November 3, 2025. It featured the Crook's Hallow, new NPCs with unique quests and new Event fishes.

Purple_Message_in_a_Bottle.intro: Fischfest 2 is a summer-themed Event that lasts from June 20th until September 12th, 2026. The event features a new island that can be accessed using the Magical Conch, several NPCs, and a new Sunshells currency, which can be exchanged for limited items.

Puzzle_Egg.description: Im puzzled how you even caught this. (see what i did there)
Puzzle_Egg.intro: Puzzle Egg is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Egg Horde Admin Event.

Pyre_Fang.description: A rugged fish, its fins sharp and tinged with embers.
Pyre_Fang.intro: Pyre Fang is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Pyrite_Pufferfish.description: A round, spiky fish with a flaming sheen. Its body hardens when threatened.
Pyrite_Pufferfish.intro: Pyrite Pufferfish is a Rare fish found in Volcanic Vents of Mariana's Veil.

Pyro_Pike.description: A small fish with a strong glow, the Pyro Pike shows unmatched aggression towards its prey.
Pyro_Pike.intro: Pyro Pike is a Limited fish found in Roslit Bay 's saltwater during the Ashfall event.

Pyrogrub.description: The Pyrogrub is a fearsome, lava swimming eel that thrives in the most volcanic of environments. The Pyrogrub sports thick dragon-like scales which allow it's inner body to not react to any form of outside temperature.
Pyrogrub.intro: Pyrogrub is a Rare fish found in the Volcano in Roslit Bay.

Quality_Bait_Crate.description: A metal bait box with a rubber seal to protect the bait inside. Seemingly lost from a fishing boat of some kind. The bait is still alive and fresh. Therefore, finders keepers?- Opening it might give you an array of baits!
Quality_Bait_Crate.intro: Quality Bait Crate is a Rare Crate found in any body of water.

Quartz_Glass.description: An ultra-pure quartz pane engineered to withstand cryogenic cooling systems without cracking.
Quartz_Glass.intro: Quartz Glass is an Exotic fish found in the Astral Observatory - Northern Expedition.

Quartzfin_Queenfish.description: A small, shimmering fish with quartz-like fins that sparkle in the light.
Quartzfin_Queenfish.intro: Quartzfin Queenfish is a Common fish found in the Calm Zone of Mariana's Veil.

Queen_Angelfish.description: A sovereign sparkle from the ocean's royal trove.
Queen_Angelfish.intro: Queen Angelfish is a Rare fish found in Treasure Island.

Queen_Bee_Serpent.description: The regal queen of the den, a serpentine bee with a stinger that commands swarms.
Queen_Bee_Serpent.intro: Queen Bee Serpent is an Exotic fish found in the Nectar Den.

Rabbitfish.description: The Rabbitfish is an elusive saltwater fish that is only found under The Arch. They are odd creatures that both resemble a rabbit, and swim in a pattern similar to a bunny jumping.
Rabbitfish.intro: Rabbitfish is a Legendary fish found in the Ocean.

Race_the_Sunset.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Racuda.description: A sneaky fish with a masked face, rummaging through murky waters.
Racuda.intro: Racuda is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the Second Sea.

Radiant_Crystal.description: An otherworldly glowing crystal that pulses with divine energy...
Radiant_Crystal.intro: Radiant Crystal is a Gemstone found in the Mineshaft.

Radiant_Guppy.description: A vivid guppy with a body that seems to glow from within.
Radiant_Guppy.intro: Radiant Guppy is an Uncommon fish found in Apollo's Song of Light.

Radiant_Triplewart_Seadevil.description: A bizarre fish with three glowing lures and a body covered in bioluminescent spots.
Radiant_Triplewart_Seadevil.intro: Radiant Triplewart Seadevil is an Unusual fish found in the Abyssal Zenith of Mariana's Veil.

Radio_(Legacy).intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Rainbow_Grouper.description: A vibrant marvel streaking through foggy reefs.
Rainbow_Grouper.intro: Rainbow Grouper is an Extinct fish found in Gilded Arch.

Rainbow_Leviathan.description: A colossal serpent said to appear where rainbows touch the sea, its scales shimmer with every color of fortune, twisting through the waves like living light. Few have seen it and returned with their rods intact...
Rainbow_Leviathan.intro: Rainbow Leviathan is a Limited fish found in Lucky Gold Abundances during the Shamrock Seas event.

Rainbow_Ribbonfish.description: A ribbonfish with a rainbow pattern, shimmering with St. Patrick's Spirit!
Rainbow_Ribbonfish.intro: Rainbow Ribbonfish is a Limited fish found in Lucky Gold Abundances during the Shamrock Seas event.

Rainbow_Totem.intro: Totems are a type of consumable item which allows the player to manipulate Weather and start Localized Events. There are currently 28 totems in Fisch, with 2 of them being unobtainable.

Raindrop.description: You usually see these when its raining 😁👍.
Raindrop.intro: Raindrop is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Rainstorm Admin Event.

Razorfin.description: A scarred and extremely lethal shark; known for causing catastrophic ship accidents.
Razorfin.intro: Razorfin is a Divine Secret fish found rarely at Castaway Cliffs.

Red_Blossom.intro: Valentides (2026) was a seasonal event on Fisch which contributed to the 2026 Valentines which lasted from February 7, 2026 - February 21, 2026. It featured a new Event area with new NPCs, unique quests, puzzles and Event fishes.

Red_Crabsquid.description: A hybrid creature with squid-like tentacles, dwelling in crimson crab cages.
Red_Crabsquid.intro: Red Crabsquid is an Uncommon fish found in the Crimson Cavern.

Red_Drum.description: The Red Drum is a close relative to the Black Drum; Red Drum can be found all around Snowcaps vast salt-waters.
Red_Drum.intro: Red Drum is a Common fish found in Snowcap Island.

Red_Energy_Crystal.description: A red-hued crystal, told to possess mystical powers.
Red_Energy_Crystal.intro: Red Energy Crystal is a Mythical fish obtained at the summit of the Northern Expedition after completing various puzzles.

Red_Fangtooth.description: A grotesque fish with oversized fangs, prowling crimson cavern depths.
Red_Fangtooth.intro: Red Fangtooth is a Rare fish found in Crimson Cavern.

Red_Frightful_Skull.intro: FischFright (2025) is the Halloween-themed annual event that occured during 2025 which lasted from October 18, 2025 - November 3, 2025. It featured the Crook's Hallow, new NPCs with unique quests and new Event fishes.

Red_Marlins_Skin_Crate.intro: Skins offer a way to change the appearance of player belongings. Currently, they can only be applied to Fishing Rods.

Red_Message_in_a_Bottle.intro: Fischfest 2 is a summer-themed Event that lasts from June 20th until September 5th, 2026. The event features a new island that can be accessed using the Magical Conch, several NPCs, and a new Sunshells currency, which can be exchanged for limited items.

Red_Snapper.description: The Red Snapper is a common salt water fish that can be commonly found all around Moosewoods oceans. They are a very noticeable fish with their obvious red and light red tones.
Red_Snapper.intro: Red Snapper is a Common fish found in Moosewood.

Red_Spotted_Blenny.description: A small fish with crimson spots, darting through crab cages in clear waters.
Red_Spotted_Blenny.intro: Red Spotted Blenny is a Common fish found in the Crimson Cavern.

Red_Tang.description: The Red Tang is a relatively common catch within Sunstone Island. Very similar to other Tangs such as the Blue Tang, just red!
Red_Tang.intro: Red Tang is an Uncommon fish found in Sunstone Island.

Redeye_Bass.description: The Redeye Bass looks very similar to the Largemouth Bass. However, the Redeye bass has very distinct red or orange eyes to go along with its greenish brown body.
Redeye_Bass.intro: Redeye Bass is an Unusual fish found in Terrapin Island.

Redeye_Piranha.description: A sharp-toothed predator with a crimson gaze.
Redeye_Piranha.intro: Redeye Piranha is a Rare fish found in the Lost Jungle.

Redwood_Duskray.description: A sturdy glider that rays through the dusk.
Redwood_Duskray.intro: Redwood Duskray is an Extinct fish found in Pine Shoals.

Reed_Striker.description: A beige-cyan fish with yellow fins, striking from the reeds with precision.
Reed_Striker.intro: Reed Striker is an Extinct fish found in the Azure Lagoon.

Reef_Goby.description: A bottom-dwelling fish that makes its home in abandoned coral holes. They form partnerships with larger reef fish, cleaning parasites off their scales in exchange for protection.
Reef_Goby.intro: Reef Goby is an Uncommon fish found in the Grand Reef.

Reef_Minnow.description: A quick, small reef fish that swims in tight groups near coral formations. They use their silvery scales and small size to hide from predators, darting between coral branches when threatened.
Reef_Minnow.intro: Reef Minnow is a Common fish found in the Grand Reef.

Reef_Parrotfish.description: A large reef fish with a beak-like mouth used to scrape algae from coral. Their powerful jaws can grind coral into fine sand, helping create the beaches around reef areas.
Reef_Parrotfish.intro: Reef Parrotfish is a Rare fish found in the Grand Reef.

Reef_Refresher.intro: Fischfest 2 is a summer-themed Event which lasts from June 20th until September 5th, 2026. The event features a new island which can be accessed through the use of the Magical Conch, several NPCs, and a new 'Sunshells' currency which can be exchanged for limited items.

Reef_Titan.description: A mythical, collosal creature that is part of the reef itself. Its movements cause tremors, and its size defies belief.
Reef_Titan.intro: Reef Titan is an Exotic fish found in Coral Bastion.

Reefdart.description: A slender blue eel with pink fins and eyes, weaving through coral shadows.
Reefdart.intro: Reefdart is an Extinct fish found in the Isle of New Beginnings.

Reefrunner_Snapper.description: Bold yet wary, the Reefunner [ sic ] Snapper darts around reefs. A popular, rare catch for reef fishers.
Reefrunner_Snapper.intro: Reefrunner Snapper is a Rare fish found in Forsaken Shores.

Regal_Angelfish.description: A delicate, ornate fish with fine orange and white lines on a dark blue body.
Regal_Angelfish.intro: Regal Angelfish is an Uncommon fish found in Coral Bastion.

Regeneration_Coil.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Reindeer_Ray.description: Ray with antlers and red nose. Pulls Santa's sleigh... underwater?
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Reindeer Ray adds a red nose and covered with snowflakes. When held out, it plays a jingle bell sound effect.

Reinforced_Battery.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Relic_Dart.description: A golden fish with light blue translucent fins, streaking through the deep like a forgotten treasure.
Relic_Dart.intro: Relic Dart is an Extinct fish found in Lushgrove.

Requis_Essence.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Reservoir_Squalus.description: An ancient deep-water underground shark with pale, non-pigmented skin and predatory auditory receptors.
Reservoir_Squalus.intro: Reservoir Squalus is a Mythical fish found in the Drylands.

Resin.intro: Resin is a Secret fish found in Mushgrove Swamp.

Revenant_Eel.description: An eel that writhes unnaturally, as if driven by something long gone.
Revenant_Eel.intro: Revenant Eel is a Rare fish found in the Hades' Underworld of Indefinite.

Rhizodus.description: A massive, toothy predator of ancient waters.

Ribbon_Eel.description: The ribbon eel is a striking and elusive reef fish known for its vibrant blue or green body and long, ribbon-like appearance. While they are rare, the Ribbon Eel can be best found in the coral reef of Roslit Bay Bestiary Entry.
Ribbon_Eel.intro: Ribbon Eel is an Unusual fish found in Roslit Bay.

Riftia.description: A giant tube worm that anchors near hydrothermal vents, harboring symbiotic bacteria to survive pitch-black depths.
Riftia.intro: Riftia is a Legendary fish found in the Astral Observatory - Abyssal Zenith.

Ringle.description: The Ringle is an interesting and elusive fish that swims at extremely low and cold depths. They have a Rhino-like horn that they use to attack their prey. Most commonly found in the open ocean of Snowcap Island.
Ringle.intro: Ringle is a Mythical fish found in Snowcap Island.

Ripple_Spine.description: A light blue fish with long, flowing fins and dark blue stripes, rippling through the water like a living wave.
Ripple_Spine.intro: Ripple Spine is an Extinct fish found at Waveborne.

Ripplefin_Carp.description: Its fins trail in layered ripples, as though water still clings to them.
Ripplefin_Carp.intro: Ripplefin Carp is a Common fish found in Poseidon's Storm of Floods.

Ro-torcycle.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Rock.description: It's not a boulder.. It's a rock! Found in rocky bodies of water.
Rock.intro: Rock is Trash found in certain bodies of water.

Rock_Gunnel.description: A long red fish with light red fins, slithering through rocky crevices.
Rock_Gunnel.intro: Rock Gunnel is an Extinct fish found in the Open Ocean.

Rock_Hind.description: A rugged titan lurking in sunlit rocky chasms.
Rock_Hind.intro: Rock Hind is an Extinct fish found in Gilded Arch.

Rock_Lobster.description: Lobsters are valuable crustaceans known for their rich, succulent meat. Lobsters are most active in the summer to autumn, and are commonly caught in crab cages during calm clear days.
Rock_Lobster.intro: Rock Lobster is an Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

RocketFuel.intro: RocketFuel is an Exotic fish found in Mushgrove Swamp.

Rocket_Ship.intro: Rocket Ship is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Galaxy, MADNESS and MEGA MAYHEM Admin Events.

Rockstar_Hermit_Crab.description: The Rockstar Hermit Crab is a unique evolutionary species, originating from the simple hermit crab. They possess antennae resembling two lightning-bolts on either side of their head, which is where their name comes from. Caught with rods or crab cages in the Desolate Deep.
Rockstar_Hermit_Crab.intro: Rockstar Hermit Crab is an Unusual fish found in the Desolate Deep.

Rokko%27s_Fragment.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Rose-Veiled_Fairy_Wrasse.description: A spectacular fairy wrasse shimmering in gradient shades of magenta, orange, and rose-pink across its delicate fin veils.
Rose-Veiled_Fairy_Wrasse.intro: Rose-Veiled Fairy Wrasse is a Mythical fish found in the Skycrest.

Rose_Bouquet.description: A cluster of ocean-borne roses somehow still fresh, a romantic gift from the sea during Valentides.
Rose_Bouquet.intro: Rose Bouquet is a Limited fish found in Sweetheart Shores during the Valentides 2 event.

Rose_Pearl.description: A pearl with a powerful pink hue.
Rose_Pearl.intro: Rose Pearl is an Unusual fish found in Clams behind Roslit Bay at a 19.58% chance.

Rose_Rockfish.description: This rugged rockfish is adorned with natural rosy patterns, as if the ocean itself bloomed for Valentine's Day.
Rose_Rockfish.intro: Rose Rockfish is a Limited fish found in Lovestorm Turtle Pools during the Valentides 2 event.

Roslit_Ray_Lobster.description: Lobsters are valuable crustaceans known for their rich, succulent meat. Lobsters are most active in the summer to autumn, and are commonly caught in crab cages during calm clear days.
Roslit_Ray_Lobster.intro: Roslit Ray Lobster is an Extinct fish found in Lobster Shores.

Rotbloom.description: A blooming mass of rot that spreads decay with every petal flutter.
Rotbloom.intro: Rotbloom is an Exotic fish found in the Toxic Grove.

Rotcoil_Eel.description: An eel whose coils secrete a rotting slime that dissolves flesh on contact. It lurks in decaying vegetation.
Rotcoil_Eel.intro: Rotcoil Eel is a Rare fish found in the Toxic Grove.

Rotfin_Eel.intro: Rotfin Eel is a Limited fish found in the Crypt of the Green One.

Rotjaw.description: A brutal predator that crushes all in its relentless grip.
Rotjaw.intro: Rotjaw is an Uncommon fish found in Cursed Isle, formerly in The Cursed Shores.

Rotted_Seed.description: A seed that found its way from the Living Garden to the Toxic Grove; didn’t seem to last very well… I wonder if it can still be used?
Rotted_Seed.intro: Rotted Seed is a Seed fish found in the Toxic Grove.

Rotwood_Perch.description: A perch adapted to decaying rotwood, blending perfectly with fallen logs and mushrooms.
Rotwood_Perch.intro: Rotwood Perch is a Common fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Roughhead_Grenadier.description: A rattail fish with a large head and tapered body, common in deep water.
Roughhead_Grenadier.intro: Roughhead Grenadier is a Common fish found in Collapsed Ruins.

Roundnose_Grenadier.description: A rattail fish with a long rounded snout and long tapering tail.
Roundnose_Grenadier.intro: Roundnose Grenadier is a Common fish found in Crowned Ruins.

Rowdy_McCharm.description: A lively red fish with eyes that glow like embers, it darts through waters with St. Patrick's playful charm!
Rowdy_McCharm.intro: Rowdy McCharm is a Limited fish found within red-colored abundances during the Lucky Event.

Royal_Egg.intro: Royal Egg is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Egg Horde Admin Event.

Royal_Tigerfish.description: A sleek predator with a striped body, awaiting a target.
Royal_Tigerfish.intro: Royal Tigerfish is a Limited fish found in Octophant Hunts in the Second Sea.

Rubber_Ducky.description: A simple, squeezable, rubber duck! It may have been lost in one of the deepest parts of our discovered world... But, it's in great condition!
Rubber_Ducky.intro: Rubber Ducky is a Legendary fish found in Vertigo.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Rubber Ducky is inspired by 'Evil Duck', a ROBLOX hat released in 2011.
Both normal and Shiny variants play a sound when interacted with.

Ruby.description: A gemstone with a very intense red hue.
Ruby.intro: Ruby is a Gemstone found inside Meteors in the Ancient Isle.

Ruby_Lionfish.description: A gleam from the sea's most coveted chests.
Ruby_Lionfish.intro: Ruby Lionfish is a Legendary fish found in Treasure Island.

Ruby_Neon_Eviota.description: A dwarf reef goby with translucent crimson flesh and glowing ruby-red internal markings.
Ruby_Neon_Eviota.intro: Ruby Neon Eviota is an Uncommon fish found in the Skycrest.

Ruby_Rasbora.description: A small, red fish with ruby-like scales that shimmer in the light.
Ruby_Rasbora.intro: Ruby Rasbora is a Rare fish found in the Calm Zone of Mariana's Veil.

Rustscale_Minnow.description: A small fish with oxidized scales resembling worn armor.
Rustscale_Minnow.intro: Rustscale Minnow is a Common fish found in Bellona's Frenzy of War.

Rusty_Bolt.description: A corroded old bolt, probably dropped by a careless miner long ago.
Rusty_Bolt.intro: Rusty Bolt is a Trash fish found in the Mineshaft.

Rusty_Hook.description: A discarded hook, bent and dulled by countless failed catches.
Rusty_Hook.intro: Rusty Hook is a Trash fish found in the Bellona's Frenzy of War.

Sacabambaspis.description: An ancient jawless fish with a distinctive forward-facing head shield and fixed mouth open in perpetual astonishment.
Sacabambaspis.intro: Sacabambaspis is a Common fish found at Outer Deep of The Deep.

Sacred_Lovestorm_Turtle.intro: Sacred Lovestorm Turtle is a Limited fish found in the Sacred Lovestorm Turtle Pool during the Valentides 2 event.

Sad_Floppy.description: A part of the Floppy Fiesta!
Sad_Floppy.intro: Sad Floppy is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Floppy Fiesta Admin Event.

Saffron_Cod.description: The Saffron Cod is a coastal fish with a yellowish tint, found in shallow northern Pacific waters.
Saffron_Cod.intro: Saffron Cod is an Uncommon fish found in Boreal Pines.

Sailfish.description: Sailfish are known for their incredible speed, long bill, and their striking sail-like dorsal fin. It's sleek body is built for fast swimming, allowing it to dart through water in bursts of speed. They are found in tropical and warmer ocean waters.
Sailfish.intro: Sailfish is a Rare fish found in the Ocean.

Salmon.description: Salmon are visually known for their silver skin and streamlined bodies. They are extremely strong swimmers and leapers, making them a difficult catch. You can find these Ocean Salmon in any deep bodies of salt water, and some freshwaters.
Salmon.intro: Salmon is an Uncommon fish found in the Ocean.

Salmoose.description: A majestic fish with antlers, swimming through icy streams.
Salmoose.intro: Salmoose is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the First Sea.

Sand_Castle.description: A tiny sand castle sculpted by the tides, symbolizing endless summer fun on the beach.

Sand_Dollar.description: Sand dollars are species of flat, burrowing sea urchins.. Yeah, they are urchins! Fun fact; The rattling of a fossilized Sand Dollar is their teeth-like sections moving around inside of them.
Sand_Dollar.intro: Sand Dollar is a Common fish found in the Ocean.

Sand_Fort.description: A formidable fortress made of sand; moat not included but highly recommended.
Sand_Fort.intro: Sand Fort is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Sand_Of_Time.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Sand_Tiger_Shark.description: A shark with a menacing grin and ragged teeth, often seen near reefs.
Sand_Tiger_Shark.intro: Sand Tiger Shark is a Mythical fish found in Coral Bastion.

Sand_Worm.description: The Sand Worm, also known as the Heart Beast is one of the most destructive and feared monsters. From land and see [ sic ], the Sand Worm is able to dig and leap around, eating anything in it's [ sic ] path. The Sand Worm is capable of hearing heartbeats from over 10,000 KM's [ sic ] away, meaning you are never truly safe when a sandstorm hits.
Sand_Worm.intro: Sand Worm is a Special fish found in any body of water during the SANDSTORM Admin Event.

Sandbar_Loach.description: A slender, smooth fish that filters subterranean cave nutrients through the silty subterranean inflows.
Sandbar_Loach.intro: Sandbar Loach is a Common fish found in the Drylands.

Sandiest_Dollar.description: A very large and valuable Sand Dollar. Must've belonged to the Sand King?
Sandiest_Dollar.intro: Sandiest Dollar is a Special fish found in any body of water during the SANDSTORM Admin Event.

Sandslasher.description: The Sandslasher is a colossal and feared predator of the arid wastes. Its elongated, armored body is lined with jagged, sandstone-like scales that blend seamlessly with the desert dunes. Rows of barbed fins run down its back, kicking up blinding clouds of sand as it moves beneath the surface. Near its head, two massive scythe-like claws extend outward, capable of tearing through prey; or unwary fishing lines; in a single motion. Hooking the Sandslasher is a rare feat; landing it marks an angler as nothing short of a desert legend.
trivia: The Sandslasher was based of the Desert Scourge from Terraria's Calamity Mod. The Shiny variant takes an even more similar appearance in terms of color.

Santa%27s_Present.description: The big man's personal present. Naughty or nice? It's judging you!

Santa%27s_Relic.description: It seems Santa made some Relic's just for the Christmas occasion! It's absolutely packed with Fischmas spirit and pure joy; Merry Fischmas!
Santa%27s_Relic.intro: Santa's Relic is a Limited Relic obtained exclusively during Fischmas 2, it has a very low chance to be found when fishing in any location.

Santa_Pufferfish.description: A pufferfish, but with a santa hat! How jolly!
Santa_Pufferfish.intro: Santa Pufferfish is a Limited fish found in the Winter Village during the Fischmas (2024) event.
trivia: When interacted with, the Santa Pufferfish plays the 'hohoho' audio from the Festive Periastron Chi Roblox gear: https://fischipedia.org/wiki/File:Ho_Ho_Ho.mp3

Santa_Salmon.description: Santa Salmons are very old and heavy salmons. They also possess a jolly santa hat and a long white beard. How festive!
Santa_Salmon.intro: Santa Salmon is a Limited fish found in the Winter Village during the Fischmas 1 event.

Santa_Whale_Shark.description: Whale shark in full Santa suit. Delivers gifts... and tidal waves.
Santa_Whale_Shark.intro: Santa Whale Shark is a Limited fish found in the Glacial Ridge during the Fischmas 2 event.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Santa Whale Shark puts the fish in Santas sleigh. When interacted with, it plays a 'Ho Ho Ho' sound effect.

Sapflow_Eel.description: A slick eel that flows like tree sap, leaving a sticky golden trail.
Sapflow_Eel.intro: Sapflow Eel is an Uncommon fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Sapphire_Stargazer.description: A flat fish with sapphire-blue scales and glowing eyes that stare into the light.
Sapphire_Stargazer.intro: Sapphire Stargazer is an Unusual fish found in the Calm Zone of Mariana's Veil.

Sarcastic_Fringehead.description: A desaturated red fish with yellow-orange fins, one eye missing and a sarcastic mop of hair.
Sarcastic_Fringehead.intro: Sarcastic Fringehead is an Extinct fish found in the Open Ocean.

Sardine.description: Sardines are small schooling fish, known for their high oil content, silver scales, and long tiny bodies.
Sardine.intro: Sardine is a Common fish found in the Ocean.

Sardines_School.intro: Sardines School is an Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

Sawfish.description: The Sawfish is a large, unique fish with a long, flattened snout that is lined with sharp teeth, resembling a saw. They are found all across the ocean mostly during the night.
Sawfish.intro: Sawfish is a Legendary fish found in the Ocean.

Scalding_Swordfish.description: A sharp fish with glowing red eyes and a body wreathed in smoky tendrils, rumored to be a spirit of the lava itself.
Scalding_Swordfish.intro: Scalding Swordfish is a Legendary fish found in Volcanic Vents of Mariana's Veil.

Scallop.description: Scallops are known for their ability to 'swim' by rapidly opening and closing their shells, which propels them through the water. They can be found best in sandy or grass filled areas of the ocean.
Scallop.intro: Scallop is an Uncommon fish found in the Ocean.
trivia: When a Scallop is caught with the Shiny attribute, it opens up revealing a pearl inside.

Scalloped_Hammerhead.description: A majestic predator patrolling the open seas.
Scalloped_Hammerhead.intro: Scalloped Hammerhead is an Exotic fish found in Castaway Cliffs.

Scalloped_Spiny_Lobster.description: Lobsters are valuable crustaceans known for their rich, succulent meat. Lobsters are most active in the summer to autumn, and are commonly caught in crab cages during calm clear days.
Scalloped_Spiny_Lobster.intro: Scalloped Spiny Lobster is an Extinct fish found in Lobster Shores.

Scaly_Dragonfish.description: A predatory deep-sea fish with fang-like teeth and a chin barbel for luring prey.
Scaly_Dragonfish.intro: Scaly Dragonfish is a Mythical fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Scarecrow.description: Not a fish, but a scarecrow that somehow ended up in the water.

Scooty_Salmon.description: Coated in fine soot, the Scooty Salmon exhibits extreme volcanic tolerance.
Scooty_Salmon.intro: Scooty Salmon is a Limited fish found in Roslit Bay 's saltwater during the Ashfall event.

Scorching_Umbrella.intro: Scorching Umbrella is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Heatwave Admin Event.

Scorchray.description: A broad, dark creature, its edges flickering with fiery traces.
Scorchray.intro: Scorchray is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Scoria_Armor.intro: The Scoria Armor is a suit equipment that prevents the player's temperature bar from increasing quickly. It is a useful item for fishing in the Scoria Reach.

Scoria_Swordfish.description: A powerful predator with a blade-like bill hardened by volcanic minerals. It patrols the warmer waters, hunting smaller fish with swift decisive strikes.
Scoria_Swordfish.intro: Scoria Swordfish is an Unusual fish found in Scoria Reach.

Scorpionfish.description: A master of camouflage with venomous spines along its back.
Scorpionfish.intro: Scorpionfish is an Uncommon fish found in Coral Bastion.

Scrap_Metal.intro: Scrap Metal is Trash found in The Depths of Vertigo.

Scrawled_Filefish.description: A mottled drifter gliding through twilight reefs.
Scrawled_Filefish.intro: Scrawled Filefish is an Extinct fish found in Gilded Arch.

Screaming_Fluke.description: A deafening horror that shatters the silence of the deep.
Screaming_Fluke.intro: Screaming Fluke is a Legendary fish found in Cursed Isle, formerly in The Cursed Shores.

Scurvy_Sailfish.description: Scurvy Sailfish are swift and skilled jumpers, often found near rocky shores. Their agility makes them hard to land.
Scurvy_Sailfish.intro: Scurvy Sailfish is an Unusual fish found in Forsaken Shores.

Scylla.description: A mythological, multi-headed being said to lurk in the ocean’s deepest abyss. Its serpent-like heads move independently, striking prey with razor-toothed maws, and some believe they regenerate when severed. A myth to most, it is feared as an immortal guardian of the sea, appearing only in the deadliest storms to drag the unwary into the depths.
Scylla.intro: Scylla is a Secret fish found in the Veil of the Forsaken of Mariana's Veil.
trivia: There was supposed to be a rarer version of the Scylla, that being its Ancient variant. It was then removed right before the update.

Scylla_Hunt_Totem.intro: Totems are a type of consumable item which allows the player to manipulate Weather and start Localized Events. There are currently 28 totems in Fisch, with 2 of them being unobtainable.

Scylla_Mask.intro: FischFright (2025) is the Halloween-themed annual event that occured during 2025 which lasted from October 18, 2025 - November 3, 2025. It featured the Crook's Hallow, new NPCs with unique quests and new Event fishes.

Sea_Angel.description: A translucent, wing-footed pelagic sea slug that flits gracefully through chilly woodland streams.
Sea_Angel.intro: Sea Angel is a Rare fish found in the Everturn Forest - Astral Cavern.

Sea_Bass.description: The Sea Bass is a popular catch for many anglers, known for its elongated body and aggressive fighting behaviour when hooked. They can be found all over the world in all sorts of salt waters.
Sea_Bass.intro: Sea Bass is a Common fish found in the Ocean.

Sea_Bunny.description: A small, fluffy-looking sea slug with ear-like rhinophores used to detect chemical scents in the water.
Sea_Bunny.intro: Sea Bunny is a Uncommon fish found in the Astral Observatory - Everturn Forest

Sea_Leviathan.description: A swift and deadly predator of the fog, elusive and nearly untouchable in its element.
Sea_Leviathan.intro: Sea Leviathan is an Extinct fish found during the Sea Leviathan Hunt event in the Open Ocean.
trivia: The Sea Leviathan Progress Speed penalty can be reduced with the Steady or Blessed Song Enchantment, Tempest Rod and Challenger's Rod passive ability, though this is not intended.

Sea_Mine.description: An inactive naval sea mine that has somehow made its way down here. Caught in crab cages in the Desolate Deep.
Sea_Mine.intro: Sea Mine is a Mythical fish found in the Desolate Deep.
trivia: The model for its Shiny variant is a reference to the Subspace Tripmine Roblox gear.

Sea_Pickle.description: The Sea Pickle is a quirky, small, tube-like sea creature found on ocean beds. Its glowing green body gives off a faint bioluminescent light, making it easy to spot at night. It's know to wriggle out of nets and rods, making it a tricky catch. Despite its unassuming appearance, it's highly valued for its oddity and unique glow.
Sea_Pickle.intro: Sea Pickle is a Mythical fish found in the Ocean.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Sea Pickle is a direct reference to 'Pickle Rick' from Season 3, Episode 3 of the animated science-fiction comedy Rick and Morty. It plays audio of Rick screaming "IM PICKLE RICK!!" when interacted with.
The Bestiary entry used to state that the preferred weather is "Clear, Cloudy" before being fixed in Version 1.23.0.

Sea_Raven.description: A crimson-hued fish with wing-like fins, gliding through rainy cavern waters.
Sea_Raven.intro: Sea Raven is an Uncommon fish found in Crimson Cavern.

Sea_Snake.description: A long, venomous sea snake with smooth, scaly skin and a graceful, undulating movement.
Sea_Snake.intro: Sea Snake is a Mythical fish found in The Depths of Vertigo.

Sea_Sponge.description: A vibrant sea sponge flourishing in warm summer waters, filtering the ocean and adding color to reefs.
Sea_Sponge.intro: Sea Sponge is a Limited fish found in Fischfest.

Sea_Turtle.description: The Sea Turtle is a graceful marine creature with a streamlined shell and paddle-like flippers, found gliding peacefully in warm coastal waters. Known for their calm demeanour and protected status, Sea Turtles are a rare and beautiful sight that often symbolizes good fortune.
Sea_Turtle.intro: Sea Turtle is a Mythical fish found in Terrapin Island.

Sea_Urchin.description: Sea Urchins are spiny, globular animals. Their hard shells are round and spiny. They use their spikes along with their tube feet to push themselves along the ocean terrain. Sea Urchins can be caught in any climate and traditionally only prefer sea water.
Sea_Urchin.intro: Sea Urchin is a Rare fish found in the Ocean.

Seacow.description: A gentle giant grazing the ocean floor, its bulk a marvel of the deep.
Seacow.intro: Seacow is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the First Sea.

Searfin.description: A sleek fish, its fins shimmering with the heat of scorched tides.
Searfin.intro: Searfin is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Seasonal_Glass.description: An ornate, weather-tinted glass panel that shifts hue depending on ambient forest temperatures.
Seasonal_Glass.intro: Seasonal Glass is a Exotic fish found in the Everturn Forest - Astral Cavern.

Seaspawn_Shrimp_School.intro: Seaspawn Shrimp School is a Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

Seaweed.description: Some lovely seaweed that caught your hook. Not as cool as a fish, but it's better than finding a lonesome boot!
Seaweed.intro: Seaweed is Trash found in various bodies of water.

Semi-Speed_Coil.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Seraphfin.description: A touch of the heavens above...
Seraphfin.intro: Seraphfin is a Divine Secret fish found rarely in any body of water.

Seraphic_Whale.description: An angelic whale wreathed in divine light. Only appearing at the peak of the Atlantean Storm, this creature is said to be a messenger of Olympus itself, heralding the gods' judgment.
Seraphic_Whale.intro: Seraphic Whale is a Limited fish found in the Atlantean Storm during the Olympian Storm event.

Sergeant_Major.description: A bold leader commanding tropical shallows.
Sergeant_Major.intro: Sergeant Major is an Extinct fish found in Gilded Arch.

Serpent_Surgeonfish.description: A long, snake-like fish with sharp fins and glowing eyes.
Serpent_Surgeonfish.intro: Serpent Surgeonfish is an Uncommon fish found in the Veil of the Forsaken of Mariana's Veil.

Shadow_Egg.intro: Shadow Egg is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Egg Horde Admin Event.

Shadow_Ray.description: A translucent ray that glides silently, barely visible against the dark.
Shadow_Ray.intro: Shadow Ray is a Rare fish found in the Hades' Underworld of Indefinite.

Shadowfang_Snapper.description: A twisted snapper warped by the Kraken's influence, with teeth sharp enough to pierce steel and scales that seem to absorb light.
Shadowfang_Snapper.intro: Shadowfang Snapper is an Uncommon fish found in Atlantis.

Shady_Crate.description: A Shady Crate that seems to have gone missing, but who really knows?
Shady_Crate.intro: Shady Crate is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Shady Surge Admin Event.

Shady_Nuke.intro: Shady Nukes are a localized event in Fisch that allows the player to catch the Shady Mutation when fished in.

Shamrock_Bloop_Fish.description: A Bloop Fish here to celebrate the St. Patrick's spirit! It's rarer than a typical Bloop Fish; but it's sure to bring you good luck!
Shamrock_Bloop_Fish.intro: Shamrock Bloop Fish is a Limited fish found in Shamrock Bloop Fish Hunts during the Shamrock Seas event.

Shamrock_Coil.intro: Shamrock Seas was a seasonal event on Fisch which was a St. Patrick's Day-themed Event which lasted from March 14, 2026 - March 21, 2026. It featured a new Event area with new NPCs, unique quests and Event fish.

Shamrock_Kraken.description: A Kraken here to celebrate the St. Patrick's spirit! It's rarer than a typical Kraken; but it's sure to bring you good luck!
Shamrock_Kraken.intro: Shamrock Kraken is a Limited fish found in Shamrock Kraken Hunts during the Shamrock Seas event.

Shamrock_Leviathan.description: A Leviathan here to celebrate the St. Patrick's spirit! It's rarer than a typical Leviathan; but it's sure to bring you good luck!
Shamrock_Leviathan.intro: Shamrock Leviathan is a Limited fish found in Shamrock Leviathan Hunts during the Shamrock Seas event.

Shamrock_Megalodon.description: A Megalodon here to celebrate the St. Patrick's spirit! It's rarer than a typical Megalodon; but it's sure to bring you good luck!
Shamrock_Megalodon.intro: Shamrock Megalodon is a Limited fish found in Shamrock Megalodon Hunts during the Shamrock Seas event.

Shamrock_Salmon.description: A lucky salmon covered in a clover pattern. It's sure to bring good luck to everyone who finds one!
Shamrock_Salmon.intro: Shamrock Salmon is a Limited fish found in Lucky Gold Abundances during the Shamrock Seas event.

Shamrock_Scylla.description: A Scylla here to celebrate the St. Patrick's spirit! It's rarer than a typical Scylla; but it's sure to bring you good luck!
Shamrock_Scylla.intro: Shamrock Scylla is a Limited fish found in Shamrock Scylla Hunts during the Shamrock Seas event.

Shard-Tooth_Salmon.description: An aggressive sand-predator armed with crystalline, glass-sharp teeth formed by molten silica.
Shard-Tooth_Salmon.intro: Shard-Tooth Salmon is an Unusual fish found in the Drylands.

Shark_Fang.intro: Shark Fang is a Limited fish found in Roslit Bay during the Archaeological Hunt event.
