Shellphone.description: A large conch shell that functions like a phone, echoing the sounds of summer waves and seagulls.
Shellphone.intro: Shellphone is a Limited fish found in Fischfest island.

Shieldbearer_Koi.description: A broad-scaled koi whose plated body resembles layered shields.
Shieldbearer_Koi.intro: Shieldbearer Koi is a Rare fish found in the Bellona's Frenzy of War.

Shimmering_Silverside.description: A sleek, silver fish with scales that shimmer like liquid metal.
Shimmering_Silverside.intro: Shimmering Silverside is a Mythical fish found in the Calm Zone of Mariana's Veil.

Shiny_Totem.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Shipwreck_Barracuda.description: Lurking near old wrecks, the Shipwreck Barracuda guards sunken treasure spots. Feared by some, prized by others.
Shipwreck_Barracuda.intro: Shipwreck Barracuda is a Legendary fish found in Forsaken Shores.

Shiver_Swarmfish_School.intro: Shiver Swarmfish School is an Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

Shiverfin_Haddock.description: A fish with frosty blue scales and faint frost patterns across its fins.
Shiverfin_Haddock.intro: Shiverfin Haddock is a Rare fish found in the Glacial Grotto.

Shop_Key.intro: A Shop Key is a consumable item which grants the player one free item from the current Limited Shop's selection.

Shortfin_Mako_Shark.description: The Shortfin Mako is a fast predator found in the forsaken ocean. Its speed and strength attract seasoned anglers.
Shortfin_Mako_Shark.intro: Shortfin Mako Shark is a Common fish found in Forsaken Shores.

Shortnose_Chimaera.description: A smaller relative of the chimaera with a blunt snout and large eyes.
Shortnose_Chimaera.intro: Shortnose Chimaera is an Uncommon fish found in Collapsed Ruins.

Shortspine_Thornyhead.description: A bright red rockfish variant protected by prominent head spines and thick scales.
Shortspine_Thornyhead.intro: Shortspine Thornyhead is an Uncommon fish found in the Gloomy Crevice.

Shrimp.description: Shrimp are small, versatile crustaceans that are most active from spring to autumn, and can be found in an abundance in deep oceans. Shrimp are predominantly nocturnal, making night fishing the most effective time.
Shrimp.intro: Shrimp is a Common fish found in the Ocean.

Shrimpanzee.description: A swift, shrimp-like creature with a tail that flicks like a whip, stashing shells in hidden burrows.
Shrimpanzee.intro: Shrimpanzee is a Limited fish found in Octophant Hunts in the Second Sea.

Silt-Crusted_Carp.description: A resilient carp whose thick, silt-caked scales shield its body from extreme arid temperatures.
Silt-Crusted_Carp.intro: Silt-Crusted Carp is an Uncommon fish found in the Drylands.

Silver_Arowana.description: A sleek predator that leaps for prey above the water’s surface.
Silver_Arowana.intro: Silver Arowana is a Rare fish found in the Lost Jungle.

Silver_Scuttler.description: A small, quick fish with shimmering scales that skitter across the ice.
Silver_Scuttler.intro: Silver Scuttler is a Common fish found in Blue Moon events at Snowcap Island.

Singularity.description: A point of infinite density where space, time, and the laws of physics cease to operate as we know them.
Singularity.intro: Singularity is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Semi Chaos, Nulltide, MAYHEM, MEGA MAYHEM, MADNESS and Pure Chaos Admin Events.

Sinocyclocheilus.description: A cave-dwelling barb from Chinese karst caves, often blind with reduced pigmentation.
Sinocyclocheilus.intro: Sinocyclocheilus is an Uncommon fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Siren%27s_Guppy.intro: Siren’s Guppy is a Limited fish found in the Crypt of the Green One.

Siren%27s_Tear.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Siren_Sculpin.description: A small, glowing fish with a hypnotic pattern on its scales.
Siren_Sculpin.intro: Siren Sculpin is a Rare fish found in the Veil of the Forsaken of Mariana's Veil.

Siren_Sheep.description: A woolly fish with a haunting bleat, drifting through misty waters.
Siren_Sheep.intro: Siren Sheep is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the Second Sea.

Siren_Singer.description: These enchanting fish produce melodic vibrations that ancient mariners often mistook for ethereal songs. Their scales shimmer with hypnotic patterns when they sing.
Siren_Singer.intro: Siren Singer is an Unusual fish found in Ethereal Abyss.

Sixgill_Shark.description: A primitive deep-water shark with six gills slits and a heavy body.
Sixgill_Shark.intro: Sixgill Shark is a Legendary fish found in the Tidefall.

Skelefish.description: The Skelefish is a literal fish skeleton, eerily animated as if it still had flesh. Its bony structure drifts through the water, with jagged, rib-like bones and a hollow skull that stares blankly ahead. Only can be caught during FischFright.
Skelefish.intro: Skelefish is a Limited fish found in Frightful Pools during the FischFright 1 event.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Skelefish may be a reference to Sans, a major character from Undertale.

Skelefriend.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Skeletal_Leviathan.description: The fossilized remains of an ancient leviathan, animated by geothermal energies. its bones have been replaced with crystalized minerals over eons, creating an eerie, giant skeleton that still hunts the depths.
Skeletal_Leviathan.intro: Skeletal Leviathan is an Exotic fish found in Scoria Reach.
trivia: The Skeletal Leviathan's model is likely inspired by the Reaper Leviathan from Subnautica, but in skeleton form.

Skeletal_Nessie.description: The bony remains of Nessie, risen from the catacombs.

Skeletal_Serpent.description: A monstrous, skeletal leviathan that coils through the lightless abyss, its bone-white form glowing with an unnatural, radiant sheen. Stirred from its ancient slumber by a catastrophic pulse of forbidden energy, it emerges from the deep when the seas fall silent, its haunting, resonant hum shattering sonar and reviving long-buried fears of the ocean's wrath. Sailors whisper it is a relic of a lost age, reborn in the wake of humanity's hubris.
Skeletal_Serpent.intro: Skeletal Serpent is an Apex fish found within the radius of an Atomic Nuke.

Skipjack_Tuna.description: The Skipjack Tuna can be caught near Snowcap Island. They are extremely agile swimmers, allowing them to put up a strong fight against anglers.
Skipjack_Tuna.intro: Skipjack Tuna is an Unusual fish found in Snowcap Island.

Skipper_Seal.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Skolopendra.description: An ancient Greek sea centipede titan that haunts the darkest abyssal rifts, striking violently from pitch-black trench walls with armor-piercing mandibles. A terror to Scylla...
Skolopendra.intro: Skolopendra is an Exotic fish found in Obsidian Trench of Mariana's Veil.

Skull.description: A hollow skull, worn smooth and silent after ages below.
Skull.intro: Skull is a Trash fish found in the Hades' Underworld of Indefinite.

Sky_Bass.description: A Sea Bass adapted to the skies.
Sky_Bass.intro: Sky Bass is a Common fish found in Above The Clouds.

Skybreaker_Leviathan.description: A massive leviathan that tears through the sea like a falling storm.
Skybreaker_Leviathan.intro: Skybreaker Leviathan is a Mythical fish found in Zeus's Thunder of Chaos.

Slag.description: A lump of cooled volcanic waste. Still warm to the touch. Not particularly valuable, but it's got a certain rough charm.
Slag.intro: Slag is Trash found in Scoria Reach.

Slain_Maw.intro: Slain Maw is a Limited fish found in the Crypt of the Green One.

Slate_Tuna.description: With their Stone Exocranium on the front of their body, the invasive Slate Tuna is able to hunt and kill pray at alarmingly high rates. However, this stone noggin of theirs also ends up in slower swim speeds for this predator, resulting with this fish being lower down on the food chain in this deep chasm.
Slate_Tuna.intro: Slate Tuna is a Common fish found in the Desolate Deep.

Slate_Turkey.description: Chiseled from rugged gray slate stone, this stoic turkey camouflages among rocky shores and pebbles. A sturdy, timeless choice for the Fischgiving table.
Slate_Turkey.intro: Slate Turkey is a Limited fish found in the Keepers Altar during the Fischgiving 2 event.
trivia: The Shiny Slate Turkey is based on the Developer Goth (@049492).

Slateskin_Potion.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Slender_Snipe_Eel.description: An extraordinarily thin, ribbon-like eel with a bird-like beak set with curved teeth to snag deep-sea shrimp.
Slender_Snipe_Eel.intro: Slender Snipe Eel is a Legendary fish found in the Gloomy Crevice.

Slipper_Lobster.description: Lobsters are valuable crustaceans known for their rich, succulent meat. Lobsters are most active in the summer to autumn, and are commonly caught in crab cages during calm clear days.
Slipper_Lobster.intro: Slipper Lobster is a Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

Sloane%27s_Viperfish.description: A mesopelagic predator with fang-like teeth and a bioluminescent lure.
Sloane%27s_Viperfish.intro: Sloane's Viperfish is a Rare fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Slurpfloth.description: A lazy, sloth-like swimmer with drooping fins, nibbling slowly in the dark waters.
Slurpfloth.intro: Slurpfloth is a Limited fish found in Octophant Hunts in the Second Sea.

Slushy.description: A frozen sugary drink that gives you an instant headache. A true summer classic.
Slushy.intro: Slushy is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.
trivia: When interacted with Slushy, it plays a slurping sound effect.
The Shiny variant of the Slushy resembles <additional info>.

Small-Spotted_Catshark.description: A small, spotted shark that rests on the bottom during the day.
Small-Spotted_Catshark.intro: Small-Spotted Catshark is a Mythical fish found in Sunken Reliquary.

Small_Spine_Chimera.description: A large, intimidating fish with spiny fins, sharp teeth, and a menacing, serpent-like body. The Chimera uses its pickaxe-like bill to strike targets, knocking them out or possible [ sic ] penetrating them entirely in two pieces.
Small_Spine_Chimera.intro: Small Spine Chimera is a Legendary fish found in The Depths of Vertigo.

Smallmouth_Bass.description: The Smallmouth Bass is a popular freshwater fish known for its fighting spirit and preference for clear, cool waters. It has a streamlined body with a greenish-brown coloration and distinctive horizontal stripes. It can be found in plenty of freshwaters, but is native to Terrapin Islands filtered water.
Smallmouth_Bass.intro: Smallmouth Bass is a Common fish found in Terrapin Island.

Smeltjaw_Snapper.description: A territorial fish with teeth that seem to shimmer with heat. It guards its thermal vent territory fiercely, snapping at anything that comes too close.
Smeltjaw_Snapper.intro: Smeltjaw Snapper is an Uncommon fish found in Scoria Reach.

Smogfish.description: A muted fish, drifting through the thick, choking haze.
Smogfish.intro: Smogfish is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Smokescreen_Totem.intro: Totems are a type of consumable item which allows the player to manipulate Weather and start Localized Events. There are currently 28 totems in Fisch, with 2 of them being unobtainable.

Smolderfang.description: A dark fish, its fins and gaze simmering with quiet intensity.
Smolderfang.intro: Smolderfang is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Smoldering_Stingray.description: A broad stingray with glowing magma veins running along its wings.
Smoldering_Stingray.intro: Smoldering Stingray is an Unusual fish found in Volcanic Vents of Mariana's Veil.

Smooth_Toadfish.description: A sleek, silvery toadfish typically gliding through coastal waters.
Smooth_Toadfish.intro: Smooth Toadfish is an Extinct fish found in Whale Interior.

Smoothie_Stingray.description: A colorful ray sporting pastel swirls of strawberry pink, mango yellow, and berry purple across its flat disc.
Smoothie_Stingray.intro: Smoothie Stingray is a Limited fish found in Skycrest.

Snakehead.description: A long, gold-colored fish, slithering with predatory grace.
Snakehead.intro: Snakehead is a Extinct fish found in the Open Ocean.

Snipefish.description: A black fish with purple fins and a ridiculous sniper scope on top, its long mouth aimed for disaster.
Snipefish.intro: Snipefish is an Unusual fish found at Outer Deep of The Deep.

Snook.description: The Common Snook is a cute salt water swimmer found commonly near Moosewood Docks. They are easy noticeable due to their thin black stripe across their body, and easily catchable due to schools during spawning season in spring.
Snook.intro: Snook is an Unusual fish found in Moosewood.

Snow_Crab.description: The Snow Crab is a long-legged crustacean with sweet meat, inhabiting cold muddy bottoms in northern seas.
Snow_Crab.intro: Snow Crab is an Uncommon fish found in Boreal Pines.

Snowback_Char.description: A majestic cold-water fish with crystalline scales that shimmer like fresh snow.
Snowback_Char.intro: Snowback Char is an Unusual fish found in the Cryogenic Canal.

Snowball.description: Perfect snowball that rolls underwater. Packs a chilly punch.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Snowball resembles a block of ice. When interacted with, it plays sound effect.

Snowcap_Algae.intro: Snowcap Algae is a Limited fish found in Algae Hunts during the Golden Tide event.

Snowcap_Lobster.description: Lobsters are valuable crustaceans known for their rich, succulent meat. Lobsters are most active in the summer to autumn, and are commonly caught in crab cages during calm clear days.
Snowcap_Lobster.intro: Snowcap Lobster is an Extinct fish found in Lobster Shores.

Snowfish.description: A mysterious fish whose scales form intricate snowflake patterns that never melt.
Snowfish.intro: Snowfish is a Rare fish found in the Frigid Cavern.

Snowflake.description: A delicate crystal of frozen perfection, each one uniquely sculpted by the winter wind.
Snowflake.intro: Snowflake is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Icestorm, MADNESS, Semi Chaos, MAYHEM, Snowstorm, MEGA MAYHEM, and Pure Chaos Admin Events.

Snowflake_Flounder.description: A very cold Flounder with a unique snowflake-like pattern on its body. Beware when holding - it's freezing cold!
Snowflake_Flounder.intro: Snowflake Flounder is a Limited fish found in the Winter Village during the Fischmas (2024) event.

Snowflake_Smelt.description: Slender fish with shimmering, iridescent scales resembling snowflakes/falling snow.
Snowflake_Smelt.intro: Snowflake Smelt is an Uncommon fish found in the Cryogenic Canal.

Snowgill_Dace.description: A small, silvery fish with frosty-white gills and a faint blue stripe along its side.
Snowgill_Dace.intro: Snowgill Dace is an Uncommon fish found in the Glacial Grotto.

Snowman.description: A jolly sentinel of snow, brought to life with a smile of coal and a heart of winter cheer!
Snowman.intro: Snowman is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Icestorm, Semi Chaos, MADNESS, MAYHEM, Snowstorm, MEGA MAYHEM, and Pure Chaos Admin Events.

Snowshoes.intro: The Snowshoes are a limited-time reusable piece of equipment, obtained during Fischmas (2025), which can be used to increase the player’s movement speed on land.

Snowy_Gravity_Coil.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Snowy_Present.description: Present dusted in snow. Cold shoulder to your hook, but full of surprises.
Snowy_Present.intro: Snowy Present is a Limited Crate found in the Glacial Ridge during the Fischmas 2 event.

Soaked_Sparkler.description: A sparkler that took a dip in the sea — still fizzing somehow.
Soaked_Sparkler.intro: Soaked Sparkler is a Limited fish found in the Patriotic Seas.

Sockeye_Salmon.description: The Sockeye Salmon are a very common type of salmon found near Moosewood, known for their vibrant red and green colors and interesting habits when laying eggs. They are very common during colder seasons such as Autumn, as that is the time most Sockeye Salmon lay their eggs.
Sockeye_Salmon.intro: Sockeye Salmon is a Common fish found in Moosewood.

Solar_Fragment.description: A magical stone with an etching representing the scorching heat of the sun.
Solar_Fragment.intro: Solar Fragment is a Fragment found in the Ancient Isle during an Eclipse.

Solarseer_Sturgeon.description: A radiant sturgeon that channels the power of the summer sun. Emerges only under the night sky.
Solarseer_Sturgeon.intro: Solarseer Sturgeon is a Mythical fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Solstice_Ray.description: A wide celestial ray whose body glows like a midsummer sky.
Solstice_Ray.intro: Solstice Ray is a Legendary fish found in Apollo's Song of Light.

Song_of_the_Deep.description: An immortal stone filled with the essence of a Divine Lantern Keeper.. Returning it to it's throne under the Statue of Sovereignty will result in your currently equipped rod being blessed with its immense power.
Song_of_the_Deep.intro: Song of the Deep is a Relic primarily obtained from Captain Ahab.
trivia: The description of the Song of the Deep is identical to the Exalted Relic.
Upon release, it had an 80% chance of failing the enchant.

Soulreaper_Bonds.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Soulwalker.intro: The Soulwalker is a reusable piece of equipment which can be used to increase the player's movement speed on land.

Sovereign_Oarfish.description: The Sovereign Oarfish is an elegant and extremely rare fish found within the Enchanted Crevice. Its long pale body and glowing crest seem to pulse with the same power leaking from the Statue of Sovereignty, making it one of the clearest signs that the altar has truly awakened.
Sovereign_Oarfish.intro: Sovereign Oarfish is a Mythical fish found in Enchanted Crevice.

Sovereign_Relic.description: An ancient stone radiating with the authority of the Keepers. Its power seems to answer the Statue of Sovereignty itself; allowing rods to be bound with forces never meant to be held for long.
Sovereign_Relic.intro: Sovereign Relic is a Relic primarily found inside of Sovereign Beam Pool during Sovereign Surge, Sovereign Storm or Sovereign Reckoning.

Spadefish.description: A sleek disk flashing through misty shallows.
Spadefish.intro: Spadefish is an Extinct fish found in Gilded Arch.

Sparkfin_Minnow.description: A tiny fish that crackles faintly with static as it moves.
Sparkfin_Minnow.intro: Sparkfin Minnow is a Common fish found in Zeus's Thunder of Chaos.

Sparkfin_Tetra.description: Small but fierce, these tetras have fins that constantly emit tiny electrical sparks. They school together to create impressive electrical displays.
Sparkfin_Tetra.intro: Sparkfin Tetra is a Common fish found in Atlantis.

Sparkler_Sardine.intro: Sparkler Sardine is a Limited fish found during the New Years Countdown event.

Sparkling_Totem.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Speartail_Pike.description: A lean predator with a tail shaped like a sharpened spear tip.
Speartail_Pike.intro: Speartail Pike is an Unusual fish found in the Bellona's Frenzy of War.

Spectral_Serpent.description: The Spectral Serpent is an aggressive and ginormous sea serpent species located in the Brine Pool of the Desolate Deep. They possess a translucent exo-membrane covering the inside of their body, as well as 4 bioluminescent eyes. They tend to lurk deeper within the Brine Pool, where they feed on microorganisms. Despite their specific diet, they have many sharp teeth and mandibles along with their hammerhead-shaped skull, which they can use to easily fend off invasive threats. When hooked, they put up an intense fight for even the most experienced anglers.
Spectral_Serpent.intro: Spectral Serpent is a Mythical fish found in the Desolate Deep 's Brine Pool.
trivia: Spectral Serpent may be a reference to the Ghost Leviathan, a creature from the video game Subnautica.

Spectral_Whale.description: A massive ghostly whale that drifts silently, its body fading in and out of reality.
Spectral_Whale.intro: Spectral Whale is a Mythical fish found in the Hades' Underworld of Indefinite during Soul Scourge, Soul Pools and Wisp Haunt.

Speed_Core.intro: Speed Core is an Exotic fish found in Sunstone Island.

Spider_Crab.description: A large, eerie crab with long, spindly legs and a tough, armored shell.
Spider_Crab.intro: Spider Crab is a Rare fish found in The Depths of Vertigo.

Spider_Salmon.description: A salmon covered in web-like patterns, creepy and crawly.

Spiderfish.description: The Spiderfish is a rare void fish, caught only in Vertigos calm waters. They are schooling fish and are a common prey of Vertigos vicious predators.
Spiderfish.intro: Spiderfish is a Common fish found in Vertigo.

Spike_Rune.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Spine_Blade.description: A sturdy vertebra from a long-lost fish, steeped in ancient mystery.
Spine_Blade.intro: Spine Blade is a Limited fish found in Roslit Bay during the Archaeological Hunt event.

Spine_Bone.description: Seems like the Spine bone of a really large fish...
Spine_Bone.intro: Spine Bone is a Limited fish in Roslit Bay during the Archaeological Hunt event.

Spined_Fin.description: A jagged, bony fin from a formidable fish, crafted by nature for defense.
Spined_Fin.intro: Spined Fin is a Limited fish found on Snowcap Island during the Archaeological Hunt event.

Spiny_Sunstone_Lobster.description: Lobsters are valuable crustaceans known for their rich, succulent meat. Lobsters are most active in the summer to autumn, and are commonly caught in crab cages during calm clear days.
Spiny_Sunstone_Lobster.intro: Spiny Sunstone Lobster is an Extinct fish found in Lobster Shores.

Splendid_Toadfish.description: A dazzling fish, camouflaged among vibrant coral reefs.
Splendid_Toadfish.intro: Splendid Toadfish is an Extinct fish found in Whale Interior.

Splinterfin_Carp.description: Its fins are jagged and uneven, like broken spearheads.
Splinterfin_Carp.intro: Splinterfin Carp is a Common fish found in the Bellona's Frenzy of War.

Split_Eye_Snapper.description: A savage snapper that strikes with unerring precision.
Split_Eye_Snapper.intro: Split-Eye Snapper is an Unusual fish found in Cursed Isle, formerly in The Cursed Shores.

Splitfin_Koi.description: A koi with fins that split and reform in layered shifting patterns.
Splitfin_Koi.intro: Splitfin Koi is a Uncommon fish found in Olympian Fissure.

Spooky_Relic.description: A stone filled with the blessing of the Vampire King. Returning it to its throne under the Statue of Sovereignty will result in your currently equipped rod being engulfed in its power.
Spooky_Relic.intro: Spooky Relic is a Limited Relic obtained from the Flying Dutchman and Trick-or-Treating during the FischFright 2025 event.

Spore_Lurker.description: A sneaky bottom-feeder that releases clouds of spores to evade predators. Its slimy hide is coated in fungal growths.
Spore_Lurker.intro: Spore Lurker is a Common fish found in the Toxic Grove.

Spotted_Drum.description: A juvenile fish with extremely long dorsal fins, adults are more modestly sized.
Spotted_Drum.intro: Spotted Drum is an Uncommon fish found in Crowned Ruins.

Spotted_Moray_Eel.description: A stealthy serpent slithering through misty crevices.
Spotted_Moray_Eel.intro: Spotted Moray Eel is a Extinct fish found in Gilded Arch.

Sprayfin.description: A vibrant yellow fish with dark yellow stripes, slashing through the water like a burst of sunlight.
Sprayfin.intro: Sprayfin is an Extinct fish found at Waveborne.

Squid.description: Squids can be found best at night in the surrounding ocean of Roslit Bay. Squids are rapid swimmers and largely locate their prey by sight. Squids are extremely intellegent and can even hunt in cooperative groups.
Squid.intro: Squid is an Unusual fish found in Roslit Bay.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Squid has a similar red coloration to the Colossal Squid 's.

Squirrelfish.description: A vivid nocturnal dweller illuminating coral crevices.
Squirrelfish.intro: Squirrelfish is an Extinct fish found in Gilded Arch.

Squirrelray.description: A nimble ray with a bushy tail, hoarding treasures in the sand.
Squirrelray.intro: Squirrelray is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the First Sea.

Stabilizer_Core.description: A humming, high-density mechanical sphere designed to calibrate large telescope arrays.
Stabilizer_Core.intro: Stabilizer Core is a Secret fish found in the Abyssal Zenith - Astral Cavern.

Stalactite.description: A sharp and spiky rock formation that has fallen from the ceiling of a formidable cavern.
Stalactite.intro: Stalactites are Trash found in the Desolate Deep.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Stalactite resembles a traffic cone. The model was made by @umbrxel.

Star.intro: Star is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Galaxy Admin Event.

Starbellied_Wolf_Fish.description: A fierce predator with a surface speckled like a starry night sky.
Starbellied_Wolf_Fish.intro: Starbellied Wolf Fish is a Rare fish found in Blue Moon events at Snowcap Island.

Starfall_Glass.description: A crystalline glass pane infused with glowing meteoric dust fallen into the ice pond.
Starfall_Glass.intro: Starfall Glass is an Exotic fish found in the Boreal Pines - Astral Cavern.

Starfall_Totem.intro: Totems are a type of consumable item which allows the player to manipulate Weather and start Localized Events. There are currently 28 totems in Fisch, with 2 of them being unobtainable.

Starfish.description: The starfish is a marine invertebrate with five arms that have hundreds of little feet which they use to move around. They prey on small organisms in their habitats, and are usually out and about during the daytime.
Starfish.intro: Starfish is an Uncommon fish found in the Ancient Isle.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Starfish is a direct reference to Patrick Star from SpongeBob SquarePants

Starlit_Seahorse.description: A tiny syngnathid whose dark body is speckled with pinpricks of brilliant glowing starlight.
Starlit_Seahorse.intro: Starlit Seahorse is a Legendary fish found in the Astral Observatory - Boreal Hollow.

Starlit_Weaver.description: These ethereal fish trail strands of bioluminescent light that weave complex patterns in the water. The patterns are said to map the currents of magical energy flowing through the abyss.
Starlit_Weaver.intro: Starlit Weaver is a Rare fish found in Atlantis.

Starry_Snapper.description: A snapper speckled with little white stars, like a patch of night sky.
Starry_Snapper.intro: Starry Snapper is a Limited fish found in the Patriotic Seas.

Static_Guppy.description: A flickering guppy that jitters with unstable energy.
Static_Guppy.intro: Static Guppy is a Common fish found in Zeus's Thunder of Chaos.

Static_Ray.description: This unique ray channels Zeus' power through its flat body, creating electromagnetic fields that stun smaller fish.
Static_Ray.intro: Static Ray is an Uncommon fish found in Atlantis.

Stationary_Egg.intro: Stationary Egg is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Egg Horde Admin Event.

Stinger_Skipper.description: A speedy fish with stinger-like fins that zap intruders.
Stinger_Skipper.intro: Stinger Skipper is an Unusual Fish found in the Nectar Den.

Stingray.description: Graceful and flat, stingrays glide effortlessly through the water, using their wide pectoral fins to move. Their long, whip-like tails end in a sharp stinger, which they can use for defence. Stingrays are bottom dwellers, often found in rocky and sandy seafloors and caves. [Contribution by @Johnny_D3pp]
Stingray.intro: Stingray is a Rare fish found in the Ocean.

Stockingfish.description: Wiggly stocking-shaped fish stuffed with holiday cheer (or maybe just coal).
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Stockingfish resembles a fish on a plaque. When held out, it plays " Merry Christmas (And a Happy New Year) " by Francis MacDonald, a track from his 2012 album "All I Want for Christmas".

Stoplight_Loosejaw.description: A deep-sea dragonfish with red and green bioluminescent lights for hunting zooplankton.
Stoplight_Loosejaw.intro: Stoplight Loosejaw is a Mythical fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Stoplight_Parrotfish.description: A radiant chewer crunching through coral clusters.
Stoplight_Parrotfish.intro: Stoplight Parrotfish is an Extinct fish found in Gilded Arch.

Storm_Eel.description: A serpentine fish that generates powerful electrical fields. Their bodies glow with inner lightning during storms.
Storm_Eel.intro: Storm Eel is an Unusual fish found in Atlantis.

Storm_Skipper.description: A dark blue fish crackling with light blue electric arcs, adorned with light blue spots and fins, skipping through tempests.
Storm_Skipper.intro: Storm Skipper is an Extinct fish found at Waveborne.

Stormcloud_Angelfish.description: A majestic fish whose fins ripple like storm clouds. They can generate powerful electrical fields that mirror Zeus' lightning.
Stormcloud_Angelfish.intro: Stormcloud Angelfish is a Rare fish found in Atlantis.

Stormgazer.description: The Stormgazer is a slower, mutated variant of the Gazerfish. They have several eyeballs covering their bodies, often used to cosntantly [ sic ] check their surroundings. When they are most active during the day, they swim just below the surface looking for a variety of smaller creatures to feed on.
Stormgazer.intro: Stormgazer is a Legendary fish found in the Desolate Deep 's Brine Pool during a Brine Storm.

Stormscale_Eel.description: An eel covered in rough scales that crackle with storm energy.
Stormscale_Eel.intro: Stormscale Eel is a Rare fish found in Zeus's Thunder of Chaos.

Stout_Blacksmelt.description: A dark mesopelagic fish possessing large, highly light-sensitive eyes suited for bathyal darkness.
Stout_Blacksmelt.intro: Stout Blacksmelt is an Unusual fish found at Lower Deep of The Deep.

Strange_Guitar.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Strata-Bound_Bass.description: A dense bass whose multi-colored scales perfectly mirror the geological strata lines of the canyon walls.
Strata-Bound_Bass.intro: Strata-Bound Bass is a Rare fish found in the Drylands.

String.description: A string! It likely has some sort of purpose...
String.intro: String is Trash found in the Desolate Deep.

Stringed_Grouper.description: A grouper with playable guitar strings, it's a mystery how this fish exists...
Stringed_Grouper.intro: Stringed Grouper is a Legendary fish found in Crystal Cove.
trivia: Interacting with the Stringed Grouper plays a guitar audio.

Stud_Koi.description: A graceful koi with shimmering orange LEGO studs, a masterpiece of the sea.
Stud_Koi.intro: Stud Koi is a Limited fish found in LEGO Pools during the LEGO Event.
trivia: The Stud Koi is from LEGO® Set 31129; Product page.

Stud_Shark.description: A fierce shark with sleek gray LEGO bricks, striking fear within the seas.
Stud_Shark.intro: Stud Shark is a Limited fish found in LEGO Pools during the LEGO Event.
trivia: The Stud Shark is from LEGO® Set 31109; Product page.

Stud_Turtle.description: A sturdy turtle with a shell made of interlocking LEGO bricks, slow but strong.
Stud_Turtle.intro: Stud Turtle is a Limited fish found in LEGO Pools during the LEGO Event.
trivia: The Stud Turtle is from LEGO® Set 31158; Product page.

Studling_Crab.description: A tiny crab with vibrant orange LEGO studs, scurrying along the ocean floor.
Studling_Crab.intro: Studling Crab is a Limited fish found in LEGO Pools during the LEGO Event.
trivia: The Studling Crab is from LEGO® Set 31122; Product page.

Studolodon.description: A prehistoric beast with massive LEGO brick plates, a plastic legend.
Studolodon.intro: Studolodon is a Limited fish found in Studolodon Hunts during the LEGO Event.
trivia: The Studolodon is from LEGO® Set 31088; Product page.

Studphin.description: A playful dolphin with sky-blue LEGO bricks, leaping through the waves.
Studphin.intro: Studphin is a Limited fish found in LEGO Pools during the LEGO Event.
trivia: The Studphin is from LEGO® Set 31128; Product page.

Studster.description: Lobsters are valuable crustaceans known for their rich, succulent meat. Lobsters are most active in the summer to autumn, and are commonly caught in crab cages during calm clear days.
Studster.intro: Studster is an Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

Stuffed_Bear.description: An adorable stuffed teddy bear that washed up, clutching a small heart.
Stuffed_Bear.intro: Stuffed Bear is a Limited fish found in Sweetheart Shores during the Valentides 2 event.

Sturgeon.description: A massive, ancient fish with a long, armoured body and distinctive bony plates. Sturgeons are known for their size and strength, making them challenging to catch.
Sturgeon.intro: Sturgeon is a Rare fish found in Snowcap Island.

Styx_Angler.description: A skeletal anglerfish with a ghastly lure, fading in and out as if bound to another plane.
Styx_Angler.intro: Styx Angler is an Exotic fish found in the Hades' Underworld of Indefinite during Styx Angler Hunts.

Subzero_Stargazer.description: A unique fish with glowing eyes that stare into the abyss. Its body is covered in frost.
Subzero_Stargazer.intro: Subzero Stargazer is an Uncommon fish found in the Challenger's Deep of Mariana's Veil.

Suckermouth_Catfish.description: The Suckermouth Catfish is a tropical freshwater fish found on the ground and near the seaweed of Roslits Bays pond. They are easily notable for their large armour like scutes covering their upper parts of the head and body.
Suckermouth_Catfish.intro: Suckermouth Catfish is a Rare fish found in Roslit Bay.

Sulfur_Fragment.description: A fragment of Sulfur; it seems to have unnatural powers...
Sulfur_Fragment.intro: Sulfur Fragment is a Fragment found in Scoria Reach.

Sulfur_Pearl.description: A pearl composed purely of sulfur, it's a wonder it hasn't exploded yet.
Sulfur_Pearl.intro: Sulfur Pearl is an Unusual fish found in Lava Clams at a 22.556% chance.

Sulfur_Snapper.description: A shadowy fish, its fins alight and eyes agleam in acrid waters.
Sulfur_Snapper.intro: Sulfur Snapper is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Summer_Reef_Titan.intro: Summer Reef Titan is a Special fish found in Admin-Exclusive.

Summer_Scylla.intro: Summer Scylla is a Special fish found in Admin-Exclusive.

Sun-Blistered_Perch.description: A hard-fighting predator with luminous orange scales that mimic the blazing desert heat.
Sun-Blistered_Perch.intro: Sun-Blistered Perch is a Mythical fish found in the Drylands.

Sunbed_Stingray.description: An ultra-flat stingray striped like a retro poolside lounge chair, perfectly designed for soaking up sun rays.
Sunbed_Stingray.intro: Sunbed Stingray is a Limited fish found in the Skycrest.

Sunburst_Soda.intro: Fischfest 2 is a summer-themed Event which lasts from June 20th until September 5th, 2026. The event features a new island which can be accessed through the use of the Magical Conch, several NPCs, and a new 'Sunshells' currency which can be exchanged for limited items.

Sunder-Whelp_Jaw.description: The juvenile, highly aggressive offspring of a apex desert leviathan. Its bite can snap ironwood oars clean in half.
Sunder-Whelp_Jaw.intro: Sunder-Whelp Jaw is a Mythical fish found in the Drylands.

Sundial_Totem.intro: Totems are a type of consumable item which allows the player to manipulate Weather and start Localized Events. There are currently 30 totems in Fisch, with 2 of them being unobtainable.

Sunfish.description: Sunfish are the heaviest bony fish species alive today. Common sunfish can weigh up to one metric tonne but on rare instances they can way two metric tonnes! The largest appeal of the ocean Sunfish is the unusual shape of it's body and it's astonishing weight. Sunfish have the name for their love of basking in the sun by floating to the surface of the water.
Sunfish.intro: Sunfish is a Legendary fish found in Sunstone Island.

Sunflare_Tetra.description: A vibrant fish, its fins radiating like the sun’s fleeting touch.
Sunflare_Tetra.intro: Sunflare Tetra is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Sunglasses.description: Stylish sunglasses lost by beachgoers, drifting in the ocean; essential for blocking those intense summer rays.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Sunglasses turns into a heart-shaped pair of shutter shades.

Sunken_Aegis_Shard.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Sunken_Silverscale.description: These fish have adapted to live among the submerged silver treasures. Their scales have taken on a metallic sheen that mimics the precious artifacts they swim among.
Sunken_Silverscale.intro: Sunken Silverscale is a Common fish found in Atlantis.

Sunleaf_Sunfish.description: A broad sunfish with leaves that glow golden in sunlight, basking near the canopy.
Sunleaf_Sunfish.intro: Sunleaf Sunfish is an Uncommon fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Sunny_O%27Coin.description: A bright yellow fish with a fitting eyepatch, it basks where gold is prevalent. A sunny St. Patrick's treasure!
Sunny_O%27Coin.intro: Sunny O'Coin is a Limited fish found within yellow-colored abundances during the Lucky Event.

Sunny_Turkey.description: Radiating warmth with feathers that shimmer like sunbeams on water, this cheerful turkey brings a beachy vibe to chilly autumn ponds. Perfectly sunny for your Fischgiving platter!
Sunny_Turkey.intro: Sunny Turkey is a Limited fish found at Sunstone Island during the Fischgiving (2025) event.
trivia: The Shiny Sunny Turkey is based on the Developer Rick (@s1mplyrick).

Sunray_Sunscale.description: A radiant scaler that basks in sunray glory.
Sunray_Sunscale.intro: Sunray Sunscale is an Extinct fish found in Pine Shoals.

Sunscale_Tetra.description: Its scales reflect sunlight in neat glden flashes.
Sunscale_Tetra.intro: Sunscale Tetra is a Common fish found in Apollo's Song of Light.

Sunscale_Tortoise.description: A radiant tortoise with golden, sun-like scales that shimmer even in the darkest storm waters. Apollo's blessing is said to protect these creatures from the storm's fury.
Sunscale_Tortoise.intro: Sunscale Tortoise is a Limited fish found in the Atlantean Storm during the Olympian Storm event.

Sunscreen_Bottle.description: A half-used bottle of sunscreen, vital for protecting skin during long, sunny summer outings.

Sunscreen_Spray.description: SPF 50; because sunburns are not a vibe. Keep yourself protected from the harsh summer rays.
Sunscreen_Spray.intro: Sunscreen Spray is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Sunslasher.description: Ancient sand serpent, awakened by the Tropical Sun. Its body is purely sand and burning grit; it does not swim, it grinds the seabed into dust. It seems to be a common target of beachgoers trying to simply build sand castles, leaving their plastic shovels behind in its body...
Sunslasher.intro: Sunslasher is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Sunsquid.description: A radiant squid that shimmers under the summer sun, known for its bright, sunny disposition and ink that glows like sunlight.
Sunsquid.intro: Sunsquid is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest island.

Super_Flippers.intro: The Super Flippers are a flippers equipment that can be used to aid in underwater maneuverability and is a direct upgrade from the Flippers.

Supersized_Bloop_Fish.intro: Supersized Bloop Fish is a Special fish found in any body of water during the MEGA MAYHEM and Supersizer Admin Events.

Supersized_Driftwood.intro: Supersized Driftwood is a Special fish found in any body of water during the MADNESS and Supersizer Admin Events.

Supersized_Floppy.intro: Supersized Floppy is a Special fish found in any body of water during the MEGA MAYHEM, MADNESS and Supersizer Admin Events.

Supersized_Mosslurker.intro: Supersized Mosslurker is a Special fish found in any body of water during the MEGA MAYHEM, MADNESS and Supersizer Admin Events.

Supersized_Scylla.intro: Supersized Scylla is a Special fish found in any body of water during the MADNESS, MEGA MAYHEM and Supersizer Admin Events.

Supersized_Sea_Pickle.intro: Supersized Sea Pickle is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Supersizer Admin Event.

Supreme_Present.description: A gistening christmas present wrapped in magical gift paper. Maybe it has some great goodies inside!
Supreme_Present.intro: Supreme Present is a Limited Crate found in the Winter Village during the Fischmas 1 event.

Surfboard_Ray.description: A flat ray that glides through the waves like a surfboard, often seen riding currents near summer beaches.

Surge_Pickerel.description: A long-bodied predator that lunges forward like a sudden wave.
Surge_Pickerel.intro: Surge Pickerel is an Unusual fish found in Poseidon's Storm of Floods.

Surge_Pike.description: A long, slender fish with light yellow fins, surging through the water with electric grace.
Surge_Pike.intro: Surge Pike is a Rare fish found at Waveborne.

Swamp_Bass.description: The Swamp Bass is species of Bass that can only be found in Swamp water. They are extremely similar to Smallmouth Bass besides their special adaptation; They have chameleon-like camouflage. This allows them to nearly entirely avoid being a prey of larger fish and Alligators.
Swamp_Bass.intro: Swamp Bass is a Common fish found in Mushgrove Swamp.

Swamp_Scallop.description: Swamp Scallops are a special kind of Scallops with a rich umami taste. They formed from an invasive growth of the Scallop population in Mushgrove Swamp.
Swamp_Scallop.intro: Swamp Scallop is an Unusual fish found in Mushgrove Swamp.

Swampfish.description: A blind cavefish from southeastern U.S. swamps and streams.
Swampfish.intro: Swampfish is a Legendary fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Swampjaw.description: A long, dark green fish with yellow fins, its jaws snapping in the swamp.
Swampjaw.intro: Swampjaw is an Extinct fish found in the Azure Lagoon.

Sweetfish.description: The Sweetfish is known for its delicate sweet flavour, and its golden hue. They are very commonly found in short river-like gap of Sunstone Island.
Sweetfish.intro: Sweetfish is a Common fish found in Sunstone Island.

Sweetheart_Seahorse.description: A pink seahorse with a tail curled to form a heart; covered with hearts in the spirit of Valentides!
Sweetheart_Seahorse.intro: Sweetheart Seahorse is a Limited fish found in Sweet Streams during the Valentides 2.

Swordfish.description: Swordfish are extremely strong and notable due to their long flattened bill that resembles a sword, as their name implies. They are a great catch, and anglers around the globe are impressed by a Swordfish catch.
Swordfish.intro: Swordfish is a Rare fish found in the Ocean.

TNT.intro: TNT is a reusable item that is necessary to blow up the blocked entrance to the Heart Of Zeus under the Grand Reef. It is required for accessing Atlantis.

Taco.intro: Taco is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Tacos Admin Event.

Tanning_Oil.description: For that golden glow. Apply generously and let the sun do its work.
Tanning_Oil.intro: Tanning Oil is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Tanning_Trout.description: A trout that's been working on its tan. It's practically glowing from all that sunbathing.
Tanning_Trout.intro: Tanning Trout is a Limited fish found at Fischfest 2.
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Tannin Trout looks supper tanned, a reference to the Super-Tanned mutation.

Tarnished_Moongill.description: A small fish with gills that shimmer like silver under moonlight.
Tarnished_Moongill.intro: Tarnished Moongill is a Mythical fish found in Blue Moon events at Snowcap Island or in any body of water during Skies of Anguish admin event.

Tartaruga.description: A colossal sea turtle cloaked in shadow, its shell a fortress of ancient secrets.
Tartaruga.intro: Tartaruga is an Exotic fish found at Sunstone Island.

Teddy_Bear.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Telescopefish.description: A long eel with beady yellow eyes and light green fins, peering into the abyss.
Telescopefish.intro: Telescopefish is an Extinct fish found in the Open Ocean.

Tempest_Colossus.description: Formed from the storm itself, this towering entity crashes through waves like a living cataclysm. Where it moves, the sky fractures and the sea answers.
Tempest_Colossus.intro: Tempest Colossus is a Limited fish found in the Atlantean Storm during the Tempest Colossus Hunts.

Tempest_Ray.description: A swift, flat-bodied ray with unique storm-pattern markings. They use their wing-like fins to glide through turbulent waters with ease, often found in groups near the surface of stormy seas.
Tempest_Ray.intro: Tempest Ray is an Uncommon fish found in the Atlantean Storm.

Tempest_Totem.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Temple_Drifter.description: These serene fish float gracefully through ethereal temples, their fins flowing like ceremonial robes. They seem to follow ancient patrol routes of the temple guardians.
Temple_Drifter.intro: Temple Drifter is an Uncommon fish found in Atlantis.

Temple_Eye.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Temple_Perch.description: A brown fish with light blue fins and accents, resting like a relic in ancient waters.
Temple_Perch.intro: Temple Perch is an Extinct fish found in Lushgrove.

Tentabrick.description: A cute octopus with green LEGO brick tentacles, a creature of the deep.
Tentabrick.intro: Tentabrick is a Limited fish found in LEGO Pools during the LEGO Event.
trivia: The Tentabrick is from LEGO® Set 31158; Product page.

Tentacle_Eel.description: An eel twisted by void energies, its body now covered in small tentacles that reach for anything nearby. Even other Kraken-touched creatures avoid it.
Tentacle_Eel.intro: Tentacle Eel is an Unusual fish found in Atlantis.

Tentacled_Horror.description: A creature more tentacle than fish, its form suggests a distant relation to the Kraken itself. The water around it seems darker, as if light itself fears to touch it.
Tentacled_Horror.intro: Tentacled Horror is an Uncommon fish found in Atlantis.

Tentacles_Junior.description: We he grows up, he wants to be OVAR 9000!!!
Tentacles_Junior.intro: Tentacles Junior is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Tentacles Admin Event.

Terrapin_Lobster.description: Lobsters are valuable crustaceans known for their rich, succulent meat. Lobsters are most active in the summer to autumn, and are commonly caught in crab cages during calm clear days.
Terrapin_Lobster.intro: Terrapin Lobster is an Extinct fish found in Lobster Shores.

Terrosunder.description: A terrifying, continent-shaking leviathan of the dunes. The Terrosunder commands the moving sand seas with unmatched weight and bone-crushing aggression.
Terrosunder.intro: Terrosunder is an Exotic fish found in the Drylands.

Terrosunder_Skull.description: An immensely heavy, hardened bony skull structural segment from an ancient apex sand-beast.
Terrosunder_Skull.intro: Terrosunder Skull is a Mythical fish found in the Drylands Sand.

Thalass_Essence.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

The_Cut_Gem.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

The_Depths_Key.description: This is the Key that leads to the gates of The Depths...
The_Depths_Key.intro: The Depths Key is an Exotic fish found in Vertigo. It is mainly used for opening the door to The Depths.

The_Kraken.description: The ruler of the abyssal depths, a being of such immense power that its mere presence warps the fabric of reality. Few have ever witnessed its true form and lived.
The_Kraken.intro: The Kraken is an Exotic fish found in Kraken Lair.

The_Whispering_One.description: In the stillness, The Whispering One mutters, with a voice exhibiting a choir of dread from beyond the unknown.
The_Whispering_One.intro: The Whispering One is a Limited fish found within the Cults Curse event.

Thermal_Harpoon.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Thicket_Leviabass.description: A bass from an earthy thicket, ruling the dense summer undergrowth waters.
Thicket_Leviabass.intro: Thicket Leviabass is a Rare fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Thorn_Ribbon_Eel.description: An eel with ribbon-like thorns that slice through water and foes alike.
Thorn_Ribbon_Eel.intro: Thorn Ribbon Eel is an Uncommon fish found in Living Garden.

Thornfish.description: A prickly terror that thorns through the deep.
Thornfish.intro: Thornfish is a Extinct fish found in Pine Shoals.

Three-eyed_Fish.description: A mutant fish with three glowing eyes, sleek scales, and a bizarre, eerie charm.
Three-eyed_Fish.intro: Three-eyed Fish is an Unusual fish found in The Depths of Vertigo.

Thunder_Bass.description: A powerful predator whose scales conduct electricity. During storms, they create impressive displays of bio-electricity across the water's surface.
Thunder_Bass.intro: Thunder Bass is an Unusual fish found in Atlantis.

Thunder_Serpent.description: A massive eel-like creature that channels Zeus' lightning directly. Its presence can electrify entire sections of the pool during storms.
Thunder_Serpent.intro: Thunder Serpent is a Legendary fish found in Atlantis.

Thunderclap_Crab.description: A heavy-shelled crab that snaps with explosive force.
Thunderclap_Crab.intro: Thunderclap Crab is a Rare fish found in Zeus's Thunder of Chaos.

Thundering_Seahorse.description: A majestic seahorse crackling with electrical energy. Each movement generates tiny sparks, and during storms, they can be seen riding lightning bolts through the water.
Thundering_Seahorse.intro: Thundering Seahorse is a Limited fish found in the Atlantean Storm during the Olympian Storm event.

Tidal_Pike.description: A swift pike species that rides the golden tides, its scales gleaming with an iridescent sheen that reflects the celebration's lights. These fish are known to dart through the water with remarkable agility.
Tidal_Pike.intro: Tidal Pike is a Limited fish found in special pools in the Ocean during the Golden Tide event.

Tidallow.description: A tiny, bright yellow fish with striking red eyes, darting through shallow waters.
Tidallow.intro: Tidallow is a Extinct fish found in the Isle of New Beginnings.

Tide_Essence.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Tide_Fang.description: A dark green fish with teal fins and light green spots, biting through the waves with feral might.
Tide_Fang.intro: Tide Fang is a Extinct fish found at Waveborne.

Tidebreaker.intro: The Tidebreaker is a diving equipment item that can be used to aid in underwater maneuverability

Tidecaller_Squid.description: A deep-dwelling squid with the ability to manipulate ocean currents around it. Legends says Poseidon gifted these creatures the power to command the tides.
Tidecaller_Squid.intro: Tidecaller Squid is a Limited fish found in the Atlantean Storm during the Olympian Storm event.

Tidecrasher_Archon.description: An immense divine beast of wave and ruin, crowned in jagged crests and dragging the sea behind it.
Tidecrasher_Archon.intro: Tidecrasher Archon is an Exotic fish found in Poseidon's Storm of Floods.

Tidepool_Minnow.description: A tiny silvery fish that darts in quick flashes between shifting water.
Tidepool_Minnow.intro: Tidepool Minnow is a Common fish found in Poseidon's Storm of Floods.

Tidepopper.description: A energetic fish that bursts from the tides, thriving in the dynamic waves of summer shores.
Tidepopper.intro: Tidepopper is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest island.

Tiki_Mask.description: An intricately carved tiki mask, representing tropical spirits and summer festivities!

Tiki_Trout.description: Ancient Polynesian woodcarving meets freshwater fish. It hums a low, ominous tune when the wind blows. Probably a god. Probably annoyed.
Tiki_Trout.intro: Tiki Trout is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Tilefish.description: A deep-dwelling monarch ruling sunlit ocean floors.
Tilefish.intro: Tilefish is an Extinct fish found in Gilded Arch.

Tilli%27s_Fragment.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Timeless_Threading.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Tinsel_Trout.description: Shiny trout tangled in tinsel. Sparkles more than your tree topper.

Tire.description: Who would leave this in an ocean? Seems to be in great condition too. A common tire for cars and pickup trucks.
Tire.intro: Tires are Trash found in various bodies of water.

Titan_Tuna.description: A tuna of impossible size, grown massive in Poseidon's blessed waters. Its powerful swimming can create whirlpools with a single tail flick.
Titan_Tuna.intro: Titan Tuna is an Uncommon fish found in Poseidon Temple.

Titanfang_Grouper.description: A fearsome grouper species unique to Poseidon Temple. Its massive jaws are lined with dagger-like teeth, making it one of the most formidable predators in these sacred waters.
Titanfang_Grouper.intro: Titanfang Grouper is a Rare fish found in Poseidon Temple.

Titanic_Black_Seadevil.description: An all black anglerfish with a glowing lure that can be seen from miles away.
Titanic_Black_Seadevil.intro: Titanic Black Seadevil is a Common fish found in the Abyssal Zenith of Mariana's Veil.

Titanic_Sturgeon.description: An ancient species grown to impossible size in Poseidon's domain. Its armored scales could withstand the pressure of the deepest trenches.
Titanic_Sturgeon.intro: Titanic Sturgeon is a Rare fish found in Atlantis.

Titanspawn_Serpent.description: A colossal serpent born from the fracture of something far older.
Titanspawn_Serpent.intro: Titanspawn Serpent is a Legendary fish found in Olympian Fissure.

Toilet_Fish.description: i need to take a dump
Toilet_Fish.intro: Toilet Fish is a Special fish found during the Secret Storm Admin Event, and formerly in the Open Ocean.
trivia: This fish is likely a reference to the " Skibidi Toilet " YouTube series by DaFuqBoom

Tompot_Blenny.description: A small, curious fish with tentavles above its eyes, peering from holes.
Tompot_Blenny.intro: Tompot Blenny is a Rare fish found in Crowned Ruins.

Torrential_Catfish.description: A wide-headed catfish that wakes from stasis only during sudden, heavy desert flash floods.
Torrential_Catfish.intro: Torrential Catfish is a Rare fish found in the Drylands.

Toxic_Guardian.description: A corrupted guardian twisted by wither energies, blending beauty and blight.
Toxic_Guardian.intro: Toxic Guardian is a Secret fish found in the Living Garden.
trivia: The Toxic Guardian bears resemblance to the Legendary Pokémon Necrozma

Toxic_Jellymass.description: A wobbly mass of toxic jelly. Useless, but it jiggles nicely.
Toxic_Jellymass.intro: Toxic Jellymass is a Trash fish found in the Toxic Grove.

Toxified_Crab.description: A toxic crab that scuttles through the poisoned waters, its shell hardened by blight.
Toxified_Crab.intro: Toxified Crab is a Mythical fish found in the Toxic Grove.

Toxinburst_Handle.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).
