Translator_Core.intro: Translator Core is a Trash fish found in Roslit Bay.

Traveler%27s_Whistle.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Treasure_Map.intro: Treasure Hunting is a game system in Fisch involving randomly-obtained Treasure Maps.

Treble_Bass.description: The Treble Bass is an interesting sub-species of bass that can produce piano-like sounds with its many gills. Legend has it you can tune a fish, but not a treble bass. Or can you?
Treble_Bass.intro: Treble Bass is an Exotic fish found in Moosewood.
trivia: When interacted with, the treble bass plays notes from C major scale on piano in ascending order.

Trevally.description: A swift fish cutting through open waters with ease.
Trevally.intro: Trevally is an Unusual fish found in Castaway Cliffs.

Tridentfish.description: A sleek fish with three sharp forward prongs on its face like a living spear.
Tridentfish.intro: Tridentfish is a Rare fish found in Poseidon's Storm of Floods during Poseidon Wrath.

Tripod_Fish.description: A metallic black fish with absurdly long blue fins, tripping over itself like a clumsy tripod.
Tripod_Fish.intro: Tripod Fish is a Rare fish found at Outer Deep of The Deep.

Triton%27s_Herald.description: These majestic fish were said to announce the arrival of ancient rulers. Their fins resemble flowing trumpets, and they produce a haunting call that carries for miles underwater.
Triton%27s_Herald.intro: Triton's Herald is a Rare fish found in Atlantis.

Tropical_Bait_Crate.description: A weathered wooden crate adorned with tropical leaves, designed to keep the bait fresh and lively. Likely drifted ashore from a fishing vessel exploring warm, exotic waters. The bait inside is vibrant and for the taking! Open it for a haul of tropical baits!
Tropical_Bait_Crate.intro: Tropical Bait Crate is a Rare Crate that can be fished in Cursed Isle, or bought at Sunstone Island.

Tropical_Relic.description: A relic that hums with tropical energy. Smells faintly of coconut and secrets.
Tropical_Relic.intro: Tropical Relic is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Tropical_Sun_Totem.intro: Fischfest 2 is a summer-themed Event which lasts from June 20th until September 5th, 2026. The event features a new island which can be accessed through the use of the Magical Conch, several NPCs, and a new 'Sunshells' currency which can be exchanged for limited items.

Tropicspike.description: A striking fish, its fins a vivid dance of shifting hues.
Tropicspike.intro: Tropicspike is an Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Trout.description: The Trout is a common freshwater fish found in all waters of Moosewood & Roslit. Trouts are well recognized for their interesting dotted patterns and pinkish-red ribbon across the sides of their soft bodies. Trouts also interestingly have two hearts to help efficiently pump blood throughout their body.
Trout.intro: Trout is a Common fish found in Moosewood.

Trumpetfish.description: The Trumpetfish is a long, slender fish known for its tubular body and pointed snout. Its unique shape makes it a fascinating sight for visitors of Sunstone.
Trumpetfish.intro: Trumpetfish is an Unusual fish found in Sunstone Island.
trivia: One of the catch quips is likely a reference to the opening trumpets of the song family ties by American rapper Baby Keem.

Tsunami_Whale.description: A colossal whale whose passing feels less like a creature and more like a disaster.
Tsunami_Whale.intro: Tsunami Whale is a Mythical fish found in Poseidon's Storm of Floods during Storm Flood.

Tumor_Pike.description: A monstrous pike that dominates through sheer malice.
Tumor_Pike.intro: Tumor Pike is an Unusual fish found in Cursed Isle, formerly in The Cursed Shores.

Turkey.description: Turkeys are large and heavy birds with a uniquely-shaped tail consisting of many feathers that line up to create a circular pattern. However, the poor Turkey is the desired choice of food for many fischers for Fischgiving dinner.
Turkey.intro: Turkey is a Limited fish found anywhere during the Fischgiving 1 event.
trivia: When interacted with, the Turkey plays the 'gobble' sound effect from the Turkey Leg Roblox gear.

Turkey_Leg.description: Gobble Gobble Yum Yum! Forks are lame...
Turkey_Leg.intro: Turkey Leg is a Special fish found in any body of water during the MEGA MAYHEM and Food Admin Events.
trivia: The Shiny variant will play a chewing sound when interacted with.

Tuskmaw.description: An extremely dangerous octopus with giant tusks; known for destroying fish at the bottom of the ocean...
Tuskmaw.intro: Tuskmaw is a Divine Secret fish found rarely in the Ocean.

Twilight_Eel.description: The Twilight Eel, whilst resembling a giant tadpole, is an Eel. Twilight Eels are extremely slimy, and use the bulb on their head to attract prey.
Twilight_Eel.intro: Twilight Eel is an Uncommon fish found in Vertigo.

Twilight_Glowfish.description: Masters of both light and shadow, these mysterious fish emit a captivating glow that intensifies during twilight hours. Their presence is said to reveal hidden pathways in ancient ruins.
Twilight_Glowfish.intro: Twilight Glowfish is a Rare fish found in Sunken Depths.

Twilight_Pegs.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Twilight_Tentaclefish.description: A long, tentacle-like fish with glowing eyes and a body that shimmers in the dark.
Twilight_Tentaclefish.intro: Twilight Tentaclefish is a Mythical fish found in the Veil of the Forsaken of Mariana's Veil.

Twisted_Relic.description: An evil stone filled with the essence of Merlin's dark energy.. Taking it under the Statue of Sovereignty will result in your currently equipped rod being cursed with its unknown power.
Twisted_Relic.intro: Twisted Relic is a Relic obtained from Merlin.

Typhleotris.description: A blind cave gudgeon from Madagascar karst caves, lacking pigmentation.
Typhleotris.intro: Typhleotris is an Uncommon fish found in the Cultist Lair.

Typhoon_Devourer.description: A relentless predator that feeds on the chaos of god-sent storms, swallowing wind, water, and anything caught within. It grows stronger with every surge of fury the storm unleashes.
Typhoon_Devourer.intro: Typhoon Devourer is a Limited fish found in the Atlantean Storm during Typhoon Devourer Hunts.

Typhoon_Tailfin.description: A large fish with the power of a typhoon.
Typhoon_Tailfin.intro: Typhoon Tailfin is a Legendary fish found in the Veil of the Forsaken of Mariana's Veil.

Typhoon_Tuna.description: A massive tuna species with storm-cloud coloring and unusual fin patterns. They swim in the heart of the Atlantean Storm, using the powerful currents to achieve incredible speeds.
Typhoon_Tuna.intro: Typhoon Tuna is a Rare fish found in the Atlantean Storm.

UFO.intro: UFO is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Aliens or MADNESS Admin Event.

Ugly_Sweater.intro: The Ugly Sweater is a suit equipment that keeps the player's temperature bar full. It is a necessary item to climb up the higher parts of the Northern Expedition and is useful in the Challenger's Deep.

Umbral_Matrix.description: A dark, light-absorbing module recovered from forbidden observatory subterranean chambers.
Umbral_Matrix.intro: Umbral Matrix is a Secret fish found in the Astral Observatory - Everturn Forest.

Umbral_Shark.description: Umbral Sharks are a nocturnal bottom feeder, spending most of their time on the floor or in small crevices. They are gentle and slow-moving until provoked. Once angered, they can be extremely strong swimmers and often will break fishing lines. They are extremely rare, as they don't often come high enough in the water for anyone to see.
Umbral_Shark.intro: Umbral Shark is a Legendary fish found in the Keepers Altar.

Umbraleaf_Sturgeon.description: A shadowy sturgeon wrapped in autumn leaves, appearing only at night during the fall fade.
Umbraleaf_Sturgeon.intro: Umbraleaf Sturgeon is a Mythical fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Unique_Present.description: A nice christmas present wrapped in white and teal gift paper. Maybe it has some better goodies inside!
Unique_Present.intro: Unique Present is a Limited Crate found in the Winter Village during the Fischmas 1 event.

Unrefined_Magnetite_Core.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Unstable_Crystal.description: A crackling, energy-dense crystal lattice that vibrates with raw cosmic power.
Unstable_Crystal.intro: Unstable Crystal is a Secret fish found in the Astral Observatory - Boreal Pines.

Valentine%27s_Relic.description: An extra-lovely relic created by Cupid; pulsing with intensified Valentine's magic
Valentine%27s_Relic.intro: Valentine's Relic is a Limited Relic obtained from fishing in any body of water, rewarded from the Wishing Well, or purchased during the Valentides 2 event.

Vampire_Perch.description: A blood-sucking perch with fangs ready to bite.
Vampire_Perch.intro: Vampire Perch is a Limited fish found in Frightful Pools during the FischFright 2025 event.

Vampire_Squid.description: A deep-sea cephalopod with glowing red eyes and webbed arms, cloaking itself in crimson currents.
Vampire_Squid.intro: Vampire Squid is a Mythical fish found in the Crimson Cavern.

Vanity.description: A Smurf obsessed with their own reflection.
Vanity.intro: Vanity is a Limited fish found in the Smurfs Movie Event pools.

Varn%27s_Amulet_Fragment.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Veilborn_Parasite.description: From an unknown origin, the Veilborn Parasite clings, with tendrils threading through its target.
Veilborn_Parasite.intro: Veilborn Parasite is a Limited fish found within the Cults Curse event.

Veiled_Charybdis.description: A colossal vortex given form; Charybdis devours all who draw near. Said to have once been a goddess cursed to hunger eternally, her swirling maw still consumes ships, storms, and even the sea itself.
Veiled_Charybdis.intro: Veiled Charybdis is an Apex fish found in Obsidian Trench of Mariana's Veil.
trivia: The music played during the second phase is " tiny fire rat (battle) " by AZALI.

Veiled_Gauntlets.intro: The Veiled Gauntlets are a gloves equipment that converts part of the Progress Speed into Forced Progress Speed on hunt fish.

Veilfin_Koi.description: A pale koi with long flowing fins like drifting funeral veils.
Veilfin_Koi.intro: Veilfin Koi is an Unusual fish found in the Hades' Underworld of Indefinite.

Veinfin_Tetra_School.intro: Veinfin Tetra School is an Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

Veinspawn.description: A merciless spawn that pulses with unyielding power.
Veinspawn.intro: Veinspawn is a Legendary fish found in Cursed Isle, formerly in The Cursed Shores.

Velocity_Coil.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Velvet_Belly_Lanternshark.description: A somewhat blue shark with light blue fins, glowing softly in the depths.
Velvet_Belly_Lanternshark.intro: Velvet Belly Lanternshark is a Extinct fish found in the Open Ocean.

Venoblossom.intro: Venoblossom is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Buffed Overgrowth, Overgrowth and MADNESS Admin Events.
trivia: The Venoblossom is a direct reference to Plantera's Bulb, a boss summon from Terraria.

Venom_Maw.description: A gaping maw filled with venomous fangs. It swallows schools whole in the boiling toxic pools.
Venom_Maw.intro: Venom Maw is a Legendary fish found in the Toxic Grove during Toxic Boils.

Verdant_Mirage.description: A dark cyan fish with bright light blue accents, a mirage in the lagoon’s heart.
Verdant_Mirage.intro: Verdant Mirage is an Extinct fish found in the Azure Lagoon.

Verdant_Spiritfish.description: An ethereal fish that glows with verdant energy, said to be the spirit of the awakening forest.
Verdant_Spiritfish.intro: Verdant Spiritfish is a Rare fish found in the Everturn Forest.

Vibranium_Fairy_Wrasse.description: A deep-water wrasse named for its metallic violet scales and intricate geometric head markings.
Vibranium_Fairy_Wrasse.intro: Vibranium Fairy Wrasse is a Legendary fish found in Skycrest.

Vimble%27s_Fragment.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Vine_Line.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Vine_Rune.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Vinefish.description: A slender green fish with yellow fins, slithering through the currents with serpentine grace.
Vinefish.intro: Vinefish is an Extinct fish found in Lushgrove.

Violet_Seed.description: A seed found from flowers within the Living Garden
Violet_Seed.intro: Violet Seed is a Seed fish found in the Living Garden.

Viperfish.description: A ferocious fish with needle-like teeth, lurking in crimson shadows.
Viperfish.intro: Viperfish is a Rare fish found in the Crimson Cavern.

Void-Drifter_Jelly.description: A translucent, dark-hued deep sea jellyfish that pulses effortlessly through high zenith currents.
Void-Drifter_Jelly.intro: Void-Drifter Jelly is a Legendary fish found in Abyssal Zenith of Mariana's Veil.

Void_Angler.description: An ancient deep-sea predator that dwells in the darkest depths of the Atlantean Storm. Their bioluminescent lures create hypnotic patterns that mirror the swirling waters above, attracting both prey and the unwary.
Void_Angler.intro: Void Angler is a Mythical fish found in the Atlantean Storm.

Void_Emperor.description: An entity of pure darkness that commands the void itself. Its presence can extinguish light and create areas of absolute darkness in the water.
Void_Emperor.intro: Void Emperor is a Mythical fish found in Atlantis.

Void_Skin_Crate.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Void_Wood.description: Believed to channel the mysteries of the Void, its wood pulses with an enigmatic, otherworldly energy.
Void_Wood.intro: Void Wood is a Legendary Crafting Ingredient found in the Keepers Altar.

Voided_Glove.intro: The Voided Glove is a gloves equipment which can be used to rarely duplicate fish.

Voidfin_Mahi.description: The Voidfin Mahi are extremely fast and sensitive fish. They can sense a heartbeat from hundreds of miles, and are capable of swimming through some solid bio-matters, such as wood.
Voidfin_Mahi.intro: Voidfin Mahi is a Rare fish found in Vertigo.

Voidglow_Ghostfish.description: A ghostly fish with a glowing body that seems to phase in and out of existence.
Voidglow_Ghostfish.intro: Voidglow Ghostfish is a Legendary fish found in the Abyssal Zenith of Mariana's Veil.

Voidscale_Guppy.description: These small but remarkable fish have scales that seem to absorb light itself. They create patches of pure darkness in the water, making them nearly invisible when still.
Voidscale_Guppy.intro: Voidscale Guppy is a Rare fish found in Atlantis.

Volcanic_Gauntlets.intro: The Volcanic Gauntlets are a gloves equipment that periodically slashes the hooked fish, burning it for bonus Progress Speed.

Volcanic_Geode.description: The Volcanic Geode encases a magma crystal core, preserving its contents with an amber-like quality. Within this geode, you might find a trove of rare or extinct treasures— it's like a volcanic Christmas!
Volcanic_Geode.intro: Volcanic Geode is a Rare Crate found in the Volcano in Roslit Bay.

Volcanic_Prowler.description: A stealthy fish, its teeth sharp and edges warm with fire.
Volcanic_Prowler.intro: Volcanic Prowler is a Extinct fish found in Emberreach.

Voltfin_Carp.description: These large carp have fins that spark with electrical energy. They gather in groups during storms to create spectacular light shows.
Voltfin_Carp.intro: Voltfin Carp is a Common fish found in Atlantis.

Voltfish.description: The Voltfish is a lightning-fast relative of the Mythic Fish. They swim solo near the surface of the waters surrounding Sunstone, and make sporadic movements when hooked.
Voltfish.intro: Voltfish is a Mythical fish found in Sunstone Island.

Voltstripe_Carp.description: A carp lined with glowing stripes that pulse like currents of electricity.
Voltstripe_Carp.intro: Voltstripe Carp is an Uncommon fish found in Zeus's Thunder of Chaos.

Vortex_Barracuda.description: An aggressive predator with spiral markings and enhanced swimming muscles. These barracuda have learned to use the storm's currents to their advantage when hunting, creating their own miniature whirlpools.
Vortex_Barracuda.intro: Vortex Barracuda is an Unusual fish found in the Atlantean Storm.

Vortex_Ray.description: A deep blue fish with yellow accents and dark blue stripes, swirling through the depths.
Vortex_Ray.intro: Vortex Ray is an Extinct fish found at Waveborne.

Walleye.description: The Walleye is a predatory fish known for its sharp teeth and distinctive large eyes. The Walleye can be found around the East side of Terrapin Island.
Walleye.intro: Walleye is an Uncommon fish found in Terrapin Island.

Wanwood_Egg.description: Forged from the roots of the last waning grove.
Wanwood_Egg.intro: Wanwood Egg is a Special fish found in any body of water during the Egg Horde Admin Event.

Warlord_Sturgeon.description: An ancient sturgeon bearing scars, mass, and presence worthy of a commander.
Warlord_Sturgeon.intro: Warlord Sturgeon is a Mythical fish found in the Bellona's Frenzy of War during War Surge.

Warstripe_Bass.description: A hardened bass marked with dark stripes like old war paint.
Warstripe_Bass.intro: Warstripe Bass is an Unusual fish found in the Bellona's Frenzy of War.

Warty_Angler.description: A black angler with a wide, toothless mouth, luring prey with warty charm.
Warty_Angler.intro: Warty Angler is an Extinct fish found in the Open Ocean.

Warty_Frogfish.description: A camouflaged oddity lurking among rocky outcrops.
Warty_Frogfish.intro: Warty Frogfish is a Rare fish found in Castaway Cliffs.

Warty_Oreo.description: A deep-water fish with a compressed, disc-like body and rough scales.
Warty_Oreo.intro: Warty Oreo is an Uncommon fish found in the Crowned Ruins.

Watching_Glowfin.description: A vigilant presence that glows with quiet menace.
Watching_Glowfin.intro: Watching Glowfin is an Extinct fish found in Pine Shoals.

Water_Balloon.description: A round, squishy missile of refreshing chaos. Perfect for surprise attacks, hot day revenge, or just watching your friend run in slow motion.
Water_Balloon.intro: Water Balloon is a Limited fish found in the Fischfest 2.

Water_Bubble.intro: The Water Bubble is a diving gear equipment that can be used to aid in breathing underwater.

Water_Rune.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Water_Shoes.intro: The Water Shoes are a reusable piece of equipment which can be used to increase the player’s movement speed on sand and in water.

Watermelon.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Watermelon_Walrus.description: A heavy marine mammal featuring dark green striped hide and juicy pink tusk accents.
Watermelon_Walrus.intro: Watermelon Walrus is a Limited fish found in Skycrest.

Wave_Piercer.description: A grey fish with light blue fins and dark grey stripes, cutting through the waves with ethereal precision.
Wave_Piercer.intro: Wave Piercer is a Extinct fish found at Waveborne.

Waveborne_Lobster.description: Lobsters are valuable crustaceans known for their rich, succulent meat. Lobsters are most active in the summer to autumn, and are commonly caught in crab cages during calm clear days.
Waveborne_Lobster.intro: Waveborne Lobster is an Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

Weather_Matrix.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing `, ~ or G).

Werewolf_Walleye.description: A walleye that howls at the moon, transforming under the night sky.

West_Australian_Lanternshark.description: A small dogfish shark boasting ventral photophores that emit a soft bioluminescent glow.
West_Australian_Lanternshark.intro: West Australian Lanternshark is a Common fish at Lower Deep of The Deep.

Western_Rock_Lobster.description: Lobsters are valuable crustaceans known for their rich, succulent meat. Lobsters are most active in the summer to autumn, and are commonly caught in crab cages during calm clear days.
Western_Rock_Lobster.intro: Western Rock Lobster is an Extinct fish found in Netter's Haven.

Whale_Egg.intro: Eggs are a type of items obtainable in Fisch. They can be opened to receive items such as Bait and C$, or more rarely contain unique Egg-exclusive items.

Whale_Shark.description: Whale Sharks are large but friendly sharks, as opposed to other sharks found in the Ocean. They are most active during the day, where they swim around in search of small organisms to eat. Despite being playful and harmless, they will still put up quite a hefty fight when hooked.
Whale_Shark.intro: Whale Shark is a Mythical fish found in Shark Hunts.
trivia: The Whale Shark model seen swimming around its respective shark hunt has a 'Homeless Ant' texture on its mouth part.

Whiptail_Catfish.description: The Whiptail Catfish is a small herbivorous fish that have a long body which resembles a whiptail. They tend to be shy and often hide under plants and rocks during the day, but are most active at night.
Whiptail_Catfish.intro: Whiptail Catfish is a Legendary fish found in Moosewood.

Whirlpool_Marlin.description: A powerful marlin species that thrives in the chaotic waters of the Atlantean Storm. Their distinctive spiral-patterned bill helps them navigate through powerful currents while hunting.
Whirlpool_Marlin.intro: Whirlpool Marlin is an Unusual fish found in the Atlantean Storm.

Whirlpool_Snapper.description: A broad snapper that twists violently, pulling like a spinning current.
Whirlpool_Snapper.intro: Whirlpool Snapper is a Legendary fish found in Poseidon's Storm of Floods.

Whisker_Bill.description: The Whisker Bill is a mythical creature that was a popular staple of Moosewood Island before they were thought to be extinct. Whisker Bills are extremely strong, however are awkward swimmers due to their peculiar archetype.
Whisker_Bill.intro: Whisker Bill is a Mythical fish found in Moosewood.

Whisper_Eel.description: A light blue eel with translucent accents, its whispers echo through the currents.
Whisper_Eel.intro: Whisper Eel is an Extinct fish found in the Isle of New Beginnings.

White_Bass.description: The White Bass is a slender, silvery fish with horizontal black stripes running along its body. It can be found in plenty of freshwaters, but is native to Terrapin Islands filtered water.
White_Bass.intro: White Bass is an Uncommon fish found in Terrapin Island.

White_Perch.description: The Perch is a common freshwater fish that is best found in Mushgrove Swamp; Unlike the classic Perch, the White Perch has no noticeable stripes.
White_Perch.intro: White Perch is a Common fish found in Mushgrove Swamp.

White_Sturgeon.description: A majestic White Sturgeon, gliding through Snowburrow’s icy depths. Its massive, armored body and silvery scales make it a legendary catch among anglers.
White_Sturgeon.intro: White Sturgeon is an Exotic fish found in Snowburrow.

Widow_Bloom.description: A flower-like predator with venomous petals that mimic harmless blooms to lure in unsuspecting fish.
Widow_Bloom.intro: Widow Bloom is a Rare fish found in the Toxic Grove.

Wiifish.description: The Wiifish is a legendary tropic fish that can only be found in the saltwater’s [ sic ] Sunstone Island during the day. They are an extremely old fish, dating back over 230,000,000 years ago. While the Wiifish is a slow swimmer, they can put up an immense fight for even advanced anglers.
Wiifish.intro: Wiifish is a Legendary fish found in Sunstone Island.
trivia: The Wiifish is a reference to the 'Mystery Fish' featured on Nintendo's Wii Play fishing game.

Windset_Totem.intro: Totems are a type of consumable item which allows the player to manipulate Weather and start Localized Events. There are currently 28 totems in Fisch, with 2 of them being unobtainable.

Winged_Carp.description: An ordinary Carp that yearned for the sky.
Winged_Carp.intro: Winged Carp is a Uncommon fish found in Above The Clouds.

Winter_Boots.intro: The Winter Boots are a reusable piece of equipment which can be used to increase the player’s movement speed on snow.

Winter_Cloak.intro: The Winter Cloak is a suit equipment that keeps the player's temperature bar full. It is a necessary item to climb up the higher parts of the Northern Expedition and is useful in the Challenger's Deep.

Winter_Gloves.intro: The Winter Gloves are a gloves equipment which can be used to catch fish with either Peppermint, Gingerbread, or Merry Mutation.
trivia: All mutations that the Winter Gloves provides are affected by Mutation Surge.

Wisp_(Item).intro: FischFright (2025) is the Halloween-themed annual event that occured during 2025 which lasted from October 18, 2025 - November 3, 2025. It featured the Crook's Hallow, new NPCs with unique quests and new Event fishes.

Wispfin_Minnow.description: A faint, drifting fish with fins that trail like pale smoke.
Wispfin_Minnow.intro: Wispfin Minnow is a Common fish found in the Hades' Underworld of Indefinite.

Witches_Brew.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Witherbloom.description: A withered secret variant of Rotbloom, infused with ancient blight curses. Too eerie to release.
Witherbloom.intro: Witherbloom is a Secret fish found in the Toxic Grove.

Wixie%27s_Fragment.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Wobbegong_Shark.description: A flat, patterned 'carpet shark' that lies perfectly still on the seafloor.
Wobbegong_Shark.intro: Wobbegong Shark is a Mythical fish found in Coral Bastion.

Wraith-Whisper_Ray.description: A spectral batoid ray that glides silently through spectral waters, leaving a trail of faint phosphorescence.
Wraith-Whisper_Ray.intro: Wraith-Whisper Ray is a Legendary fish found in Veil of the Forsaken of Mariana's Veil.

Wraithfin.intro: Wraithfin is a Limited fish found in the Crypt of the Green One.

Wreath_Wrasse.description: It seems to be so full of joy and festivities, that it's wearing a wreath!
trivia: The Shiny variant of the Wreath Wrasse resembles a wreath with little fish.

Wretched_Guppy.description: In the shadowed shallows, the Wretched Guppy festers, with scales peeling like forgotten curses.
Wretched_Guppy.intro: Wretched Guppy is a Limited fish found within the Cults Curse event.

Wyvern.description: An ancient dragon-like beast lurking above the clouds.
Wyvern.intro: Wyvern is an Exotic fish found in Above The Clouds during Wyvern Hunts.
trivia: The Wyvern is a direct reference to the Wyvern, a long white Chinese Dragon from the video game Terraria.

X-ray_Tetra.description: A transparent fish with a colorful hue inside, light blue fins, and vibrant eyes.
X-ray_Tetra.intro: X-ray Tetra is an Exotic fish found in the Open Ocean.

Xiphactinus.description: Xiphactinus is a massive, fast predator from the Cretaceous, with sharp teeth, sleek body, and incredible hunting efficiency.
Xiphactinus.intro: Xiphactinus is an Unusual fish found in the Ancient Isle.

Xtra_Sour_Gummy_Pack.description: A sour pack of gummies; so sour even the fish would pucker!
Xtra_Sour_Gummy_Pack.intro: Xtra Sour Gummy Pack is a Limited Crate obtained from any body of water during the FischFright 2025 event.

Yellow_Boxfish.description: Yellow Boxfish are known for their odd box-shaped body along with their vibrant yellow hue. Despite the cute appearance, they are incredibly toxic to the touch. They lurk around the coral reefs of Roslit Bay during the day.
Yellow_Boxfish.intro: Yellow Boxfish is an Unusual fish found in Roslit Bay.

Yellow_Conch.intro: Fischfest 2 is a summer-themed Event that lasts from June 20th until September 5th, 2026. The event features a new island that can be accessed using the Magical Conch, several NPCs, and a new Sunshells currency, which can be exchanged for limited items.

Yellow_Energy_Crystal.description: A yellow-hued crystal, told to possess mystical powers.
Yellow_Energy_Crystal.intro: Yellow Energy Crystal is a Mythical fish found on the cliffs of the Northern Expedition mountain during an Avalanche.

Yellow_Message_in_a_Bottle.intro: Fischfest 2 is a summer-themed Event that lasts from June 20th until September 12th, 2026. The event features a new island that can be accessed using the Magical Conch, several NPCs, and a new Sunshells currency, which can be exchanged for limited items.

Yellow_Studfish.description: A sunny yellow fish dotted with LEGO studs, brightening the ocean depths.
Yellow_Studfish.intro: Yellow Studfish is a Limited fish found in LEGO Pools during the LEGO Event.
trivia: The Yellow Studfish is from LEGO® Set 31122; Product page.

Yellowfin_Tuna.description: The Yellowfin Tuna is a species of tuna known for their speed and agility. The Yellowfin Tuna can be found best near Moosewoods waters, but you can find them in most open saltwater due to them being highly migratory. They are less endangered than Bluefin Tuna but still face threats.
Yellowfin_Tuna.intro: Yellowfin Tuna is an Uncommon fish found in Moosewood.

Zebrafishlet.description: A tiny striped swimmer, darting through the currents like a zebra in the herd.
Zebrafishlet.intro: Zebrafishlet is a Limited fish found in Animal Hunts in the First Sea.

Zeus%27_Herald.description: A legendary fish said to be Zeus' messenger, its body pure lightning given form. Its presence heralds the greatest of storms.
Zeus%27_Herald.intro: Zeus' Herald is a Mythical fish found in Atlantis.

Zeus_Storm_Totem.intro: Items are stored in the player's Inventory and can be 'favorited' (with right-click, or a double tap on mobile.) and moved around in the Backpack (openable by pressing ~ or G).

Zombiefish.description: Once a lifeless fish drifting to the surface, the Zombiefish was struck by lightning and brought back to life. Now reanimated, it prowls the waters during FischFright, haunting the tides with its undead presence.
Zombiefish.intro: Zombiefish is a Limited fish found in Frightful Pools during the FischFright 1 event.
